entries.meaningZh: 《阿依达》，威尔第创作的歌剧（Aida）
entries.en: The library's recording of Aida came with a libretto in three languages.
entries.zh: 图书馆收藏的《阿依达》录音附有三种语言的歌剧脚本。

entries.meaningZh: Angiostomidae科；曾用于包含Angiostoma、Strongyloides等线虫的一种历史科级分类
entries.en: The museum's catalogue retained Angiostomidae as the family name used in the original study.
entries.zh: 博物馆的目录保留了原研究所用的Angiostomidae这一科名。

entries.meaningZh: 安哥拉的；与安哥拉或其人民有关的
entries.en: The festival screened three Angolan films on its opening night.
entries.zh: 电影节开幕当晚放映了三部安哥拉电影。

entries.meaningZh: 环斑病毒科；按植物病症划分病毒时采用的一种历史科名（Annulaceae）
entries.en: The old chart grouped tobacco ringspot virus under Annulaceae.
entries.zh: 那张旧分类表把烟草环斑病毒归入了历史分类中的环斑病毒科。

entries.meaningZh: 异齿类；兽孔类中的一类化石动物（Anomodontia）
entries.en: The fossil display placed Anomodontia among the major groups of therapsids.
entries.zh: 化石展览把异齿类列为兽孔类的主要类群之一。

entries.meaningZh: 裸头绦虫属（Anoplocephala）
entries.en: The veterinary guide included Anoplocephala among the tapeworm genera found in horses.
entries.zh: 兽医指南把裸头绦虫属列入可见于马体内的绦虫属。

entries.meaningZh: 裸头绦虫科（Anoplocephalidae）
entries.en: The taxonomic table placed the specimen in Anoplocephalidae.
entries.zh: 分类表把该标本归入了裸头绦虫科。

entries.meaningZh: 吸虱类；吸食哺乳动物血液的虱类分类群（Anoplura）
entries.en: The entomology practical used a separate key to identify specimens of Anoplura.
entries.zh: 昆虫学实习课用一份专门的检索表鉴定吸虱类标本。

entries.meaningZh: 安普（Anpu）；旧埃及学英语文献中埃及神阿努比斯的名称
entries.en: The illustrated guide shows Anpu at the entrance to the tomb.
entries.zh: 图解指南把安普画在墓室入口处。

entries.meaningZh: Apodacea；历史海参分类中的无足亚纲名称，旧方案下包括Apodida和Molpadiida
entries.en: The seminar compared the old Apodacea grouping with later sea-cucumber classifications.
entries.zh: 研讨会比较了旧的Apodacea类群划分与后来的海参分类体系。

entries.meaningZh: 爱德华·维克托·阿普尔顿（Edward Victor Appleton，研究电离层的英国物理学家）
entries.en: The chapter on radio propagation opened with an account of Appleton's experiments.
entries.zh: 讲述无线电传播的那一章，以介绍阿普尔顿的实验作为开头。

entries.meaningZh: 阿基诺（Corazon C. Aquino，1933–2009）；菲律宾前总统（本例指这一历史人物）
entries.en: A portrait of Aquino greeted visitors at the entrance to the history exhibition.
entries.zh: 历史展览入口处，阿基诺的一幅肖像迎接着参观者。

entries.meaningZh: 阿基塔尼亚；古代高卢西南部的地域名称
entries.en: The history atlas places Aquitania north of the Pyrenees.
entries.zh: 那本历史地图集把阿基塔尼亚标在比利牛斯山以北。

entries.meaningZh: 阿拉伯语成分；出现在其他语言中的阿拉伯语词语、表达或特点
entries.en: The editor kept the Arabism because no English word conveyed quite the same idea.
entries.zh: 编辑保留了那个源自阿拉伯语的词，因为没有哪个英语词能表达完全相同的意思。

entries.meaningZh: Aramus属；美洲湿地中长喙涉禽的属名，属秧鹤科Aramidae
entries.en: We watched an Aramus bird searching the shallows for food at first light.
entries.zh: 天刚亮，我们就看着一只Aramus属的鸟在浅水里觅食。

entries.meaningZh: 园蛛类的历史属名Aranea；现列为Araneus属的晚出异名
entries.en: The old label read Aranea, and the newer catalogue placed the specimen under Araneus.
entries.zh: 旧标签上写的是Aranea，而较新的目录把该标本归在Araneus属下。

entries.meaningZh: 传统单子叶植物分类中的亚纲名Arecidae；包含棕榈等类群
entries.en: She turned to the Arecidae section of the flora after checking its classification scheme.
entries.zh: 核对分类框架后，她翻到了植物志中的Arecidae部分。

entries.meaningZh: 黑翻石鹬（Arenaria melanocephala），北美太平洋沿岸的鸟类
entries.en: The observer photographed Arenaria melanocephala on the wave-washed rocks.
entries.zh: 观察者在浪潮冲刷的岩石上拍下了黑翻石鹬Arenaria melanocephala。

entries.meaningZh: Argasoid；一种以铜为主要成分的仿银合金名称（历史材料名）
entries.en: The conservator recorded Argasoid as the material of the silver-coloured fitting.
entries.zh: 修复人员把那件银色配件的材质记为Argasoid合金。

entries.meaningZh: 园蛛科的旧科名Argiopidae；现列作Araneidae的异名
entries.en: The older paper uses Argiopidae for the orb-weaver family listed as Araneidae in the new catalogue.
entries.zh: 较早的论文用Argiopidae作为园蛛科的名称，而新目录使用Araneidae。

entries.meaningZh: 布卢姆；本例指计算机科学家 Manuel Blum
entries.en: The seminar discussed Blum's contributions to computational complexity.
entries.zh: 研讨课讨论了布卢姆对计算复杂性研究的贡献。

entries.meaningZh: 威廉·博伊斯（William Boyce，英国作曲家）
entries.en: A recording of Boyce's church music played quietly in the exhibition room.
entries.zh: 展厅里小声播放着博伊斯教会音乐作品的一段录音。

entries.meaningZh: 布拉格（William Lawrence Bragg）；研究晶体X射线结构分析的物理学家、1915年诺贝尔物理学奖得主之一（本例人名）
entries.en: The students used a model crystal to discuss Bragg's work.
entries.zh: 学生们用一个晶体模型讨论布拉格的研究。

entries.meaningZh: 费迪南德·布劳恩（Ferdinand Braun，物理学家、阴极射线管研究先驱）
entries.en: The lecture placed Braun's experiments in the history of electronic displays.
entries.zh: 讲座把布劳恩的实验放在电子显示技术的发展史中加以介绍。

entries.meaningZh: 保柏（Bupa），名称源于British United Provident Association的医疗保健集团
entries.en: She called Bupa to ask about the limits of her health cover.
entries.zh: 她致电保柏，询问自己医疗保险的保障限额。

entries.meaningZh: 安布罗斯·埃弗里特·伯恩赛德（Ambrose Everett Burnside，美国南北战争时期的将军）
entries.en: The exhibit used a battlefield map to explain Burnside's defeat at Fredericksburg.
entries.zh: 展览用一张战场地图解释伯恩赛德在弗雷德里克斯堡战败的经过。

entries.meaningZh: 乔治·巴特沃斯（George Butterworth，英国作曲家）
entries.en: The conductor asked the strings to repeat the opening of Butterworth's score more softly.
entries.zh: 指挥请弦乐组更轻柔地重奏巴特沃斯乐谱的开头。

entries.meaningZh: 综合精神病理评定量表的简称（Comprehensive Psychopathological Rating Scale，CPRS）
entries.en: The researchers used the CPRS to record changes in the patients' symptoms.
entries.zh: 研究人员用综合精神病理评定量表记录了患者症状的变化。

entries.meaningZh: 卡昂，法国西北部的一座城市（Caen）
entries.en: The old street map of Caen was too large to unfold on the train.
entries.zh: 那张卡昂旧街道地图太大了，在火车上无法展开。

entries.meaningZh: 凯丝，英国赛艇运动员 Cath Bishop 的名字（本例所指）
entries.en: Watching Cath race helped the young rowers understand the demands of a coxless pair.
entries.zh: 观看凯丝的比赛，帮助年轻赛艇选手理解了无舵手双人艇项目的要求。

entries.meaningZh: 克莱斯勒，汽车品牌名称（Chrysler）
entries.en: The brochure explained Chrysler's plans for its next generation of vehicles.
entries.zh: 宣传册介绍了克莱斯勒对其下一代汽车的规划。

entries.meaningZh: 达林顿（Sidney Darlington）；研究半导体电路的工程师（本例人名）
entries.en: The lecture placed Darlington's circuit work in the wider history of semiconductor design.
entries.zh: 这堂课把达林顿的电路研究放在半导体设计的整体历史中来讨论。

entries.meaningZh: 滴露；清洁和消毒用品品牌 Dettol
entries.en: The shop had sold out of the small bottles of Dettol.
entries.zh: 那家商店的小瓶装滴露已经售罄。

entries.meaningZh: 约翰·杜威（John Dewey，美国哲学家、教育思想家）
entries.en: Dewey's view of education divided the reading group.
entries.zh: 杜威的教育观在读书小组中引起了分歧。

entries.meaningZh: 邓恩（J. Michael Dunn）；哲学、信息学及计算机科学学者，曾任信息学学院院长（本例人名）
entries.en: The article recalls Dunn's work across philosophy and informatics.
entries.zh: 那篇文章回顾了邓恩横跨哲学与信息学的研究。

entries.meaningZh: 费拉里（Domenico Ferrari）；从事计算机系统性能和网络研究的学者（本例人名）
entries.en: The literature review highlights Ferrari's early work on computer-system performance.
entries.zh: 文献综述着重介绍了费拉里早期关于计算机系统性能的研究。

entries.meaningZh: Franklin；本例指Franklin Computer公司及其20世纪80年代微型计算机品牌
entries.en: The collector found a Franklin computer with its original keyboard.
entries.zh: 收藏者找到了一台保留着原装键盘的Franklin微型计算机。

entries.meaningZh: 吉布森（William Gibson）；小说Neuromancer等作品的作者（本例人名）
entries.en: Her essay reads Gibson's fiction alongside accounts of everyday life online.
entries.zh: 她的文章把吉布森的小说与有关日常网络生活的记述放在一起解读。

entries.meaningZh: 戈登（Gordon Bell）；本例在访谈讨论语境中以Gordon称呼这位计算机研究者
entries.en: The students compared Gordon's account of digital memory with their own note-taking habits.
entries.zh: 学生们把戈登关于数字记忆的介绍与自己的记笔记习惯作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 多元方差分析的缩写（multivariate analysis of variance）
entries.en: The team used MANOVA to compare the groups across several related outcomes.
entries.zh: 团队用多元方差分析比较了各组在多个相关结果指标上的差异。

entries.meaningZh: MORI；Market and Opinion Research International的简称，英国市场及民意研究机构的历史名称
entries.en: The journalist checked the original MORI survey before quoting its results.
entries.zh: 记者在引用结果前核查了MORI发布的原始调查。

entries.meaningZh: 马尔堡病毒病（本例为疾病名称的简称）
entries.en: The briefing compared Marburg with other viral haemorrhagic fevers.
entries.zh: 情况介绍比较了马尔堡病毒病与其他病毒性出血热。

entries.meaningZh: 麦吉，姓氏（Mcgee，常写作 McGee）
entries.en: McGee took a step back to check whether the picture was straight.
entries.zh: 麦吉后退一步，查看那幅画是否挂正了。

entries.meaningZh: 英国全国及地方政府工作人员协会的简称（National and Local Government Officers' Association，历史工会）
entries.en: The exhibition included a NALGO membership card from the 1970s.
entries.zh: 展览中有一张20世纪70年代的NALGO会员证。

entries.meaningZh: 英国全国公共部门雇员工会的简称（National Union of Public Employees，历史工会）
entries.en: The historian interviewed a retired NUPE organizer about working conditions in the 1980s.
entries.zh: 历史学家就20世纪80年代的工作条件采访了一名退休的NUPE工会组织者。

entries.meaningZh: 罗伯特（Henry M. Robert）；《罗伯特议事规则》的作者（本例人名）
entries.en: Before the meeting, she compared Robert's rules with the club's older procedures.
entries.zh: 开会前，她把罗伯特的议事规则与俱乐部较早的程序作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 老年人收缩期高血压研究项目的简称（Systolic Hypertension in the Elderly Program，临床研究名称）
entries.en: The lecture discussed SHEP as an example of a randomized clinical trial.
entries.zh: 讲座以老年人收缩期高血压研究项目为例，讨论了随机临床试验。

entries.meaningZh: 哈里森·施密特（Harrison Schmitt，美国地质学家、阿波罗17号宇航员）
entries.en: The students paused the film to discuss Schmitt's description of the lunar rocks.
entries.zh: 学生们暂停影片，讨论施密特对月岩的描述。

entries.meaningZh: 单列直插式内存模块的缩写（single in-line memory module，SIMM）
entries.en: The technician replaced a faulty SIMM in the old desktop.
entries.zh: 技术人员更换了那台旧式台式电脑中一个有故障的单列直插式内存模块。

entries.meaningZh: 英国运输及普通工人工会的简称（Transport and General Workers' Union，历史工会）
entries.en: The display traced the TGWU's campaigns for better working conditions.
entries.zh: 展览回顾了英国运输及普通工人工会为改善工作条件而开展的活动。

entries.meaningZh: 彼得·格思里·泰特（Peter Guthrie Tait，苏格兰数学家、物理学家）
entries.en: The exhibition linked Tait's work in physics with his interest in knots.
entries.zh: 展览将泰特的物理学研究与他对纽结的兴趣联系了起来。

entries.meaningZh: 文恩；本例指逻辑学家 John Venn，以文氏图著称
entries.en: Venn used overlapping circles to represent relations between sets.
entries.zh: 文恩用相互重叠的圆表示集合之间的关系。

entries.meaningZh: 施行人工流产的人（如今常带贬义）
entries.en: The pamphlet called the clinic's doctor an abortionist to discredit her work.
entries.zh: 小册子把诊所的医生称为“堕胎医生”，以诋毁她的工作。

entries.meaningZh: 航空结构件；飞行器中单独制造的部件或分段
entries.en: The inspector found a small dent in the newly delivered aerostructure.
entries.zh: 检查员在新交付的航空结构件上发现了一处小凹痕。

entries.meaningZh: ……岁；年龄为……（拉丁语aetatis的缩写，用于年龄记录）
entries.en: The miniature bears the inscription ‘aetat 31’ beside the date.
entries.zh: 这幅细密画在日期旁题有“31岁”。

entries.meaningZh: 乙醚麻醉；以乙醚使人失去知觉（旧拼法）
entries.en: Her notes on aetherization filled the last page of the notebook.
entries.zh: 她关于乙醚麻醉的笔记写满了笔记本的最后一页。

entries.meaningZh: 洗糖精炼；去除原糖晶体表面糖蜜膜的工序
entries.en: The refinery’s schedule left more time for affining.
entries.zh: 精炼厂的生产计划给洗糖精炼留出了更多时间。

entries.meaningZh: 上级法院对下级法院判决的维持或确认
entries.en: The court’s affirmance left the earlier judgment unchanged.
entries.zh: 上级法院维持原判，使先前判决保持不变。

entries.meaningZh: 作郑重声明而不宣誓的人（法律用语）
entries.en: The affirmant checked every page before signing the statement.
entries.zh: 作郑重声明的人在签署声明前逐页作了核对。

entries.meaningZh: 汇流；流向某处的过程（旧用语）
entries.en: The physician’s notes described an affluxion of blood towards the injured tissue.
entries.zh: 医生的笔记描述了血液向受伤组织汇流的情况。

entries.meaningZh: 租船人；为运送货物而租用船舶的人
entries.en: The affreighter asked whether the vessel could take the extra cargo.
entries.zh: 租船人询问这艘船能否装下额外的货物。

entries.meaningZh: 向物体或人身上浇洒液体；本例指浇水洗礼
entries.en: The guide pointed to the baptism by affusion in the wall painting.
entries.zh: 导览员指向壁画中以浇水方式施行的洗礼。

entries.meaningZh: Afridol；一种有机汞钠盐，CAS52795-88-7
entries.en: The analyst checked the label on the Afridol bottle against the inventory.
entries.zh: 分析员对照清单核查了那瓶Afridol有机汞钠盐的标签。

entries.meaningZh: 行动后复盘的；回顾评估已完成行动的（修饰报告等）
entries.en: Her after-action report devoted a full page to the failed radio link.
entries.zh: 她的行动后复盘报告用整整一页讨论了失灵的无线电通信链路。

entries.meaningZh: 后冷凝器；位于末级抽气器等后段、继续冷凝蒸汽的设备
entries.en: The inspection log records a leak in the after-condenser.
entries.zh: 检查记录记载了后冷凝器的一处泄漏。

entries.meaningZh: 后续费用；主要计划或工程完成后发生的支出（旧用语）
entries.en: The estate accounts record an unexpected after-cost for repairs to the new wall.
entries.zh: 庄园账目记载了新墙的一笔意外后续维修费用。

entries.meaningZh: 余辉；阴极射线管屏幕在电子束移开后短暂保持的发光
entries.en: Long after-glow made the moving trace difficult to follow.
entries.zh: 持续较久的余辉使移动的波迹难以辨认。

entries.meaningZh: 停堆余热；核反应堆停堆后由剩余放射性衰变持续产生的热量
entries.en: The trainee asked why cooling was still needed to remove afterheat.
entries.zh: 受训人员问，为什么仍需冷却来排走停堆余热。

entries.meaningZh: 后脉冲；主输出脉冲后由器件内部过程产生的伪脉冲（本例光电倍增管）
entries.en: The analyst excluded the afterpulse from the photon count.
entries.zh: 分析人员在光子计数中剔除了这个后脉冲。

entries.meaningZh: agarythrine；十九世纪文献从Agaricus ruber所记载的一种生物碱名称
entries.en: The old monograph lists agarythrine separately from the fungus’s red pigment.
entries.zh: 这本旧专著将agarythrine生物碱与该真菌的红色色素分开列出。

entries.meaningZh: agglomerin；由A、B、C、D四种组分组成的一种抗生素复合物
entries.en: The chemist compared the agglomerin complex with its separated components.
entries.zh: 化学家把agglomerin抗生素复合物与分离出的各组分作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 证券投机；以买卖证券牟利的活动（旧用语）
entries.en: Newspapers blamed agiotage for the wild swings in the price of government bonds.
entries.zh: 报纸把政府债券价格的大幅波动归咎于证券投机。

entries.meaningZh: 运转起来；处于活动或进行状态（旧副词）
entries.en: Their savings were enough to set the little workshop agoing.
entries.zh: 他们的积蓄足以让这间小作坊开工运转。

entries.meaningZh: 链霉素；Agrimycin是其记录在案的名称之一（本例指该物质）
entries.en: An older report uses Agrimycin as a name for streptomycin.
entries.zh: 较早的一份报告用Agrimycin作为链霉素的名称。

entries.meaningZh: 马尔库斯·维普萨尼乌斯·阿格里帕（Marcus Vipsanius Agrippa，古罗马将领）
entries.en: The map used blue arrows to show the route taken by Agrippa's fleet.
entries.zh: 地图用蓝色箭头标出了阿格里帕舰队所走的路线。

entries.meaningZh: 失眠（旧医学用语）
entries.en: Persistent agrypnia left him too tired to finish the letter.
entries.zh: 持续失眠使他疲惫得无法写完那封信。

entries.meaningZh: 妨碍睡眠的；使人保持清醒的（旧医学形容词）
entries.en: The old pharmacology text describes coffee as agrypnotic.
entries.zh: 那本旧药理学著作把咖啡描述为能使人保持清醒的饮品。

entries.meaningZh: 气流；空气的流动
entries.en: The filter reduced the airflow through the vent.
entries.zh: 过滤器减少了通过通风口的气流。

entries.meaningZh: 把人安置或关在气闸舱内（及物动词）
entries.en: In the novel, the commander decides to air-lock the visitors until their spacesuits have been checked.
entries.zh: 小说中，指挥官决定把来访者关在气闸舱内，直到他们的宇航服检查完毕。

entries.meaningZh: 空气域；由同一区域空气供应覆盖、可统筹治理空气污染的地理区域
entries.en: The two cities agreed to share pollution data for the same air-shed.
entries.zh: 两座城市同意共享同一空气域的污染数据。

entries.meaningZh: 黎明离别诗；描写恋人在拂晓分别的普罗旺斯抒情诗或歌曲
entries.en: The singer repeated the final line of the alba as the lute fell silent.
entries.zh: 琉特琴声停下时，歌者又唱了一遍那首黎明离别曲的最后一句。

entries.meaningZh: 分配器；管理内存分配的程序对象（本例为 C++ 内存管理义）
entries.en: The custom allocator reserved memory for the new container.
entries.zh: 这个自定义分配器为新容器分配了内存。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔文号，美国的一艘载人深海科研潜水器（Alvin）
entries.en: The team used Alvin to photograph the vents on the seafloor.
entries.zh: 团队使用阿尔文号拍摄海底的热液喷口。

entries.meaningZh: 阿玛，多贡人传统信仰中与创世有关的至高神（Amma）
entries.en: The lecturer compared different accounts of how Amma created the world.
entries.zh: 讲师比较了关于阿玛创造世界的不同叙述。

entries.meaningZh: 功能活动缺失（旧医学术语）
entries.en: The case notes recorded anergasia in the affected tissue despite repeated stimulation.
entries.zh: 病历记载，受影响的组织尽管受到反复刺激，仍缺乏功能活动。

entries.meaningZh: 器质性精神障碍的；与器质性缺损相关的（历史精神病学分类用语）
entries.en: The lecturer placed anergastic reactions in the organic-defect category of the historical classification.
entries.zh: 讲师把这套历史分类中的anergastic反应归入器质性缺损一类。

entries.meaningZh: Anesin；一种含氯丁醇的溶液的历史商品名（并非单指纯氯丁醇）
entries.en: A faded label identified the solution in the bottle as Anesin.
entries.zh: 一张褪色的标签标明，瓶中的溶液是Anesin。

entries.meaningZh: 抑动情性黄体内分泌物的旧称（采用1932年文献的历史用法，不作为现代激素身份鉴定）
entries.en: The 1932 account described anestrin as a luteal secretion acting in opposition to the follicular hormone.
entries.zh: 1932年的那份论述把anestrin描述为与卵泡激素作用相反的黄体内分泌物。

entries.meaningZh: 道德抑制缺乏；缺少伦理或道德约束的状态（旧心理学术语）
entries.en: The essay questioned whether anethopathy was a useful clinical concept or chiefly a moral judgment.
entries.zh: 这篇文章质疑，道德抑制缺乏究竟是有用的临床概念，还是主要属于道德判断。

entries.meaningZh: 起缓和、安抚或镇痛作用的（旧医学用语）
entries.en: The physician described the preparation as anetic, intended to soothe the patient's discomfort.
entries.zh: 医生把这种制剂描述为具有缓和作用，意在减轻患者的不适。

entries.meaningZh: 被包被的子实层在腔内发育成熟、随后包被破裂而暴露的真菌发育方式（angiocarpy）
entries.en: The lecture used a sequence of fungal sections to show the enclosed stages of angiocarpy.
entries.zh: 讲课时用一系列真菌切片展示了子实层包被内发育的各个阶段。

entries.meaningZh: 毛细血管扩张型皮肤结节病斑块；angiolupoid（旧称，现归入皮肤结节病的一种表现）
entries.en: The dermatologist photographed the angiolupoid on the patient's forehead before writing the case report.
entries.zh: 皮肤科医生在撰写病例报告前，拍下了患者前额的毛细血管扩张型结节病斑块。

entries.meaningZh: 血管或淋巴管疾病的旧统称（angiosis）
entries.en: The index used angiosis as a broad heading for diseases of blood vessels and lymphatic vessels.
entries.zh: 索引用angiosis作为血管和淋巴管疾病的宽泛分类标题。

entries.meaningZh: 使血管壁张力增强的（生理学用语）
entries.en: The experiment compared the angiotonic effects of the two extracts on isolated blood vessels.
entries.zh: 实验比较了两种提取物对离体血管产生的增强管壁张力作用。

entries.meaningZh: 下反角；飞机机翼自翼根向翼尖下倾的角度（航空义）
entries.en: Viewed from the front, the model's anhedral was clearly visible.
entries.zh: 从正面看，模型机翼的下反角清晰可见。

entries.meaningZh: 安徽紫草乌碱甲；anhweiaconitine，一种最初从安徽产紫草乌根中分离出的生物碱
entries.en: The chemist compared the new sample's spectrum with the reference data for anhweiaconitine.
entries.zh: 化学家把新样品的谱图与安徽紫草乌碱甲的参考数据进行了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 未水合状态（anhydration的一个旧医学用法）
entries.en: The report distinguished anhydration from the later uptake of water by the material.
entries.zh: 报告将该材料尚未水合的状态与其后吸收水分的过程区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 观念活动缺乏；缺少思维观念（旧心理学用语，并非缺少人生理想）
entries.en: The seminar discussed anideation as a disturbance of thinking.
entries.zh: 研讨课把观念活动缺乏作为一种思维障碍来讨论。

entries.meaningZh: anil-quinoline；带有anil亚胺基团的喹啉类化合物（历史化学文献用法）
entries.en: An anil-quinoline derivative was set aside for further spectral analysis.
entries.zh: 一种带有anil亚胺基团的喹啉衍生物被留作进一步谱图分析。

entries.meaningZh: 易被苯胺染料染色的；嗜苯胺染料的（组织学用语）
entries.en: The pathologist chose an aniline stain to reveal the anilinophil structures.
entries.zh: 病理学家选择了一种苯胺染料，以显示那些易被这类染料着色的结构。

entries.meaningZh: 对甲氧基苯基丙酮；1-(4-methoxyphenyl)propan-2-one（anisacetone）
entries.en: The analyst checked the chromatogram for a small peak corresponding to anisacetone.
entries.zh: 分析人员查看色谱图，寻找对应于对甲氧基苯基丙酮的小峰。

entries.meaningZh: 时间间隔不相等的；不等时的（本例信号时序义）
entries.en: The receiver logged the anisochronous pulses with a separate timestamp for each arrival.
entries.zh: 接收器为每个到达的脉冲单独记录时间戳，记下了这些间隔不等的脉冲。

entries.meaningZh: 脉搏快速且快慢不匀的（旧医学形容词）
entries.en: The old case notes describe an anisotachys pulse that varied from one minute to the next.
entries.zh: 旧病历描述了一种快速且快慢不匀的脉搏，其速率每分钟都在变化。

entries.meaningZh: anisyl；曾被假定存在于茴香及其衍生物中的基团的旧称（采用1900年Gould词典用法）
entries.en: In the old glossary, anisyl is treated as a hypothetical radical rather than an isolated substance.
entries.zh: 旧词汇表把anisyl视为一种假定基团，而非已分离出的物质。

entries.meaningZh: 二水硫酸钙的一种名称（annaline；此处采用新西兰EPA化学品名录用法）
entries.en: The inventory listed annaline under the entry for calcium sulfate dihydrate.
entries.zh: 名录把annaline列在二水硫酸钙的条目下。

entries.meaningZh: 胭脂树橙色素；从Bixa orellana种子取得的色素（annato，annatto的一种写法）
entries.en: The cheese maker added annato to give the batch a warmer orange colour.
entries.zh: 制酪师加入胭脂树橙色素，使这批奶酪呈现出更暖的橙色。

entries.meaningZh: 增环反应；向已有分子稠合一个新环的反应（annulation的另一用语）
entries.en: The proposed annelation would add a second ring to the starting molecule.
entries.zh: 所提出的增环反应将为起始分子再稠合一个环。

entries.meaningZh: annerdite；samarskite与columbite平行连生混合物的一种旧名称（USGS历史用法）
entries.en: The curator checked the old annerdite label against the catalogue's description of intergrown minerals.
entries.zh: 馆员对照目录中对连生矿物的描述，核查了旧的annerdite标签。

entries.meaningZh: 子宫附件炎；卵巢、输卵管等子宫附件的炎症（annexitis）
entries.en: The case report noted annexitis involving the left ovary and fallopian tube.
entries.zh: 病例报告记载了累及左侧卵巢和输卵管的子宫附件炎。

entries.meaningZh: 碘化百里香酚（dithymol diiodide，Aristol）的一种旧称
entries.en: The pharmacist found annidalin listed among the antiseptics in an old stock book.
entries.zh: 药剂师在一本旧库存簿中发现，annidalin被列在防腐消毒剂之中。

entries.meaningZh: 经年石松宁；annotinine，一种石松类生物碱
entries.en: The team reserved a portion of the annotinine sample for structural analysis.
entries.zh: 研究团队留出一部分经年石松宁样品，用于结构分析。

entries.meaningZh: 胭脂树橙色素；annatto的一种历史写法（annotta）
entries.en: The textile conservator identified annotta as the dye named in the faded recipe.
entries.zh: 纺织品修复人员认出，褪色配方里记载的染料annotta就是胭脂树橙色素。

entries.meaningZh: 胭脂树橙色素；用胭脂树种子表面色素层制成的染料（annotto）
entries.en: A little annotto gave the butter a deeper yellow colour.
entries.zh: 少量胭脂树橙色素使黄油呈现出更浓的黄色。

entries.meaningZh: 爱戏弄他人、惹人烦的人（本例指人）
entries.en: The office annoyer kept hiding people's mugs until everyone lost patience with him.
entries.zh: 办公室里那个爱捉弄人的家伙总把别人的杯子藏起来，直到大家都对他失去了耐心。

entries.meaningZh: 环螺旋状的（本例形容肌梭的感觉神经末梢）
entries.en: The drawing shows an annulo-spiral nerve ending wrapped around the central region of a muscle spindle.
entries.zh: 图中画出一个环螺旋状神经末梢，缠绕在肌梭的中央区域。

entries.meaningZh: anoia；曾用于描述严重理解能力缺失的旧医学术语
entries.en: The editor replaced the obsolete label anoia with a more precise description of the person's difficulties.
entries.zh: 编辑用更准确的文字描述此人的困难，替换了anoia这个过时标签。

entries.meaningZh: 对丙烯基苯酚（anol；p-propenylphenol）
entries.en: The chemist measured how anol behaved in solutions of different acidity.
entries.zh: 化学家测量了对丙烯基苯酚在不同酸度溶液中的表现。

entries.meaningZh: anolobine；一种阿朴啡型生物碱（此处对应FDA登记的(-)-anolobine）
entries.en: Only a few milligrams of anolobine remained for the final analysis.
entries.zh: 只剩几毫克anolobine可供最后的分析。

entries.meaningZh: 异常三色视觉；三类视锥细胞仍存在、其中一类颜色敏感性异常的一种色觉异常（anomalopia）
entries.en: The colour-matching test revealed anomalopia even though she could still distinguish many colours.
entries.zh: 尽管她仍能分辨许多颜色，颜色匹配测试还是显示出异常三色视觉。

entries.meaningZh: 无肩的（旧形态学用语）
entries.en: An anomous fetus was illustrated in the chapter on rare congenital malformations.
entries.zh: 讲述罕见先天畸形的章节中画有一个无肩胎体。

entries.meaningZh: anonaceine；早期文献报道从Xylopia aethiopica果实中取得的一种生物碱
entries.en: The review traced reports of anonaceine back to early work on Xylopia fruits.
entries.zh: 这篇综述把有关anonaceine的报道追溯到早期对Xylopia属植物果实的研究。

entries.meaningZh: 番荔枝碱；一种阿朴啡型生物碱（anonaine）
entries.en: The laboratory compared the anonaine sample with a separately stored reference standard.
entries.zh: 实验室把番荔枝碱样品与单独存放的参考标准品作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 环己酮的一种名称（anone；CAS108-94-1）
entries.en: The solvent analysis found anone but no cyclohexanol in the sample.
entries.zh: 溶剂分析在样品中检出了环己酮，没有检出环己醇。

entries.meaningZh: 无甲症；指甲或趾甲缺如
entries.en: The report documented anonychia affecting several fingers.
entries.zh: 报告记载了累及数个手指的无甲症。

entries.meaningZh: 上斜视；眼球向上偏斜（anoopsia的旧用法）
entries.en: The old ophthalmic record described the upward deviation of one eye as anoopsia.
entries.zh: 旧眼科病历把一眼向上偏斜的情况记为上斜视。

entries.meaningZh: 杀按蚊剂；能够杀灭按蚊的物质（anophelicide）
entries.en: The trial compared the new anophelicide with an untreated control.
entries.zh: 试验将这种新杀按蚊剂与未经处理的对照组作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 先天性无眼；出生时一眼或双眼缺如（anophthalmia）
entries.en: The specialist explained the diagnosis of unilateral anophthalmia to the baby's parents.
entries.zh: 专科医生向婴儿的父母解释了单侧先天性无眼的诊断。

entries.meaningZh: 先天性眼球缺如（anophthalmus；本例指病况）
entries.en: The embryology seminar included a case of congenital anophthalmus affecting only one eye.
entries.zh: 胚胎学研讨课讨论了一例仅累及一眼的先天性眼球缺如病例。

entries.meaningZh: 失明；视觉缺失（anopia的一个义项）
entries.en: His anopia prevented him from reading the printed notice without assistance.
entries.zh: 由于失明，他无法在无人帮助的情况下阅读那张印刷通知。

entries.meaningZh: 肛门成形术；修复或形成肛门开口的手术
entries.en: The surgeon discussed the planned anoplasty with the child's parents.
entries.zh: 外科医生与孩子的父母讨论了拟进行的肛门成形术。

entries.meaningZh: Anoplopoma属；包括sablefish（黑鳕）的一属鱼类
entries.en: The catalogue gave Anoplopoma as the genus of the sablefish specimen.
entries.zh: 目录把这件黑鳕标本的属名记为Anoplopoma。

entries.meaningZh: 视力缺失或受抑制（anopsia的一个义项）
entries.en: The ophthalmologist recorded anopsia in the affected part of the visual field.
entries.zh: 眼科医生记录了受影响视野区域的视觉缺失。

entries.meaningZh: 肛门与耻骨的；涉及两者的
entries.en: The trainee marked the anopubic distance on the pelvic diagram.
entries.zh: 实习生在骨盆示意图上标出了肛门至耻骨的距离。

entries.meaningZh: 无睾丸的；睾丸组织缺如的（本例形容病况）
entries.en: The study distinguished anorchid patients from those whose testes had failed to descend.
entries.zh: 研究把睾丸缺如的患者与睾丸未下降的患者区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 无睾丸的（anorchidic；本例形容实验动物）
entries.en: The study compared anorchidic mice with an untreated control group.
entries.zh: 研究将无睾小鼠与未经处理的对照组作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 食欲抑制剂；使食欲降低的药物（anoretic）
entries.en: The review discussed the risks associated with each anoretic.
entries.zh: 综述讨论了每一种食欲抑制剂所涉及的风险。

entries.meaningZh: 不含器官的（采用旧生物学用法的anorganic）
entries.en: The old text called the simple tissue anorganic because it contained no distinct organs.
entries.zh: 旧文献称这种简单组织为无器官的，因为其中没有独立的器官。

entries.meaningZh: 无机结构学；研究无机结构的学科（旧用语）
entries.en: His notes on anorganology included sketches of mineral crystal forms.
entries.zh: 他的无机结构学笔记中画有矿物晶形的草图。

entries.meaningZh: 性高潮缺失；无法达到性高潮（anorgasmy）
entries.en: She raised her concerns about anorgasmy during the consultation.
entries.zh: 她在就诊时谈到了自己对性高潮缺失的担忧。

entries.meaningZh: 不伴性高潮的；未达到性高潮的（anorgastic）
entries.en: The questionnaire recorded whether the sexual experiences had been anorgastic.
entries.zh: 问卷记录了这些性生活经历是否没有达到性高潮。

entries.meaningZh: 反常的；不符合常态或规则的（anormal，旧用语）
entries.en: The nineteenth-century report described the plant's growth as anormal.
entries.zh: 十九世纪的那份报告把这种植物的生长描述为异常。

entries.meaningZh: 浆液分泌不足；浆液性物质分泌减少（旧医学术语）
entries.en: The pathologist used anorrhorrhea to describe the gland's diminished serous secretion.
entries.zh: 病理学家把该腺体浆液分泌减少的情况记为anorrhorrhea。

entries.meaningZh: 歪长石；钠、钾、铝硅酸盐长石矿物（anorthoclase）
entries.en: The thin section contained several grains of anorthoclase.
entries.zh: 薄片中含有几颗歪长石颗粒。

entries.meaningZh: 视物变形；直线看起来弯曲的视觉异常（anorthopia的一个义项）
entries.en: Because of anorthopia, the straight edge of the door appeared bent to him.
entries.zh: 由于视物变形，他看见门的直边像是弯曲的。

entries.meaningZh: 利用旋转圆盘使变形图案显现为可辨认图像的一种光学装置（anorthoscope）
entries.en: Visitors turned the anorthoscope and watched the distorted drawing resolve into a recognizable picture.
entries.zh: 参观者转动这台光学装置，看着变形图案显现为可以辨认的图像。

entries.meaningZh: 勃起能力缺失或障碍（anorthosis的一种旧医学用法）
entries.en: The old medical index placed anorthosis among disorders of erectile function.
entries.zh: 旧医学索引把anorthosis列在勃起功能障碍一类。

entries.meaningZh: 肛门镜检查；利用肛门镜观察肛门及直肠下部的检查
entries.en: The clinic sent her an information sheet about anoscopy before the appointment.
entries.zh: 就诊前，诊所寄给她一份有关肛门镜检查的说明单。

entries.meaningZh: antiphthisin；一种历史结核菌素制剂
entries.en: A historian found antiphthisin mentioned in the correspondence between two tuberculosis researchers.
entries.zh: 一位历史学者在两名结核病研究者的通信中发现了对 antiphthisin 这种历史结核菌素制剂的提及。

entries.meaningZh: 抗疟原虫的；包括抑制疟原虫生长的
entries.en: She chose a review of antiplasmodial compounds for the journal club.
entries.zh: 她为文献讨论会选了一篇关于抗疟原虫化合物的综述。

entries.meaningZh: 反增塑作用；某些添加剂使聚合物刚性增加而非软化的现象
entries.en: The explanation surprised the class: antiplasticization had made the modified polymer stiffer rather than softer.
entries.zh: 这个解释让全班感到意外：反增塑作用使改性聚合物变得更硬，而非更软。

entries.meaningZh: 尿道球腺；考珀腺（旧称）
entries.en: The diagram gives the antiprostate and the prostate separate labels.
entries.zh: 这幅图分别标出了尿道球腺和前列腺。

entries.meaningZh: 聚合物抗辐射剂；用于减轻辐射所致性能变化的添加剂
entries.en: The materials report discussed the rubber's antirad content in a separate section.
entries.zh: 材料报告用单独一节讨论了这种橡胶中抗辐射剂的含量。

entries.meaningZh: 反倒易的（多项式满足 P(x) = −xⁿP(1/x)，n 为其次数）
entries.en: The student used x² − 1 as a simple example of an antireciprocal polynomial.
entries.zh: 这名学生用 x² − 1 举出反倒易多项式的一个简单例子。

entries.meaningZh: 反共振；振动系统响应出现极小值的现象
entries.en: A deep notch in the response curve marked the antiresonance.
entries.zh: 响应曲线上的一个深凹口标示出反共振。

entries.meaningZh: 反向运动错觉演示器（一种历史视觉仪器）
entries.en: The curator placed the antirheoscope beside the other optical instruments.
entries.zh: 馆员把反向运动错觉演示器摆在其他光学仪器旁边。

entries.meaningZh: 拮抗核黄素作用的
entries.en: The seminar devoted its final slide to the compound's antiriboflavin action.
entries.zh: 研讨课的最后一张幻灯片专门介绍了该化合物拮抗核黄素的作用。

entries.meaningZh: 据称可对抗硬癌的（旧医药用语）
entries.en: The historian treated the pamphlet's antiscirrhous promises as advertising rather than proof.
entries.zh: 这位历史学者把小册子中对抗硬癌的功效承诺视为广告宣传，而非证据。

entries.meaningZh: 拮抗铁生理作用的药剂；抗铁作用药剂
entries.en: The handbook groups this antisideric with drugs that counteract the physiological effects of iron.
entries.zh: 手册把这种抗铁作用药剂与其他拮抗铁生理效应的药物归为一类。

entries.meaningZh: 抗精子毒素（旧称：拮抗 spermotoxin 作用的物质）
entries.en: The report's reference to antispermotoxin puzzled the medical historian.
entries.zh: 报告中提到的抗精子毒素让那位医学史研究者感到困惑。

entries.meaningZh: 小鱼际的；位于手掌小指侧隆起处的
entries.en: The drawing shades the antithenar eminence beside the little finger.
entries.zh: 图中把小指旁的小鱼际隆起处涂上了阴影。

entries.meaningZh: 对偶的（蒙特卡洛模拟中将随机变量作反向相关配对的）
entries.en: Each antithetic pair in the simulation contained u and 1 − u.
entries.zh: 模拟中的每一组对偶变量都包含 u 和 1 − u。

entries.meaningZh: 抗凝血活酶物质；拮抗凝血活酶作用的抗凝物质
entries.en: Her lecture notes distinguish antithromboplastin from substances that simply remove calcium.
entries.zh: 她的讲义把拮抗凝血活酶的物质与单纯去除钙的物质区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: antithyroidin；一种历史血清制剂名称，不等同于现代甲状腺激素拮抗剂的统称
entries.en: The faded caption identified the vial as antithyroidin, rather than thyroid extract.
entries.zh: 褪色的说明文字将瓶中物标为 antithyroidin 这种历史血清制剂，而非甲状腺提取物。

entries.meaningZh: 抗体（所引旧词典中 antitropin 的泛义）
entries.en: The editor added a note explaining the older term antitropin to readers familiar with antibody.
entries.zh: 编辑加了一条注释，向熟悉 antibody 一词的读者解释 antitropin 这个表示抗体的旧称。

entries.meaningZh: antitulase；早期结核病研究中的一种免疫血清制剂名称
entries.en: An entire page of the monograph is devoted to antitulase and the debate surrounding it.
entries.zh: 这本专著用整整一页讨论 antitulase 这种历史免疫血清制剂及围绕它的争论。

entries.meaningZh: 防治性传播疾病的
entries.en: The local archive holds several posters from the town's antiveneral campaign.
entries.zh: 当地档案馆保存着几张该镇性传播疾病防治宣传活动的海报。

entries.meaningZh: 抗病毒红素；历史抗生素 antivirubin 的名称
entries.en: The librarian located an early paper on antivirubin in a bound volume from the 1950s.
entries.zh: 图书馆员在一册二十世纪五十年代的合订本中找到了一篇早期介绍抗病毒红素的论文。

entries.meaningZh: 抵御异物或外来因子的（用于机体防御机制）
entries.en: The chapter on antixenic defenses explains how the lungs respond to foreign material.
entries.zh: 有关抵御异物的防御机制的一章解释了肺部如何应对外来物质。

entries.meaningZh: antozone；旧化学理论中假设的氧变体名称，所引旧词典后来将其归为过氧化氢
entries.en: The historian traced the disappearance of antozone from later accounts of oxygen chemistry.
entries.zh: 这位历史学者追溯了 antozone 这一名称从后来的氧化学论述中消失的过程。

entries.meaningZh: 主动脉弓扩张并伴主动脉瓣关闭不全（Hodgson 病的旧称）
entries.en: Aortism was recorded in the casebook alongside a description of the enlarged aortic arch.
entries.zh: 病例簿记载了旧称 aortism 的病变，同时描述了扩大的主动脉弓。

entries.meaningZh: 顶嘴；无礼的回嘴（非正式用语）
entries.en: The teacher asked for an explanation, not backtalk.
entries.zh: 老师要求作出解释，而不是无礼地顶嘴。

entries.meaningZh: baronet的书面缩写（Bart.）；准男爵头衔
entries.en: Sir Edward Vale, Bart., declined the invitation.
entries.zh: 爱德华·韦尔准男爵谢绝了邀请。

entries.meaningZh: 糟蹋；劣化；使原有事物的品质败坏（本例为改编作品义）
entries.en: Fans criticised the film as a bastardization of the original novel.
entries.zh: 影迷批评这部电影糟蹋了原著小说。

entries.meaningZh: 鸨母；经营妓院的女人（旧式或文学用语，本例为经营者义）
entries.en: The play's bawd arranges meetings between wealthy clients and the women she controls.
entries.zh: 剧中的鸨母为富有的客人与她控制的女人安排会面。

entries.meaningZh: 生物地球化学；研究生物过程与地球环境中化学物质循环关系的学科
entries.en: Her research in biogeochemistry tracks how carbon moves between soil, plants and the atmosphere.
entries.zh: 她的生物地球化学研究追踪碳如何在土壤、植物和大气之间迁移。

entries.meaningZh: 化学构词成分boro-；表示化合物中含有硼
entries.en: She highlighted boro- in borosilicate to remind herself that the glass contains boron.
entries.zh: 她标出了borosilicate（硼硅酸盐）中的构词成分boro-，提醒自己这种玻璃含有硼。

entries.meaningZh: 狂蝇幼虫，尤指寄生在马体内的种类（bott，bot 的较少用拼法）
entries.en: The preserved bott was large enough to examine without a microscope.
entries.zh: 那只保存下来的狂蝇幼虫大得不用显微镜就能观察。

entries.meaningZh: 胸花；别在衣服扣眼或翻领上的花（本例为服饰义）
entries.en: He chose a blue ribbon to match the white boutonniere on his jacket.
entries.zh: 他选了一条蓝色缎带，来搭配夹克上的白色胸花。

entries.meaningZh: 经纪业务；经纪人的业务活动
entries.en: Broking accounted for most of the firm's income that year.
entries.zh: 那一年，经纪业务占了这家公司收入的大部分。

entries.meaningZh: 分页器；沿穿孔线分开表格纸的设备（本例为纸张处理设备义）
entries.en: The burster separated the printed forms along their perforations.
entries.zh: 分页器沿着穿孔线将印好的表格纸分开。

entries.meaningZh: 中美洲清算所的简称（Central American Clearing House，历史区域支付清算安排）
entries.en: The study examined how CACH settled payments among participating central banks.
entries.zh: 这项研究考察了中美洲清算所如何结算参与国中央银行之间的支付。

entries.meaningZh: 一种地中海地区的刺柏属植物，Juniperus oxycedrus（本例为植物义）
entries.en: A mature cade shaded the stone wall at the edge of the garden.
entries.zh: 一株成年的 Juniperus oxycedrus 为花园边缘的石墙投下了阴影。

entries.meaningZh: 精神贯注；精神分析理论中对某人、事物或观念的心理能量投入
entries.en: The analyst interpreted his attachment to the house as a strong cathexis.
entries.zh: 分析师将他对那所房子的依恋解释为强烈的精神贯注。

entries.meaningZh: 诉讼；请求法律救济的程序（法律用语，源于拉丁语）
entries.en: The clerk entered the causa in the court's register.
entries.zh: 书记员把这起诉讼登记在法院的登记簿上。

entries.meaningZh: 日本自治体国际化协会的简称（Council of Local Authorities for International Relations）
entries.en: The council asked CLAIR for help arranging an exchange with a Japanese town.
entries.zh: 该地方议会请自治体国际化协会协助安排与一个日本城镇的交流。

entries.meaningZh: 淡水龟；本例指河栖的 Pseudemys concinna
entries.en: A cooter slid from the log into the river as we approached.
entries.zh: 我们走近时，一只河栖淡水龟从圆木上滑进了河里。

entries.meaningZh: 润湿器；使物体湿润的装置（本例为信封封口用具义）
entries.en: The clerk pressed each envelope against the dampener before sealing it.
entries.zh: 办事员在封口前，把每个信封贴在润湿器上润湿。

entries.meaningZh: 下延笔画；小写字母伸到基线下方的部分（排印用语）
entries.en: The descender of the letter g dipped below the ruled line.
entries.zh: 字母 g 的下延笔画伸到了横线下方。

entries.meaningZh: 迪娜，女性名字（Dina）
entries.en: Dina left her sketchbook on the train and went back to look for it.
entries.zh: 迪娜把速写本落在了火车上，又回去寻找。

entries.meaningZh: 迟钝或行动迟缓的人（古语）
entries.en: 'Wake up, you doldrum!' the captain shouted at the sleeping guard.
entries.zh: “醒醒，你这个呆子！”船长冲着熟睡的守卫喊道。

entries.meaningZh: 德鲁兹教徒；德鲁兹宗教群体的成员
entries.en: My neighbour is a Druze who grew up in Lebanon.
entries.zh: 我的邻居是一名在黎巴嫩长大的德鲁兹教徒。

entries.meaningZh: 蕴涵；前提为真时结论必定为真的逻辑关系（本例为逻辑义）
entries.en: The tutor used a counterexample to disprove the claimed entailment.
entries.zh: 导师用一个反例推翻了所声称的逻辑蕴涵关系。

entries.meaningZh: 教唆他人（尤指儿童）犯罪的成年人；犯罪教唆犯
entries.en: The crime story centres on a fagin who recruits children at the railway station.
entries.zh: 这部犯罪故事围绕一名在火车站招募儿童犯罪的教唆犯展开。

entries.meaningZh: 契据；法律文书；法律事实（旧法律用语）
entries.en: The archivist placed the damaged fait between two sheets of protective paper.
entries.zh: 档案员把那份受损的契据夹在两张保护纸之间。

entries.meaningZh: 细粉，尤指升华所得的粉末（旧化学用语，复数形式）
entries.en: The chemist collected the flores on a sheet of black paper.
entries.zh: 化学家把这些细粉收集在一张黑纸上。

entries.meaningZh: 叶酸的；与叶酸有关的，常见于 folic acid（叶酸）这一名称
entries.en: The label listed folic acid among the added vitamins.
entries.zh: 标签把叶酸列在所添加的维生素之中。

entries.meaningZh: Gentianopsis属的龙胆类植物，花冠裂片边缘呈流苏状
entries.en: A fringed gentian opened its blue flower beside the wet meadow path.
entries.zh: 湿草甸的小径旁，一株花冠边缘呈流苏状的龙胆开出了蓝花。

entries.meaningZh: 不知从何处；突然地（本例为突然出现义）
entries.en: A delivery cyclist seemed to appear from nowhere and rang his bell.
entries.zh: 一名送货骑手仿佛不知从哪儿冒了出来，按响了车铃。

entries.meaningZh: 客厅；住宅中供人坐下交谈、休息的起居室
entries.en: They moved the armchairs into the front room before the visitors arrived.
entries.zh: 客人到来前，他们把扶手椅搬进了客厅。

entries.meaningZh: 小鳕鱼；本例取北美tomcod义，即Microgadus属鱼类
entries.en: The angler released the frost fish after checking its size.
entries.zh: 钓者量过大小后，把那条北美小鳕鱼放回水中。

entries.meaningZh: （比喻）极为愤怒；气得口沫横飞
entries.en: He began to froth at the mouth when the meeting was cancelled.
entries.zh: 会议一取消，他就气得口沫横飞。

entries.meaningZh: 蛋奶冻冰淇淋；以煮制蛋奶糊为基底的冷冻甜品
entries.en: We bought frozen custard from the little shop opposite the pier.
entries.zh: 我们在码头对面的小店买了蛋奶冻冰淇淋。

entries.meaningZh: 修正因子；为调整结果或补偿测量、估算中的不确定性而引入的数值
entries.en: The reviewer questioned the unexplained fudge factor in the cost estimate.
entries.zh: 审阅者质疑了成本估算中那个没有说明依据的修正因子。

entries.meaningZh: 燃油系统；给发动机供给燃料的设备系统
entries.en: The mechanic checked the fuel system before trying to restart the engine.
entries.zh: 机械师先检查了燃油系统，再尝试重新启动发动机。

entries.meaningZh: 全成形针织的；按衣片形状编织制成的
entries.en: The shop displayed a fully-fashioned cardigan with neatly joined seams.
entries.zh: 商店陈列着一件按形编织后拼缝的开襟毛衣，接缝整齐。

entries.meaningZh: 完全长成的；已达到成年体型的
entries.en: The fully grown cat was still smaller than the puppy.
entries.zh: 那只已经长成的猫，体型仍比小狗小。

entries.meaningZh: 功能性文盲的；读写能力不足以应付日常实际需要的
entries.en: The course was designed for adults who were functionally illiterate but had years of practical work experience.
entries.zh: 这门课程面向读写能力不足以应付日常需要、但已有多年实际工作经验的成年人。

entries.meaningZh: 斜桁顶帆；张设于斜桁上方的三角形纵帆
entries.en: The crew lowered the gaff topsail as the wind strengthened.
entries.zh: 风力增强时，船员们降下了斜桁上方的顶帆。

entries.meaningZh: 缺音音阶；少于七个音的音阶，如五声音阶
entries.en: The composer used a gapped scale to give the melody a sparse, open sound.
entries.zh: 作曲家采用了省略部分音级的音阶，让旋律显得疏朗开阔。

entries.meaningZh: 垃圾堆放场；用来倾倒垃圾的地点
entries.en: The old garbage dump was fenced off while the council planned its restoration.
entries.zh: 市政部门规划修复方案期间，旧垃圾堆放场被围栏封了起来。

entries.meaningZh: 茄（Solanum melongena）；本例取食用茄果义
entries.en: She sliced a garden egg and added it to the stew.
entries.zh: 她把一个茄子切片，放进炖菜里。

entries.meaningZh: 酸模（Rumex acetosa）；本例选择这一食用酸味叶菜植物义
entries.en: She added a few leaves of garden sorrel to the soup for a sharp flavour.
entries.zh: 她在汤里加了几片酸模叶，让汤多些酸味。

entries.meaningZh: 庭园网螟Achyra rantalis的幼虫；会在植物叶上结网的毛虫
entries.en: The gardener found a garden webworm feeding inside a webbed leaf.
entries.zh: 园丁在一片被丝网裹住的叶子里，发现了一条Achyra rantalis幼虫正在取食。

entries.meaningZh: 瑞香属灌木Daphne cneorum；低矮、常绿，开粉红花
entries.en: The garland flower covered the rockery with small pink blossoms.
entries.zh: 这株Daphne cneorum开出小小的粉红花朵，铺满了假山石园。

entries.meaningZh: 韭菜（Allium tuberosum）；本例取植株义
entries.en: A garlic chive grew through a gap between the paving stones.
entries.zh: 一株韭菜从铺路石之间的缝隙里长了出来。

entries.meaningZh: 蒜味酱；本例取以大蒜调味的蛋黄酱aioli义
entries.en: She whisked crushed garlic into the mayonnaise to make garlic sauce.
entries.zh: 她把捣碎的大蒜搅进蛋黄酱里，调成了蒜味酱。

entries.meaningZh: 旅行衣物袋；可展开悬挂衣物的行李袋，本例不限定塑料材质
entries.en: He unzipped the garment bag and hung the suit in the wardrobe.
entries.zh: 他拉开旅行衣物袋的拉链，把西装挂进衣柜。

entries.meaningZh: 搓板针；平织时每行均织下针、形成横向凸棱的针织组织
entries.en: She chose garter stitch for the scarf because it produced a ridged texture.
entries.zh: 她选择用搓板针织围巾，因为它能织出带凸棱的纹理。

entries.meaningZh: 汽车油量表；显示油箱中剩余汽油量的仪表，采用gage拼法
entries.en: The gas gage showed that there was little fuel left in the tank.
entries.zh: 汽车油量表显示，油箱里剩下的燃油已经不多。

entries.meaningZh: 汽车油量表；显示油箱中剩余汽油量的仪表，采用gauge拼法
entries.en: She glanced at the gas gauge before choosing the longer route.
entries.zh: 她在选择较长的路线之前，看了一眼汽车油量表。

entries.meaningZh: 气体弹发射枪；本例指发射气体弹的枪，而非导气式自动枪
entries.en: An old gas gun stood in the museum's collection of crowd-control equipment.
entries.zh: 博物馆的防暴装备藏品中陈列着一支旧式气体弹发射枪。

entries.meaningZh: （美）汽车加油机；供给汽油的加油设备
entries.en: A delivery van blocked the only working gas pump.
entries.zh: 一辆送货货车堵住了唯一还能用的加油机。

entries.meaningZh: 盖尔，姓氏（Gayle）
entries.en: Gayle unfolded the map and traced the river with a pencil.
entries.zh: 盖尔展开地图，用铅笔沿着河流描画。

entries.meaningZh: 双子座，黄道上的一个星座（本例为天文学名称）
entries.en: A faint pencil circle marked Gemini on the folded star chart.
entries.zh: 折叠的星图上，一个淡淡的铅笔圈标记着双子座。

entries.meaningZh: 遗传禀赋；个体继承的遗传特征或遗传构成
entries.en: The study considered both genetic endowment and the conditions in which the children grew up.
entries.zh: 这项研究同时考虑了遗传禀赋和孩子们成长的环境条件。

entries.meaningZh: 地理英里；所引词典用作nautical mile（海里）的同义名称，本例不指定换算值
entries.en: The navigator used a geographical mile as the distance unit in the logbook.
entries.zh: 领航员在航海日志中以地理英里作为距离单位。

entries.meaningZh: 婆婆纳属植物Veronica chamaedrys，通常开蓝白色花
entries.en: Blue germander speedwell flowered along the woodland path.
entries.zh: 林间小路旁的Veronica chamaedrys开着蓝花。

entries.meaningZh: （非正式）发生性关系
entries.en: The scene implies that the two adults get it on, then cuts to the next morning.
entries.zh: 这一幕暗示两个成年人发生了性关系，随后镜头切换到次日清晨。

entries.meaningZh: 开始；着手做事
entries.en: Let's get started before the light fades.
entries.zh: 趁天色还没暗下来，我们开始吧。

entries.meaningZh: 抢先；抢在他人之前采取行动或取得优势（常接on）
entries.en: They hoped to get the jump on rival teams by testing the equipment early.
entries.zh: 他们希望通过提早测试设备，抢先于其他队伍。

entries.meaningZh: 听闻；得知（多指偶然得知某事）
entries.en: If the neighbours get wind of the surprise, the whole plan will be ruined.
entries.zh: 如果邻居们听说了这个惊喜安排，整个计划就泡汤了。

entries.meaningZh: 幽灵词；由误读、误印等错误产生、又被当成真实词流传的词形
entries.en: The lexicographer traced the ghost word to a misread handwritten note.
entries.zh: 词典编纂者追查发现，这个幽灵词源于对一张手写便条的误读。

entries.meaningZh: 日本蜘蛛蟹（Macrocheira kaempferi）；本例选择这一物种义
entries.en: The aquarium's giant crab moved its long legs slowly across the tank floor.
entries.zh: 水族馆里的日本蜘蛛蟹缓慢地移动长腿，沿着水槽底部爬行。

entries.meaningZh: 欧洲大胡蜂（Vespa crabro）；本例选择该物种义
entries.en: The giant hornet paused on the fallen apple before flying back into the trees.
entries.zh: 那只欧洲大胡蜂在落地的苹果上停了一会儿，然后飞回树间。

entries.meaningZh: 科莫多巨蜥（Varanus komodoensis）；本例取物种义
entries.en: Visitors watched the giant lizard walk past the keeper's shelter.
entries.zh: 游客们看着那只科莫多巨蜥从饲养员的遮棚旁走过。

entries.meaningZh: 巨型雪纳瑞犬；一种大型雪纳瑞犬品种
entries.en: The giant schnauzer rested beside its handler after the obedience exercise.
entries.zh: 服从训练结束后，那只巨型雪纳瑞犬在训导员身边休息。

entries.meaningZh: 大型天蚕蛾类的幼虫；本例取天蚕蛾科毛虫义，非成蛾
entries.en: The giant silkworm gripped the twig while it chewed a fresh leaf.
entries.zh: 那条大型天蚕蛾幼虫抓住细枝，啃着一片新鲜叶子。

entries.meaningZh: 白得的礼物或好处；常用于look a gift horse in the mouth这一习语
entries.en: We weren't going to look a gift horse in the mouth when the theatre offered us free rehearsal space.
entries.zh: 剧院愿意免费借给我们排练场地，我们可不会再挑三拣四。

entries.meaningZh: 礼品包装纸；用于包装礼物的纸张
entries.en: She cut a sheet of silver gift wrap for the box.
entries.zh: 她剪下一张银色礼品包装纸，准备包盒子。

entries.meaningZh: （口语，略粗俗）在乎；关心（常用于否定句）
entries.en: I don't give a damn about the colour as long as the chair is comfortable.
entries.zh: 只要椅子坐着舒服，我一点也不在乎它是什么颜色。

entries.meaningZh: 提供照护；照料人
entries.en: The charity recruited more volunteers to give care to older residents.
entries.zh: 慈善机构招募了更多志愿者，为年长居民提供照护。

entries.meaningZh: 向人眉目传情；投去含情或诱惑的目光（旧式说法）
entries.en: He tried to give the glad eye to the pianist.
entries.zh: 他试着向钢琴演奏者眉目传情。

entries.meaningZh: 宣泄；表达情绪（常接to）
entries.en: She used her diary to give vent to feelings she could not express at work.
entries.zh: 她用日记宣泄那些在工作中无法表达的情绪。

entries.meaningZh: 断气；本例比喻机器彻底停止工作，采用通常分写形式give up the ghost
entries.en: We replaced the kettle before it could give up the ghost completely.
entries.zh: 我们趁那只水壶还没彻底坏掉，就换了新的。

entries.meaningZh: 锦葵科草本Napaea dioica；原产北美，掌状叶、白色小花
entries.en: The glade mallow rose above the other plants in the damp meadow.
entries.zh: 潮湿草甸里的Napaea dioica长得比周围的植物都高。

entries.meaningZh: 蛇蜥类蜥蜴；身体细长似蛇，尾长而易断
entries.en: The glass snake moved through the dry grass beside the path.
entries.zh: 那只蛇蜥穿过小路旁的干草丛。

entries.meaningZh: 金莲花属（Trollius）植物，具有近球状的黄色花
entries.en: A globe flower opened its yellow bloom beside the pond.
entries.zh: 池塘边的一株金莲花属植物开出了黄色的花。

entries.meaningZh: 光泽蛇（Arizona elegans）；鳞片表面有光泽的夜行蛇
entries.en: The glossy snake's scales reflected the light from the torch.
entries.zh: 那条光泽蛇的鳞片反射着手电筒的光。

entries.meaningZh: 唇裂（旧称，现被视为冒犯；现代通常用 cleft lip）
entries.en: The old medical record used harelip where a modern report would say cleft lip.
entries.zh: 旧病历使用了 harelip 一词，现代报告则会使用 cleft lip（唇裂）。

entries.meaningZh: 管鼻果蝠类（Nyctimene属）；鼻孔呈分叉管状的果蝠
entries.en: The harpy bat's tube-shaped nostrils were clear in the close-up photograph.
entries.zh: 特写照片清楚显示了这只Nyctimene属果蝠管状的鼻孔。

entries.meaningZh: 哈他瑜伽；结合身体姿势与呼吸练习的瑜伽体系
entries.en: The hatha yoga class began with a few quiet minutes of breathing.
entries.zh: 哈他瑜伽课以几分钟安静的呼吸练习开始。

entries.meaningZh: 用车辆运走；拉走
entries.en: The council hired a truck to haul off the broken branches.
entries.zh: 市政部门雇了一辆卡车把折断的树枝运走。

entries.meaningZh: 熟练掌握（常用have something down结构）
entries.en: Once I have the basic steps down, I'll try the faster version.
entries.zh: 等我熟练掌握基本步骤后，就会尝试速度更快的版本。

entries.meaningZh: 猛鸮（Surnia ulula）；北方的鹰形鸮鸟
entries.en: The hawk owl watched the clearing from the top of a dead spruce.
entries.zh: 那只猛鸮站在一棵枯云杉的顶端，注视着林间空地。

entries.meaningZh: 失灵的；工作异常的（非正式用语）
entries.en: The ticket machine went haywire just as the evening queue began to grow.
entries.zh: 晚间排队的人刚多起来，售票机就出了故障。

entries.meaningZh: 出售吸食大麻等所用器具及相关用品的商店
entries.en: The head shop displayed glass pipes and incense in the window.
entries.zh: 那家烟具用品店的橱窗里陈列着玻璃烟斗和熏香。

entries.meaningZh: 夏枯草（Prunella vulgaris）；本例取植物义，不表示疗效
entries.en: Purple spikes of heal-all rose above the short grass.
entries.zh: 矮草丛上方长出了夏枯草的紫色花穗。

entries.meaningZh: 健康检查；评估身体健康状况的体检
entries.en: The clinic offered a health check before the start of the training programme.
entries.zh: 培训项目开始前，诊所提供了一次健康检查。

entries.meaningZh: 健身保健中心；提供锻炼设施的营业场所
entries.en: The health spa had a small exercise room overlooking the garden.
entries.zh: 那家健身保健中心有一间面向花园的小健身房。

entries.meaningZh: 罗马天主教徒每年捐给教廷的捐金；Peter’s Pence的同义名
entries.en: Parish records list the hearth money collected for Rome that year.
entries.zh: 教区记录列出了当年为罗马教廷收取的捐金。

entries.meaningZh: 加热过的；已经变热的
entries.en: Steam rose from the heated-up soup on the counter.
entries.zh: 柜台上热好的汤冒着蒸汽。

entries.meaningZh: 已灭绝的北美草原松鸡，传统学名Tympanuchus cupido cupido
entries.en: For the exhibition, the museum borrowed a mounted heath hen.
entries.zh: 为举办展览，博物馆借来了一件这种已灭绝的北美草原松鸡的剥制标本。

entries.meaningZh: 从Hedeoma pulegioides（American pennyroyal）提取的芳香挥发油
entries.en: The chemist kept the hedeoma oil in a tightly sealed amber bottle.
entries.zh: 化学师用密封严实的棕色瓶保存这种挥发油。

entries.meaningZh: Echinocereus属的仙人掌，通常具有显著尖刺
entries.en: A hedgehog cactus grew between two sun-warmed rocks.
entries.zh: 两块被太阳晒暖的岩石之间，长着一株Echinocereus属仙人掌。

entries.meaningZh: （较旧的说法）慌乱匆忙地；乱糟糟地
entries.en: The servants rushed heels over head to prepare for the unexpected guests.
entries.zh: 仆人们手忙脚乱地赶着为突然到访的客人做准备。

entries.meaningZh: 自行取用；自取（常接to，尤用于食物等）
entries.en: Visitors are welcome to help themselves to apples from the basket.
entries.zh: 欢迎访客自行取用篮子里的苹果。

entries.meaningZh: 唇形科植物Galeopsis tetrahit，具有硬毛和白色或淡红色花
entries.en: The hemp nettle grew taller than the young cabbages around it.
entries.zh: 这株Galeopsis tetrahit长得比周围的小卷心菜还高。

entries.meaningZh: 丁型肝炎；由丁肝病毒引起、依赖乙肝病毒感染而发生的肝炎
entries.en: Her research focuses on hepatitis delta and its interaction with hepatitis B.
entries.zh: 她的研究聚焦于丁型肝炎及其与乙型肝炎的相互关系。

entries.meaningZh: 草本茶；用草本植物的叶等冲泡的茶样饮料
entries.en: He offered me a cup of herb tea made with dried mint.
entries.zh: 他给我端来一杯用干薄荷泡的草本茶。

entries.meaningZh: 菊科草本植物Filago germanica，具有棉絮状毛
entries.en: The botanist examined the woolly leaves of herba impia with a hand lens.
entries.zh: 植物学家用手持放大镜观察Filago germanica带绒毛的叶片。

entries.meaningZh: 梯牧草（Phleum pratense）；本例取常栽作干草的牧草义
entries.en: The farmer cut the herd's grass before its long flower spikes had fully ripened.
entries.zh: 农民在梯牧草的长花穗完全成熟前收割了它。

entries.meaningZh: 前桅挂横帆、后桅挂纵帆的双桅帆船；brigantine的同义称呼
entries.en: The painting shows a hermaphrodite brig entering the harbour under reduced sail.
entries.zh: 画中，一艘只张了部分帆的前横后纵帆式双桅帆船正驶入港口。

entries.meaningZh: 寄居蟹；腹部柔软、常住在空螺壳中的甲壳动物
entries.en: At the slightest movement, the hermit crab withdrew into its shell.
entries.zh: 稍有动静，那只寄居蟹就缩回它寄住的贝壳里。

entries.meaningZh: 把英雄或名人当作偶像而强烈崇拜的人；worshiper为美式拼法
entries.en: As a young hero worshiper, he copied the runner's haircut as well as his training clothes.
entries.zh: 年轻时，他把那位赛跑运动员当作偶像，连发型和训练服都照着模仿。

entries.meaningZh: 把英雄或名人当作偶像而强烈崇拜的人；worshipper为英式拼法
entries.en: The biographer was determined to be a critic rather than a hero worshipper.
entries.zh: 那位传记作者决心做一名批评者，而不做人物的盲目崇拜者。

entries.meaningZh: 英雄双韵体对句；两行押韵的抑扬格五音步诗句
entries.en: He ended the stanza with a neat heroic couplet.
entries.zh: 他用两行工整的抑扬格五音步押韵诗句收住了这个诗节。

entries.meaningZh: 山核桃属Carya树木的坚果，尤指北美山核桃
entries.en: The squirrel rolled a hickory nut across the porch.
entries.zh: 松鼠把一颗山核桃滚过了门廊。

entries.meaningZh: 髋臼；与股骨头相接的髋关节窝部
entries.en: The diagram showed how the ball of the femur fits into the hip socket.
entries.zh: 图中展示了股骨头如何嵌入髋臼。

entries.meaningZh: 四面斜坡的（本例指四坡屋顶）
entries.en: The cottage had a hipped roof with no vertical gable ends.
entries.zh: 这间乡舍的屋顶四面倾斜，没有垂直的山墙端面。

entries.meaningZh: 雇来的农工；受雇在农场或牧场劳动的人
entries.en: The hired hand was already mending the fence when the farmer arrived.
entries.zh: 农场主到来时，雇来的农工已经在修篱笆。

entries.meaningZh: 暂停招聘；某个雇主或机构暂时停止招收新员工的措施
entries.en: The museum announced a hiring freeze while it reviewed next year's budget.
entries.zh: 博物馆在审查来年预算期间宣布暂停招聘。

entries.meaningZh: 工会经营的职业介绍或派工所，按资历或轮派等方式分配工作
entries.en: By six in the morning, dockworkers were waiting at the union's hiring hall.
entries.zh: 早晨六点，码头工人们已经在工会的派工所等候。

entries.meaningZh: 组胺H2受体阻断剂；通过阻断H2受体来抑制组胺作用的药物
entries.en: The lecture compared two histamine blockers that act at H2 receptors.
entries.zh: 这堂课比较了两种作用于H2受体的组胺阻断剂。

entries.meaningZh: 使人切实体会或充分理解；产生切身影响
entries.en: The cost of the delays hit home when we received the final invoice.
entries.zh: 收到最终账单时，我们才切实体会到延误造成的代价。

entries.meaningZh: （旧俚语）纵酒；过量饮酒
entries.en: In the novel, he would hit it up at the same shabby bar after every payday.
entries.zh: 小说里，他每逢发薪后都会去同一家破旧酒吧狂饮一番。

entries.meaningZh: （非正式）上床睡觉；就寝
entries.en: It was nearly midnight when I finally decided to hit the hay.
entries.zh: 等我终于决定去睡觉时，已经快半夜了。

entries.meaningZh: 灰毛豆属Tephrosia植物，具有羽状叶和扁平有毛的荚果
entries.en: The hoary pea's pale, hairy leaves stood out against the darker grasses.
entries.zh: 这株Tephrosia属植物灰白多毛的叶片，在深色草丛中格外显眼。

entries.meaningZh: 北美柳属灌木Salix candida，叶片灰白多毛
entries.en: The hoary willow bent over a shallow pool at the edge of the marsh.
entries.zh: 沼泽边，一株Salix candida俯垂在浅水潭上方。

entries.meaningZh: 给泥瓦匠搬运砖块、灰浆等材料的小工
entries.en: The hod carrier set down his load beside the bricklayers.
entries.zh: 给泥瓦匠运料的小工把搬来的材料放在砌砖工身旁。

entries.meaningZh: 热带果树Spondias mombin的黄色果实，又称yellow mombin
entries.en: The ripe hog plum left a sharp, sour taste in her mouth.
entries.zh: 熟透的Spondias mombin果实在她嘴里留下了一股强烈的酸味。

entries.meaningZh: 牢牢坚持；坚守（常接to）
entries.en: Despite the setbacks, she continued to hold fast to her original plan.
entries.zh: 尽管屡遭挫折，她仍坚持原来的计划。

entries.meaningZh: 临时圈留牲畜的围场
entries.en: The cattle waited in the holding yard while the trailer was backed into position.
entries.zh: 拖车倒入指定位置时，牛群在临时围场里等候。

entries.meaningZh: 在家修习的课程或学习方式，可采用函授等形式
entries.en: He completed the accounting course through home study while working nights.
entries.zh: 他一边上夜班，一边通过在家学习完成了会计课程。

entries.meaningZh: 古德等积投影；用于世界地图的等面积投影，常采用分瓣形式
entries.en: The atlas uses a homolosine projection to compare the areas of continents.
entries.zh: 这本地图集采用古德等积投影来比较各大陆的面积。

entries.meaningZh: 指蜜鸟；非洲和亚洲的鸟类，能取食蜂蜡等，部分种类会引人寻找蜂巢
entries.en: A honey guide called from a branch above the beekeeper.
entries.zh: 一只指蜜鸟在养蜂人头顶的树枝上鸣叫。

entries.meaningZh: 北美牧豆树类植物Prosopis glandulosa，具刺和富含糖分的荚果
entries.en: The honey mesquite shaded the dry creek bed with its spreading branches.
entries.zh: 那株Prosopis glandulosa伸展着枝条，为干涸的溪床遮出一片阴影。

entries.meaningZh: 以促进科学、艺术或文学等为宗旨的荣誉学会或学术团体
entries.en: The honorary society elected her for her contributions to marine science.
entries.zh: 这个学会因她对海洋科学的贡献而推选她为成员。

entries.meaningZh: （拉丁语）出于荣誉；用于授予名誉学位
entries.en: The university awarded her a doctorate honoris causa.
entries.zh: 大学授予她名誉博士学位。

entries.meaningZh: 会发出低沉hoot叫声的猫头鹰；本例不限定具体属种
entries.en: From the orchard came the low call of a hoot owl.
entries.zh: 果园里传来一只猫头鹰低沉的鸣叫。

entries.meaningZh: 车轴草属Trifolium dubium，开淡黄色小花的三叶草
entries.en: Yellow hop clover flowered between the stones at the edge of the path.
entries.zh: 小径边的石缝里，Trifolium dubium开着黄色小花。

entries.meaningZh: 骑上；登上动物的背部
entries.en: She paused by the pony, then decided to hop on for a short ride.
entries.zh: 她在小马旁停了一下，随后决定骑上去走一小段路。

entries.meaningZh: 同前所述的人或事物；同一作者或同一出处（主要用于书目、引注）
entries.en: The editor used idem in the second footnote instead of repeating the author's name.
entries.zh: 编辑在第二条脚注中用 idem 代替再次写出作者的姓名。

entries.meaningZh: 向内生长；长入（罕用，不及物）
entries.en: The narrow gaps allowed roots to ingrow between the stones.
entries.zh: 那些狭窄的缝隙使根能够长入石块之间。

entries.meaningZh: 四分位间的；位于上下四分位数之间的（本例用于 interquartile range，四分位距）
entries.en: The interquartile range was small even though one observation was unusually high.
entries.zh: 尽管有一个观测值异常偏高，四分位距仍然很小。

entries.meaningZh: 美国废钢铁协会的历史简称（Institute of Scrap Iron and Steel，本例采用该机构义）
entries.en: The archive preserved correspondence between ISIS and several steel companies.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着美国废钢铁协会与几家钢铁公司之间的往来信件。

entries.meaningZh: 权利；权限（法律用语，jus 的复数）
entries.en: The charter set out the jura claimed by the town's guilds.
entries.zh: 特许状列明了该镇各行会所主张的权利。

entries.meaningZh: 卡菲尔高粱；一种籽粒高粱（本例只选作物名称义）
entries.en: The trial compared kafir with two other grain sorghums.
entries.zh: 这项试验比较了卡菲尔高粱与另外两种籽粒高粱。

entries.meaningZh: 肯德尔（M. G. Kendall）；1938年A New Measure of Rank Correlation论文作者（本例人名）
entries.en: The statistics tutor wrote Kendall's name beside the rank-correlation exercise.
entries.zh: 统计课教师在那道秩相关练习旁写下了肯德尔的名字。

entries.meaningZh: 虚己论的；与基督自我倒空的神学观念有关的（基督教神学用语）
entries.en: The seminar compared kenotic and non-kenotic accounts of the incarnation.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了关于道成肉身的虚己论解释与不采用虚己论的解释。

entries.meaningZh: 克尔（Roy P. Kerr）；发表旋转质量引力场研究、提出克尔解的理论研究者（本例人名）
entries.en: The professor sketched the geometry of Kerr's rotating black-hole solution on the board.
entries.zh: 教授在黑板上画出了克尔旋转黑洞解的几何示意图。

entries.meaningZh: 基伊，姓氏（Keye）
entries.en: Keye steadied the ladder while I replaced the bulb.
entries.zh: 基伊扶稳梯子，我则更换灯泡。

entries.meaningZh: 麻风病患者（古旧称谓，现代宜使用 person with leprosy 等中性表达）
entries.en: A lazar appears briefly in the medieval tale, asking the travellers for food.
entries.zh: 那篇中世纪故事里，一名麻风病患者短暂出场，向旅人讨要食物。

entries.meaningZh: 立法会；本例指香港的立法机关
entries.en: The legislative council debated the housing proposal late into the evening.
entries.zh: 立法会讨论那项住房提案，一直持续到深夜。

entries.meaningZh: 柠檬蛋白霜派；以柠檬馅为主体、表面覆有蛋白霜的派
entries.en: She spread the meringue over the lemon meringue pie before putting it in the oven.
entries.zh: 她把蛋白霜铺在柠檬派上，然后将派送进烤箱。

entries.meaningZh: 小扁豆汤；以小扁豆为主要材料的汤
entries.en: A pot of lentil soup was simmering beside the kitchen window.
entries.zh: 厨房窗边，一锅小扁豆汤正用小火煨着。

entries.meaningZh: 小食蚁兽；本例指Tamandua tetradactyla，具有可缠握的尾巴
entries.en: The lesser anteater curled its tail around a branch as it climbed.
entries.zh: 那只小食蚁兽攀爬时，把尾巴缠在了一根树枝上。

entries.meaningZh: 百金花属草本Centaurium pulchellum；RHS所用的lesser centaury植物义
entries.en: We found lesser centaury growing in a gap beside the path.
entries.zh: 我们在小径旁的一处空隙里发现了Centaurium pulchellum。

entries.meaningZh: 放下；使物体降至较低位置的动作
entries.en: The slow letting down of the heavy curtain took several minutes.
entries.zh: 把那幅沉重的幕布缓缓放下，花了好几分钟。

entries.meaningZh: 淫猥；猥亵的言行或性质
entries.en: Several reviewers objected to the lewdness of the jokes in the performance.
entries.zh: 几位评论者反对演出中那些笑话的淫猥内容。

entries.meaningZh: 起重装置；用于举升重物的设备
entries.en: The lifting device raised the engine clear of the workshop floor.
entries.zh: 起重装置把发动机吊离了车间地面。

entries.meaningZh: 轻蝇量级拳手（本例取传统业余拳击的类别名称）
entries.en: In the old tournament photograph, the light flyweight stands beside his coach.
entries.zh: 在那张旧拳赛照片中，这位轻蝇量级拳手站在教练身旁。

entries.meaningZh: 光时；光在真空中传播一小时所经过的距离，是长度单位
entries.en: In the diagram, the probe was one light hour from Earth.
entries.zh: 图中，那艘探测器距离地球一光时。

entries.meaningZh: 轻中量级拳手（本例取传统业余拳击的类别名称）
entries.en: The retired light middleweight still helped young boxers at the club.
entries.zh: 那位退役的轻中量级拳手仍在俱乐部帮助年轻拳手。

entries.meaningZh: 轻次中量级拳手（本例取传统业余拳击的类别名称）
entries.en: A light welterweight from our club reached the final of the amateur tournament.
entries.zh: 我们俱乐部的一名轻次中量级拳手打进了那次业余拳赛的决赛。

entries.meaningZh: 短莛山麦冬（Liriope muscari），具有草状叶的多年生草本
entries.en: The gardener planted lily turf along the edge of the shaded path.
entries.zh: 园丁沿着林荫小径的边缘种下了短莛山麦冬。

entries.meaningZh: 柔枝松（Pinus flexilis）；北美西部一种枝条柔韧的松树
entries.en: The limber pine's flexible branches bent under the fresh snow.
entries.zh: 那棵柔枝松柔韧的枝条在新落的积雪下弯了下来。

entries.meaningZh: 有限审阅；对财务信息提供有限保证、程序范围小于审计的业务
entries.en: The board requested a limited review of the financial statements before the annual audit.
entries.zh: 董事会要求在年度审计之前，对财务报表进行有限审阅。

entries.meaningZh: 司线裁判；本例指美式橄榄球比赛中的场上裁判之一
entries.en: The line judge moved along the sideline as the football game continued.
entries.zh: 美式橄榄球比赛继续进行，司线裁判沿着边线移动。

entries.meaningZh: 线形叶；狭长、两侧边缘大致平行的叶片
entries.en: Each linear leaf was narrow enough to slip between the bars of the fence.
entries.zh: 每片线形叶都很窄，能从栅栏的栏杆间穿过去。

entries.meaningZh: 舌；解剖学上对舌的称呼（lingua）
entries.en: In the anatomy diagram, the lingua was shaded blue.
entries.zh: 解剖图中，舌被涂成了蓝色。

entries.meaningZh: 白头翁属植物Pulsatilla patens的一种英文俗名，亦称American pasqueflower
entries.en: The lion's beard opened its pale violet flowers in the spring sunshine.
entries.zh: 春日阳光下，那株Pulsatilla patens开出了淡紫色的花。

entries.meaningZh: 弟弟；年龄比自己小的兄弟
entries.en: My little brother kept the ticket from his first train journey.
entries.zh: 我弟弟一直保存着他第一次乘火车时的车票。

entries.meaningZh: 妹妹；年龄比自己小的姐妹
entries.en: Her little sister drew a map to help us find the house.
entries.zh: 她妹妹画了一张地图，帮助我们找到那所房子。

entries.meaningZh: 小规格的北美硬壳蛤（Mercenaria mercenaria）；quahog的食用规格名称
entries.en: We ordered littleneck clams as a starter and shared a bowl between us.
entries.zh: 我们点了一碗小规格的北美硬壳蛤作前菜，一起分着吃。

entries.meaningZh: 美洲常绿栎类树木；并非专指落叶的槲树
entries.en: The live oak kept its green canopy while the neighbouring trees stood bare.
entries.zh: 旁边的树木光秃秃的，那棵常绿栎树却仍然绿荫满冠。

entries.meaningZh: 装卸货台；卡车或列车装卸货物的平台
entries.en: The driver backed the truck towards the warehouse loading dock.
entries.zh: 司机把卡车倒向仓库的装卸货台。

entries.meaningZh: 角豆荚；角豆树的豆荚，内含种子和带甜味的果肉
entries.en: She split a dried locust bean to show the seeds inside.
entries.zh: 她掰开一条干角豆荚，展示里面的种子。

entries.meaningZh: （英式非正式用语）持停车示意牌、帮助学童过马路的女性护导员
entries.en: The lollipop lady held up her sign while the children crossed the road.
entries.zh: 孩子们过马路时，那位女护导员举起了停车示意牌。

entries.meaningZh: Phegopteris connectilis；一种分布于北美和欧亚的蕨类植物，亦称northern beech fern
entries.en: A patch of long beech fern covered the bank beside the stream.
entries.zh: 溪流旁的坡岸上长着一片Phegopteris connectilis蕨。

entries.meaningZh: 天牛；天牛科中身体较长、触角通常很长的甲虫
entries.en: A longicorn beetle crawled across the log, sweeping its long antennae ahead.
entries.zh: 一只天牛爬过圆木，长长的触角在前方摆动。

entries.meaningZh: 观看；把目光投向某物、用视觉观察的活动
entries.en: The tutor encouraged careful looking at the painting before any discussion.
entries.zh: 老师鼓励大家在讨论之前，先仔细观察那幅画。

entries.meaningZh: （非正式）失去情绪控制；发怒或崩溃
entries.en: She was afraid she would lose it if another customer shouted at her.
entries.zh: 她担心，如果再有顾客对她大喊大叫，她就会情绪失控。

entries.meaningZh: 地中海地区的鼠李科灌木状落叶植物Ziziphus lotus
entries.en: The lotus tree's thorny branches formed a dense barrier beside the track.
entries.zh: 那株Ziziphus lotus带刺的枝条在小路旁形成了一道密密的屏障。

entries.meaningZh: Abies grandis；北美太平洋沿岸的一种高大冷杉，亦称grand fir
entries.en: The lowland white fir rose above the smaller trees beside the river.
entries.zh: 河边，那棵Abies grandis冷杉高出了周围较小的树木。

entries.meaningZh: 罗经基准线；船用罗经上用于指示船首方向的固定标线
entries.en: The helmsman read the heading where the compass card met the lubber's line.
entries.zh: 舵手在罗经刻度盘与船首基准线相交的位置读取航向。

entries.meaningZh: 润滑物质；用于使接触表面滑顺、减小摩擦的物质
entries.en: A thin film of lubricating substance coated the metal surfaces.
entries.zh: 金属表面覆着一层薄薄的润滑物质。

entries.meaningZh: 月球太阳日；月面同一地点相邻两次太阳升起的间隔，约为29.5个地球日
entries.en: The chart compares a lunar day, measured from one sunrise to the next, with an Earth day.
entries.zh: 图表对比了月球上从一次日出到下一次日出的太阳日与地球上的一日。

entries.meaningZh: 月球登月舱；阿波罗计划中运送宇航员往返月面与月球轨道的飞行器
entries.en: The lunar excursion module carried two astronauts towards the surface while their colleague remained in orbit.
entries.zh: 登月舱载着两名宇航员前往月面，另一名同伴则留在轨道上。

entries.meaningZh: 机枪手；操作机枪的人员
entries.en: The veteran had served as a machine gunner before becoming a schoolteacher.
entries.zh: 那位退伍军人当教师之前，曾是一名机枪手。

entries.meaningZh: 轻机枪；本例取所引词典中machine rifle的历史武器名称义
entries.en: The museum label dated the machine rifle to the early twentieth century.
entries.zh: 博物馆的说明牌把那挺轻机枪的年代标为二十世纪初。

entries.meaningZh: 机缝针迹；由缝纫机形成的针迹
entries.en: The machine stitch was so even that she could barely see where the seam began.
entries.zh: 机缝针迹十分均匀，她几乎看不出缝线从哪里开始。

entries.meaningZh: 鱼鳞状云天；卷积云或小片高积云排列成行、呈鱼鳞状的天空景象
entries.en: A mackerel sky stretched above the fishing boats at dawn.
entries.zh: 黎明时，渔船上空铺展着一片鱼鳞状云天。

entries.meaningZh: 以很高的学业荣誉；以优异成绩（用于毕业荣誉等级）
entries.en: She graduated magna cum laude while working evenings at the campus library.
entries.zh: 她以优异成绩毕业，在校期间晚间还在校园图书馆工作。

entries.meaningZh: 大联盟棒球运动员；大联盟棒球队的队员
entries.en: The former major leaguer now coaches children on Saturday mornings.
entries.zh: 那位前大联盟棒球运动员现在每周六上午指导孩子们打球。

entries.meaningZh: 特意做；刻意确保做到（常接of doing）
entries.en: I make a point of learning everyone's name before the first meeting.
entries.zh: 第一次开会前，我会特意记住每个人的名字。

entries.meaningZh: 让路；腾出通道
entries.en: The crowd stepped back to make way for the ambulance.
entries.zh: 人群向后退，为救护车让路。

entries.meaningZh: 用于祈祷、冥想的一串念珠或绳结（尤用于印度教）
entries.en: One of the mala's wooden beads had cracked, so he set it aside for repair.
entries.zh: 那串念珠有一颗木珠裂了，他便把它放到一旁，准备修理。

entries.meaningZh: 莽吉柿；山竹树（Garcinia mangostana），果实可食的热带乔木
entries.en: The mangosteen tree shaded the courtyard beside the kitchen.
entries.zh: 厨房旁的院子里，那棵山竹树投下了一片树荫。

entries.meaningZh: 肯塔拉麻纤维；由菲律宾栽培的龙舌兰类植物取得、可制粗绳的硬质纤维
entries.en: The rope maker twisted manila maguey into a coarse cord.
entries.zh: 制绳匠把肯塔拉麻纤维捻成了一根粗绳。

entries.meaningZh: 持枪操练；按规定进行的步枪操练动作
entries.en: The recruits practised the manual of arms until their movements matched.
entries.zh: 新兵们反复练习持枪操练，直到动作一致。

entries.meaningZh: 地图集；本例指装订成册的一组地图
entries.en: The map collection opened with a double-page view of the whole continent.
entries.zh: 这本地图集开篇是一幅横跨两页的全大陆地图。

entries.meaningZh: 列队走出；本例指从狭窄通道行进到开阔地带
entries.en: The soldiers began to march out of the narrow pass onto the plain.
entries.zh: 士兵们开始列队走出狭窄的山口，进入平原。

entries.meaningZh: 闭海；受单一国家管辖、对其他国家关闭的可航行海域
entries.en: The essay examines an old ruler's claim that the gulf was a mare clausum.
entries.zh: 这篇文章考察了一位昔日统治者关于该海湾属于闭海的主张。

entries.meaningZh: 古罗马人对地中海的称呼，字面意为“我们的海”
entries.en: Roman merchants carried grain across mare nostrum to ports in Italy.
entries.zh: 古罗马商人把粮食运过他们所称的“我们的海”，送往意大利的港口。

entries.meaningZh: 一团乱麻；混乱复杂的局面或杂乱的一堆事物
entries.en: The accounts were a mare's nest of missing receipts and contradictory totals.
entries.zh: 这些账目乱成一团：收据缺失，各项总数也互相矛盾。

entries.meaningZh: 马斯特曼，姓氏（Masterman）
entries.en: Masterman moved the meeting indoors when the first drops of rain fell.
entries.zh: 最初几滴雨落下时，马斯特曼把会议转移到室内。

entries.meaningZh: 美狄亚，希腊神话中帮助伊阿宋取得金羊毛的科尔喀斯公主（Medea）
entries.en: The seminar compared the ways different plays portray Medea.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了不同戏剧塑造美狄亚的方式。

entries.meaningZh: 安德鲁·威廉·梅隆（Andrew William Mellon，美国金融家和慈善家）
entries.en: Two chapters of the biography deal with Mellon's banking career.
entries.zh: 这部传记用两章讲述梅隆的银行业生涯。

entries.meaningZh: 微生物群；本例指肠道中的细菌等微生物
entries.en: The study compared the intestinal microflora of the two groups.
entries.zh: 研究比较了两组的肠道微生物群。

entries.meaningZh: 代替实物什一税缴纳的定额款项（旧法律用语）
entries.en: The old lease specified a modus payable each year in place of tithes.
entries.zh: 旧租约规定，每年缴纳一笔定额款以代替什一税。

entries.meaningZh: 一钠的；在化学式中含一个钠原子的（化学用语）
entries.en: The label listed monosodium glutamate among the ingredients.
entries.zh: 标签将谷氨酸一钠列为一种配料。

entries.meaningZh: 北美西部的一种禾本科牧草，所引词典学名为Oryzopsis hymenoides；非旱稻
entries.en: The seed heads of mountain rice trembled in the wind above the dry grassland.
entries.zh: 干燥草地上方，Oryzopsis hymenoides带籽的穗头在风中颤动。

entries.meaningZh: 卷耳属Cerastium中若干小型草本植物的俗名（本例为一株植物，非属名本身）
entries.en: A mouse ear had taken root between the paving stones.
entries.zh: 一株卷耳属小草在铺路石的缝隙间扎了根。

entries.meaningZh: 鼠兔；小型、短耳的兔形目哺乳动物，本例不限定草原鼠兔这一物种
entries.en: A mouse hare called from a gap between the rocks, then disappeared from view.
entries.zh: 一只鼠兔在岩石缝隙里叫了一声，随后消失不见了。

entries.meaningZh: 卷耳属Cerastium中若干草本的俗名，通常开白色小花；本例不固定为单一物种
entries.en: Our seedlings were crowded by mouse-ear chickweed along the edge of the bed.
entries.zh: 苗床边缘的卷耳属草本挤占了我们幼苗的生长空间。

entries.meaningZh: 菊科草本Pilosella officinarum，旧时归入Hieracium属，叶被柔毛
entries.en: A mouse-ear hawkweed spread its hairy leaves close to the ground.
entries.zh: 一株Pilosella officinarum贴着地面展开了被有柔毛的叶子。

entries.meaningZh: 来回移动；先向一个方向、再向相反方向移动
entries.en: The loose sign began to move back and forth in the wind.
entries.zh: 那块松动的标牌开始在风中来回摆动。

entries.meaningZh: 与……很相似地；像……那样（本例为方式用法）
entries.en: She prepared the tea much as her grandmother had done, warming the pot first.
entries.zh: 她像祖母从前那样准备茶水，先把茶壶温热。

entries.meaningZh: 美洲骨顶（Fulica americana）；北美的一种秧鸡科水鸟
entries.en: A mud hen paddled between the reeds, leaving a narrow trail on the water.
entries.zh: 一只美洲骨顶游过芦苇间，在水面留下了一道窄窄的水迹。

entries.meaningZh: 泥螈Necturus maculosus；具有羽状外鳃的北美水生有尾两栖动物（本例义）
entries.en: The mud puppy remained under a flat rock in the stream.
entries.zh: 那只Necturus maculosus泥螈待在溪流中的一块扁石下面。

entries.meaningZh: 泥龟类；栖息于美洲泥底淡水水域的龟类
entries.en: The mud turtle disappeared into the soft sediment at the edge of the pond.
entries.zh: 那只泥龟钻进了池塘边柔软的沉积物里。

entries.meaningZh: 肱三头肌；上臂后侧具有三个头的肌肉
entries.en: During the anatomy practical, she labelled the musculus triceps brachii on the model.
entries.zh: 解剖实习课上，她在模型上标出了肱三头肌。

entries.meaningZh: 蘑菇酱汁；本例取加入炒蘑菇的棕色酱汁义，非蘑菇酱油
entries.en: He spooned mushroom sauce over the roast before carrying it to the table.
entries.zh: 他把蘑菇酱汁浇在烤肉上，然后将肉端上餐桌。

entries.meaningZh: 音乐教师；教授音乐的人
entries.en: The music teacher asked each pupil to clap the rhythm before singing.
entries.zh: 音乐教师请每个学生先拍出节奏，再开始唱歌。

entries.meaningZh: 澳洲麝鸭（Biziura lobata）；本例指澳大利亚的这种水鸟，不指番鸭
entries.en: The musk duck dived beside the reed bed and resurfaced farther away.
entries.zh: 那只澳洲麝鸭在芦苇丛旁潜入水中，随后在更远处浮出水面。

entries.meaningZh: 前膛枪；从枪口一端装填的旧式火器
entries.en: The museum's muzzle loader had a cracked wooden stock.
entries.zh: 博物馆里那支前膛枪的木制枪托上有一道裂缝。

entries.meaningZh: 美国国家汽车配件协会的简称（National Automotive Parts Association）；本例用于NAPA品牌的配件门店
entries.en: She stopped at a NAPA store to collect a replacement headlamp.
entries.zh: 她在一家NAPA汽车配件店停留，领取一个替换用的前照灯。

entries.meaningZh: 纳粹的；与德国国家社会主义运动或纳粹党有关的（历史政治用语）
entries.en: The exhibition traced the spread of national socialist propaganda through local newspapers.
entries.zh: 展览追踪了纳粹宣传如何通过地方报纸传播。

entries.meaningZh: 新西兰树状倒挂金钟Fuchsia excorticata；可长成灌木或小乔木的植物
entries.en: The native fuchsia shaded the wooden footbridge beside the stream.
entries.zh: 那株新西兰Fuchsia excorticata为溪边的木制小桥遮出了阴凉。

entries.meaningZh: 航海链；旧长度单位，本例取所引工程词典中15英尺的定义
entries.en: Her transcription preserved the distance in nautical chains rather than converting it to miles.
entries.zh: 她誊录时保留了以航海链表示的距离，没有把它换算成英里。

entries.meaningZh: Hakea lissosperma；澳大利亚一种叶片坚硬呈针状的哈克木属灌木
entries.en: The needle bush's rigid leaves caught the sleeve of his jacket.
entries.zh: 那株Hakea lissosperma坚硬的叶子勾住了他的夹克袖子。

entries.meaningZh: Eleocharis acicularis；荸荠属中茎细如针的一种湿地植物
entries.en: A thin carpet of needle spike rush spread across the shallow end of the tank.
entries.zh: 水缸浅水端铺开了一层细密的Eleocharis acicularis。

entries.meaningZh: Hakea leucoptera；澳大利亚一种叶端尖锐、开乳白色花的灌木，非一般针叶木材
entries.en: Creamy flowers clustered among the pointed leaves of the needle wood.
entries.zh: 那株Hakea leucoptera尖锐的叶片间，簇生着乳白色的花。

entries.meaningZh: Sarcocephalus latifolius非洲灌木的一种旧英文俗名；英文含过时、可能冒犯的种族用字
entries.en: The herbarium sheet labels the African shrub 'negro peach' in the collector's handwriting.
entries.zh: 那张植物标本签上，采集者亲笔用旧名“negro peach”标注了这株非洲灌木。

entries.meaningZh: 一种叶片有毛、开暗紫褐色花的缠绕藤本的旧英文名；英文含过时、可能冒犯的种族用字（所引词典义）
entries.en: She replaced the outdated label 'negro vine' with the plant's scientific name in the exhibition.
entries.zh: 她把展览里过时的“negro vine”标签换成了该植物的学名。

entries.meaningZh: 筑巢地点；适合鸟类等动物筑巢的地方
entries.en: The pair returned to the same nesting place beneath the bridge.
entries.zh: 那对鸟又回到了桥下同一个筑巢地点。

entries.meaningZh: 神经胶质细胞；组成神经胶质的单个细胞
entries.en: The student outlined a neuroglial cell in the microscope drawing.
entries.zh: 学生在显微绘图中勾出了一个神经胶质细胞的轮廓。

entries.meaningZh: 新生儿颅内出血的缩写（neonatal intracranial hemorrhage，本例采用该医学义）
entries.en: The review compared imaging findings in infants with NICH.
entries.zh: 这篇综述比较了新生儿颅内出血患儿的影像学表现。

entries.meaningZh: （毒品俚语）价值五美元的一份毒品
entries.en: In the crime novel, the detective finds a nickel note in the suspect's coat pocket.
entries.zh: 那部犯罪小说中，侦探在嫌疑人的外套口袋里发现了一份价值五美元的毒品。

entries.meaningZh: 夜间鸣叫的鸟的旧称或文学称呼；不限定为渡鸦
entries.en: In the poem, a night raven breaks the silence outside the ruined tower.
entries.zh: 诗中，一只夜间鸣叫的鸟打破了废塔外的寂静。

entries.meaningZh: 天主教出版审查中表示未发现教义或道德方面妨碍的认可或声明（本例义）
entries.en: The title page carried a nihil obstat dated several years before the reprint.
entries.zh: 扉页上印有一项教会审查认可，日期比此次重印早了好几年。

entries.meaningZh: 亚硝化细菌；把氨或有关含氨化合物氧化为亚硝酸盐的细菌类群
entries.en: The researchers measured nitrite production by nitrous bacteria in the soil samples.
entries.zh: 研究人员测量了土壤样本中亚硝化细菌产生的亚硝酸盐量。

entries.meaningZh: 热带种甘蔗（Saccharum officinarum）；通常具有粗壮、多汁、高糖的茎
entries.en: The noble cane in the trial plot had thick, juicy stems.
entries.zh: 试验地里的Saccharum officinarum甘蔗长着粗壮、多汁的茎。

entries.meaningZh: 不抗辩答辩；刑事被告不争辩指控、接受相应裁判处罚的答辩（法律术语）
entries.en: The transcript records a plea of nolo contendere rather than a plea of not guilty.
entries.zh: 庭审记录记载的是不抗辩答辩，而不是无罪答辩。

entries.meaningZh: 嗜眠性脑炎的旧称（nona）
entries.en: The historian found several cases recorded as nona in the old hospital register.
entries.zh: 历史学家在旧医院登记册里发现了数例记作嗜眠性脑炎的病例。

entries.meaningZh: 不可由发行人任意提前赎回的债券；发行人在约定保护期间没有此类赎回权
entries.en: The issuer could not redeem the noncallable bond early merely because interest rates had fallen.
entries.zh: 发行人不能仅仅因为利率下降，就提前赎回这只不可提前赎回的债券。

entries.meaningZh: Circus hudsonius；本例取现行分类中的北美鹞类猛禽，不与欧亚白尾鹞混同
entries.en: A northern harrier flew low across the marsh at dusk.
entries.zh: 黄昏时，一只Circus hudsonius贴着沼泽低飞。

entries.meaningZh: 历史上将Icterus galbula与Icterus bullockii合并时使用的鸟名；现已重新区分两种
entries.en: The 1980 field notebook records a northern oriole in the cottonwoods by the river.
entries.zh: 1980年的野外笔记记载，河边的杨树上出现过一只当时合称为northern oriole的鸟。

entries.meaningZh: 俯冲；飞机机头向下的急降动作
entries.en: The pilot pulled the aircraft out of a nose dive above the sea.
entries.zh: 飞行员在海面上方把飞机从俯冲状态中拉了起来。

entries.meaningZh: （口语）好啦；用于温和制止或劝慰的话
entries.en: 'Now, now, there's no need to shout,' the teacher said.
entries.zh: “好啦，好啦，没必要大喊大叫，”老师说。

entries.meaningZh: Ginglymostoma cirratum；一种常在暖海浅水底部活动的鲨鱼，非grey nurse shark沙锥齿鲨
entries.en: A nurse shark rested on the sandy bottom beneath the pier.
entries.zh: 一条Ginglymostoma cirratum鲨鱼卧在码头下的沙底上。

entries.meaningZh: （俚语、贬义）精神病院；本例报告并批评这一侮辱性称呼
entries.en: The film's narrator calls the hospital a nut house, a label the review criticises as insulting.
entries.zh: 影片的叙述者把医院称作“疯人院”，影评批评这一称呼带有侮辱性。

entries.meaningZh: 北美若干结可食松子的pinyon松类；不专指瑞士五针松
entries.en: Nut pines dotted the dry hillside above the village.
entries.zh: 村庄上方干燥的山坡上，点缀着一株株结松子的pinyon松。

entries.meaningZh: Pelargonium odoratissimum；叶片芳香的一种天竺葵属植物（本例义）
entries.en: The nutmeg geranium released a scent when she brushed against its leaves.
entries.zh: 她碰到那株Pelargonium odoratissimum的叶子时，叶片散发出了一股香气。

entries.meaningZh: 眼斑吐绶鸡（Meleagris ocellata，旧名Agriocharis ocellata）
entries.en: The ocellated turkey's tail feathers caught the light as it turned.
entries.zh: 那只眼斑吐绶鸡转身时，尾羽映出了光彩。

entries.meaningZh: 八位组；由八个二进制位组成的单位（本例为计算机义）
entries.en: In this format, the first octet records the message type.
entries.zh: 在这种格式中，第一个八位组记录消息类型。

entries.meaningZh: 古怪的人；行为或习惯与旁人不同的家伙（本例为普通人物义）
entries.en: The new caretaker was an odd fellow who collected broken clocks and named every stray cat.
entries.zh: 新来的看门人是个古怪家伙，既搜集坏钟，又给每只流浪猫取名字。

entries.meaningZh: 油芫菁类甲虫；本例指Meloe属甲虫，可从足关节渗出油状防御液
entries.en: The oil beetle crawled slowly across the sandy track.
entries.zh: 那只Meloe属芫菁慢慢爬过沙质小路。

entries.meaningZh: Pyrularia pubera灌木的油质核果，亦称buffalo nut（本例为特定植物的果实义）
entries.en: The oil nut lay among fallen leaves beneath the shrub.
entries.zh: 灌木下的落叶间，躺着一枚Pyrularia pubera的核果。

entries.meaningZh: 世代传承的家族财富；老牌富裕家族的祖传财富
entries.en: Much of the town's old money was tied up in land rather than cash.
entries.zh: 镇上那些老牌富裕家族的财富大多在土地上，而不是现金。

entries.meaningZh: 在它上面；在所指事物上（本例为方位状语用法）
entries.en: There was an empty table, so I set my bag on it.
entries.zh: 有张空桌子，我便把包放在了上面。

entries.meaningZh: 保持警觉的；留心戒备的
entries.en: After the first alarm, even the sleepiest crew member remained on the qui vive.
entries.zh: 第一次警报过后，连最困倦的船员也一直保持警觉。

entries.meaningZh: 在巡回演出中；在不同地点依次进行相关演出等活动
entries.en: The quartet rehearsed a new piece while on tour in Spain.
entries.zh: 那个四重奏乐团在西班牙巡演期间排练了一首新曲。

entries.meaningZh: 一次性活动或尝试；只发生或进行一次的事（本例义）
entries.en: The workshop was a one-shot, rather than the start of a regular course.
entries.zh: 那次工作坊只是一次性活动，并不是常规课程的开端。

entries.meaningZh: 有一次；在某一个时候
entries.en: One time, we missed the last bus and walked home under the stars.
entries.zh: 有一次，我们错过了末班车，便披着星光走回家。

entries.meaningZh: 帕尔马，西班牙马略卡岛上的港口城市（Palma）
entries.en: By the time we reached Palma, the harbor lights had come on.
entries.zh: 我们抵达帕尔马时，港口的灯已经亮了。

entries.meaningZh: 帕洛阿尔托研究中心的简称（Palo Alto Research Center）
entries.en: The researcher spent a summer working with a team at PARC.
entries.zh: 这名研究人员用一个夏天与帕洛阿尔托研究中心的一个团队合作。

entries.meaningZh: 乌羽玉，一种小型、无刺、近球形的仙人掌（Lophophora williamsii）
entries.en: The botanical illustration showed peyote from above and from the side.
entries.zh: 植物学插图展示了乌羽玉的俯视图和侧视图。

entries.meaningZh: 多项描记器绘出的记录图；多种生理变化的描记图
entries.en: The technician marked the interruption on the polygram before filing it.
entries.zh: 技术员在归档前，先在多项生理描记图上标出了记录中断的位置。

entries.meaningZh: 压强；单位面积受到的力（本例指实际压力大小，非声压级）
entries.en: The pressure level in the chamber rose steadily during the test.
entries.zh: 测试过程中，腔室内的压强持续上升。

entries.meaningZh: 哄抬价格；利用消费者缺少替代选择而索取过高价格的行为
entries.en: Residents accused the only shop still open after the storm of price gouging.
entries.zh: 风暴过后，居民指责唯一仍在营业的商店哄抬价格。

entries.meaningZh: Pinus pungens；美国阿巴拉契亚山区的一种松树，球果鳞片有刺尖
entries.en: The prickly pine's old cones remained attached to a twisted branch.
entries.zh: 那棵Pinus pungens的老球果仍挂在一根扭曲的枝条上。

entries.meaningZh: 素朴艺术；由未受正规艺术训练者创作的艺术（本例取该词典义）
entries.en: The gallery's room on primitive art featured carvings by self-taught artists.
entries.zh: 画廊的素朴艺术展室中，陈列着自学成才的创作者雕刻的作品。

entries.meaningZh: 简约原则；解释现象时避免引入不必要假设或实体的原则（奥卡姆剃刀）
entries.en: The researcher invoked the principle of parsimony when choosing between the two explanations.
entries.zh: 研究人员在两种解释之间作选择时，援引了简约原则。

entries.meaningZh: 相对性原理；本例指物理学规律不因惯性参考系的匀速直线运动而改变的原理
entries.en: The lecturer used a smoothly moving train to introduce the principle of relativity.
entries.zh: 讲师用一列平稳行驶的火车，引入了相对性原理。

entries.meaningZh: 按总体各层比例抽取的分层样本；比例分层样本
entries.en: The team drew a proportional sample so that each year group made up the same share of the sample as of the school.
entries.zh: 团队抽取了一个按比例分层的样本，使各年级在样本中所占比例与其在全校中所占比例一致。

entries.meaningZh: 公共部门借款需求的缩写（public sector borrowing requirement，英国历史财政统计术语）
entries.en: The economist compared the PSBR with the figures in the previous budget.
entries.zh: 这名经济学家将公共部门借款需求与上一次预算中的数字作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 翼突；蝶骨向下伸出的骨性突起
entries.en: The student located the pterygoid process on the skull model before answering the question.
entries.zh: 学生回答问题前，先在颅骨模型上找到了翼突。

entries.meaningZh: 主要依靠公众支持的慈善组织
entries.en: The public charity depended on hundreds of small donations to keep its shelter open.
entries.zh: 那家主要依靠公众支持的慈善组织，需要数百笔小额捐款才能维持收容所运营。

entries.meaningZh: 公开披露；把问题或主题公诸于众、供公众讨论
entries.en: Public exposure of the proposal led to a lively debate at the town meeting.
entries.zh: 提案公开后，在镇民大会上引发了热烈讨论。

entries.meaningZh: 膨化米；经膨化而变松脆的米粒
entries.en: She scattered puffed rice over the melted chocolate and left the tray to cool.
entries.zh: 她把膨化米撒在融化的巧克力上，然后把托盘放在一旁冷却。

entries.meaningZh: 叫停；终止或阻止某项活动继续（惯用语）
entries.en: The council decided to pull the plug on the festival after its main sponsor withdrew.
entries.zh: 主要赞助商退出后，议会决定叫停那场节庆活动。

entries.meaningZh: 体外射精法；在射精前撤出的避孕做法
entries.en: The questionnaire listed pulling out separately from condom use.
entries.zh: 问卷把体外射精法与使用安全套分列为不同选项。

entries.meaningZh: 拟八哥（Quiscalus quiscula）；本例取purple grackle的鸟类义
entries.en: A purple grackle landed on the wet lawn and began probing for food.
entries.zh: 一只Quiscalus quiscula拟八哥落在湿草坪上，开始探寻食物。

entries.meaningZh: 钱袋抽绳；用于束紧钱袋开口的绳子
entries.en: The purse string had snapped, spilling a handful of coins onto the path.
entries.zh: 钱袋抽绳断了，一把硬币撒在小路上。

entries.meaningZh: 给……施麻醉；使……进入麻醉状态（口语）
entries.en: The anaesthetist explained how she would put the patient under before the operation.
entries.zh: 麻醉师解释了她将在手术前如何让患者进入麻醉状态。

entries.meaningZh: 欧洲山杨（Populus tremula）；quaking aspen的一个旧大陆树种义
entries.en: The European quaking aspen in the arboretum had begun to turn yellow.
entries.zh: 树木园里的那棵欧洲山杨（Populus tremula）已经开始变黄。

entries.meaningZh: 感质；某一种主观体验所特有的感受性质（qualia 的单数，哲学与心理学用语）
entries.en: The philosopher used the bitterness of coffee as an example of a quale.
entries.zh: 哲学家以咖啡的苦味作为一种感质的例子。

entries.meaningZh: 生活质量；对自身生活状况的满意程度（本例取主观体验义）
entries.en: Having time for music and friends improved her quality of life.
entries.zh: 有时间欣赏音乐、与朋友相处，让她的生活质量提高了。

entries.meaningZh: 类似的；具有某些相似特征的；准的
entries.en: The exchange group evolved into a quasi library, complete with handwritten loan records.
entries.zh: 这个交换小组成了一种类似图书馆的组织，还备有手写的借阅记录。

entries.meaningZh: 槲皮素；一种黄酮醇类化合物
entries.en: The analysis measured quercetin separately from its glycosides.
entries.zh: 这项分析分别测定了槲皮素及其糖苷。

entries.meaningZh: 警戒状态；高度警觉（常用于on the qui vive）
entries.en: The unexpected knock put everyone on the qui vive.
entries.zh: 突如其来的敲门声，让所有人都警觉起来。

entries.meaningZh: Agropyron repens（词典所用学名）；靠匍匐根茎迅速蔓延的一种禾草
entries.en: Quick grass had sent new shoots through the edge of the vegetable bed.
entries.zh: 那种Agropyron repens已经从菜畦边缘钻出了新的枝芽。

entries.meaningZh: 帝王鲑（Oncorhynchus tshawytscha，亦称chinook salmon）
entries.en: A quinnat salmon specimen lay on the measuring board beside the biologist's notebook.
entries.zh: 一条帝王鲑标本放在量鱼板上，旁边是生物学家的笔记本。

entries.meaningZh: 槽隔圆凸线脚；以窄槽与相邻装饰面分开的圆凸线饰
entries.en: A thin layer of paint had filled the groove beside the quirk bead.
entries.zh: 一层薄薄的油漆填进了圆凸线脚旁的窄槽。

entries.meaningZh: 带槽线脚；具有小凹槽的装饰线条
entries.en: The joiner used a small brush to clean dust from the quirk molding.
entries.zh: 木工用一把小刷子清理带槽线脚里的灰尘。

entries.meaningZh: 带槽线脚；具有小凹槽的装饰线条（英式拼写）
entries.en: The replacement quirk moulding matched the groove on the old door frame.
entries.zh: 新换的带槽线脚与旧门框上的槽形相配。

entries.meaningZh: Chrysothamnus nauseosus（词典所用学名）；美国西部开密集黄花的芳香灌木
entries.en: The rabbit brush beside the fence was covered in small yellow flowers.
entries.zh: 篱笆旁那株Chrysothamnus nauseosus开满了小黄花。

entries.meaningZh: 貉（Nyctereutes procyonoides）；面部有类似浣熊斑纹的犬科动物
entries.en: The raccoon dog paused at the edge of the reeds and sniffed the air.
entries.zh: 那只貉在芦苇边停下来，嗅了嗅空气。

entries.meaningZh: 单人赛艇；由一名划手操纵的狭长竞赛艇（本例取single shell义）
entries.en: The racing skiff slipped away from the landing stage with a single rower aboard.
entries.zh: 那艘单人赛艇载着一名划手，轻轻滑离了登船台。

entries.meaningZh: 竞赛用游艇；本例指参加比赛的帆船
entries.en: The racing yacht heeled sharply as it rounded the buoy.
entries.zh: 那艘竞赛帆船绕过浮标时，船身明显倾斜。

entries.meaningZh: 英国皇家戏剧艺术学院的简称（Royal Academy of Dramatic Art，本例采用该院校义）
entries.en: She practised her audition pieces before applying to RADA.
entries.zh: 她在申请英国皇家戏剧艺术学院之前练习了试镜片段。

entries.meaningZh: 桡静脉；前臂桡侧伴行桡动脉的静脉
entries.en: The anatomy tutor highlighted the radial vein on a diagram of the forearm.
entries.zh: 解剖学导师在前臂示意图上突出标出了桡静脉。

entries.meaningZh: 散热器格栅；让冷却空气通往汽车散热器的栅状部件
entries.en: A small dent in the radiator grille was the only visible damage to the car.
entries.zh: 散热器格栅上的一处小凹痕，是那辆车唯一看得见的损伤。

entries.meaningZh: Lychnis flos-cuculi（词典所用学名）；通常开粉红色深裂花瓣的一种多年生草本
entries.en: The ragged robin's pink flowers nodded above the wet grass.
entries.zh: 那株Lychnis flos-cuculi的粉红花朵在湿草上方轻轻摇动。

entries.meaningZh: 插肩袖；袖片延伸至领口、袖缝斜向领部的袖型
entries.en: The jacket's raglan sleeve gave him room to reach for the top shelf.
entries.zh: 那件夹克的插肩袖让他有足够的活动空间，伸手够到最高一层架子。

entries.meaningZh: 铁路车辆；行驶在铁轨上的车厢或车辆
entries.en: The empty railroad car rolled slowly into the repair shed.
entries.zh: 那节空铁路车厢缓缓驶入了维修库。
