entries.meaningZh: 苹果实蝇（Rhagoletis pomonella）的幼虫；railroad worm的一个虫名义
entries.en: The railroad worm left a brown tunnel through the apple's flesh.
entries.zh: 那条苹果实蝇幼虫在苹果果肉中留下了一道褐色虫道。

entries.meaningZh: Echinocereus rigidissimus；具有彩色密刺的柱状仙人掌
entries.en: A rainbow cactus stood on the sunny shelf beside a row of clay pots.
entries.zh: 一株Echinocereus rigidissimus摆在向阳的架子上，旁边是一排陶盆。

entries.meaningZh: 孔雀鱼（旧词典学名Lebistes reticulatus）；rainbow fish的一个淡水鱼义
entries.en: A male rainbow fish trailed his patterned tail through the water.
entries.zh: 一条雄性孔雀鱼拖着花纹鲜艳的尾巴，在水中游动。

entries.meaningZh: 彩虹胡瓜鱼（Osmerus mordax）；北美的一种胡瓜鱼
entries.en: The rainbow smelt specimen was kept on ice until the biologist could examine it.
entries.zh: 那条彩虹胡瓜鱼标本一直保存在冰上，等待生物学家检查。

entries.meaningZh: 非正式讨论小组；聚在一起作坦率交流的一组人（本例取讨论会义）
entries.en: The rap group met in the common room to talk about the pressures of university life.
entries.zh: 那个非正式讨论小组在公共休息室碰面，谈论大学生活带来的压力。

entries.meaningZh: 快速眼动睡眠；以眼球快速运动等为特征的一种睡眠阶段（REM睡眠）
entries.en: The sleep record showed several periods of rapid eye movement sleep.
entries.zh: 睡眠记录中出现了几段快速眼动睡眠。

entries.meaningZh: 按份配给；定量分发
entries.en: The team leader had to ration out the remaining batteries.
entries.zh: 队长不得不按份配给剩下的电池。

entries.meaningZh: Botrychium virginianum；孢子囊成簇、形似响尾蛇尾部的一种蕨类
entries.en: The guide pointed out a rattlesnake fern among the fallen leaves.
entries.zh: 向导指出了落叶间的一株Botrychium virginianum。

entries.meaningZh: Eryngium yuccifolium；一种具刺叶的多年生刺芹属植物
entries.en: The rattlesnake master stood above the shorter plants in the prairie display.
entries.zh: 草原植物展示区中，那株Eryngium yuccifolium高出周围较矮的植物。

entries.meaningZh: 原毛；未经精炼或加工的羊毛
entries.en: The mill bought raw wool from three nearby farms.
entries.zh: 那家工厂从附近的三个农场收购了未经加工的羊毛。

entries.meaningZh: （马等）抬起前腿、以后腿站立而向后仰起
entries.en: The pony began to rear back when the umbrella opened.
entries.zh: 雨伞一撑开，小马就开始抬起前腿、以后腿站立。

entries.meaningZh: 隐性等位基因
entries.en: The worksheet represented the recessive allele with a lowercase letter.
entries.zh: 练习单用一个小写字母表示隐性等位基因。

entries.meaningZh: 充电器；为可充电电池补充电能的装置
entries.en: The recharger stopped working after the cable came loose.
entries.zh: 电缆松脱后，充电器停止了工作。

entries.meaningZh: 反复发生的事件；隔一段时间再次出现的事情
entries.en: Flooding had become a recurrent event in the riverside village.
entries.zh: 在那个河边村庄，洪水已成了反复发生的事。

entries.meaningZh: 红山姜（Alpinia purpurata）；一种观赏姜科植物
entries.en: The florist added a stalk of red ginger to the arrangement.
entries.zh: 花艺师在插花作品中加入了一枝红山姜。

entries.meaningZh: Mullus auratus；一种体色鲜红、体侧有浅色条纹的羊鱼科海鱼
entries.en: The diver watched a red goatfish move slowly over the pale sand.
entries.zh: 潜水者看着一条Mullus auratus在浅色沙底上缓缓游过。

entries.meaningZh: 热狗；夹在面包里热食的法兰克福香肠（red hot的食物义）
entries.en: He bought a red hot from the stand outside the station.
entries.zh: 他从车站外的小摊买了一个热狗。

entries.meaningZh: 北美圆柏（Juniperus virginiana，亦称eastern red cedar）；red juniper的一个树种义
entries.en: The red juniper sheltered several small birds during the snowstorm.
entries.zh: 暴风雪中，那棵Juniperus virginiana为几只小鸟提供了庇护。

entries.meaningZh: （旧时、冒犯性称谓）北美原住民；带种族歧视意味的旧称
entries.en: The editor removed the phrase 'red man' from the modernized text because it was an offensive label.
entries.zh: 编辑从现代化改写的文本中删去了“red man”这个说法，因为它是一个冒犯性的称谓。

entries.meaningZh: Abies amabilis；北美西部的一种冷杉（亦称Pacific silver fir）
entries.en: A red silver fir towered above the low fog in the valley.
entries.zh: 山谷里，一棵Abies amabilis高高地耸出低雾。

entries.meaningZh: Lutjanus campechanus；北美大西洋及墨西哥湾的一种笛鲷（本例取该种鱼义）
entries.en: A red snapper swam slowly past the reef's outer edge.
entries.zh: 一条Lutjanus campechanus缓缓游过礁石外缘。

entries.meaningZh: 玫瑰茄（Hibiscus sabdariffa）；red sorrel的一个木槿属植物义
entries.en: The gardener collected the fleshy red calyxes from the red sorrel.
entries.zh: 园丁从那株玫瑰茄上采下了肥厚的红色花萼。

entries.meaningZh: 红蚯蚓；red worm的土栖蚯蚓义（非水生摇蚊幼虫）
entries.en: A red worm curled up as she lifted the damp leaf litter.
entries.zh: 她掀开潮湿的落叶层时，一条红蚯蚓蜷缩了起来。

entries.meaningZh: 重新进入；再次参加（本例为再次进入场所义）
entries.en: After the alarm stopped, staff were allowed to reenter the building.
entries.zh: 警报停止后，工作人员获准重新进入大楼。

entries.meaningZh: 参考书；供查阅可靠事实或资料的工具书
entries.en: The librarian kept the reference work behind the desk because several maps were loose.
entries.zh: 那部参考书里的几幅地图已经松脱，图书管理员便把它放在借阅台后。

entries.meaningZh: 垃圾收集工；受雇收集、处理垃圾的人
entries.en: The refuse collector returned the empty bin to the pavement.
entries.zh: 垃圾收集工把空垃圾桶放回了人行道上。

entries.meaningZh: 收费出借藏书；图书馆等供读者付费租借的一批图书
entries.en: The library's rental collection included several new crime novels.
entries.zh: 图书馆的收费出借藏书中，有几本新出的犯罪小说。

entries.meaningZh: 代表性抽样；旨在使样本反映总体特征的抽样（本例为抽样目标义，不限定一种设计）
entries.en: The report stressed representative sampling so that rural residents would not be overlooked.
entries.zh: 报告强调要进行能反映总体情况的抽样，以免忽视农村居民。

entries.meaningZh: 科研场所；开展研究的中心或基地
entries.en: The research facility had space for two laboratories and a shared workshop.
entries.zh: 那处科研场所可容纳两个实验室和一间共用工作间。

entries.meaningZh: 电阻单位；衡量电阻的单位（本例取欧姆）
entries.en: The chart labels the ohm as the resistance unit.
entries.zh: 图表把欧姆标为电阻单位。

entries.meaningZh: 含类维生素A物质的；由类维生素A物质衍生的（如 retinoic acid，维甲酸）
entries.en: The research assistant checked the label on the vial of retinoic acid.
entries.zh: 研究助理查看了那瓶维甲酸上的标签。

entries.meaningZh: 观叶秋海棠类；源自Begonia rex的一类杂交秋海棠
entries.en: The rex begonia's patterned leaves caught the light beside the window.
entries.zh: 窗边那株观叶秋海棠带花纹的叶片映着光。

entries.meaningZh: 犀金龟类；头部常具角状突起的大型甲虫（本例取类群义）
entries.en: The rhinoceros beetle clung to the bark, its curved horn silhouetted against the lamp.
entries.zh: 那只犀金龟紧贴树皮，弯曲的角状突起在灯光下显出轮廓。

entries.meaningZh: 以米发酵酿成的传统酒；本例指印度阿萨姆的米酿酒
entries.en: At the village feast in Assam, our host poured rice beer into small cups.
entries.zh: 阿萨姆的村宴上，主人把以米酿成的发酵酒倒进小杯里。

entries.meaningZh: 骑马等离去；骑着车或马离开
entries.en: They watched the courier mount his horse and ride off toward the hills.
entries.zh: 他们看着信使跨上马，骑马朝山地远去。

entries.meaningZh: （老式俚语，表示赞同）说得对；好极了
entries.en: "Right on!" Maya said when the group agreed to make the event free.
entries.zh: 小组同意让活动免费后，玛雅说：“太好了！”

entries.meaningZh: 筑路者；从事道路建设的人
entries.en: The road builder inspected the damaged culvert before work resumed.
entries.zh: 施工恢复前，那名筑路人员检查了受损的涵洞。

entries.meaningZh: 烤猪肉；经烘烤制成的猪肉菜肴（本例取熟食义）
entries.en: The roast pork was sliced at the table and served with potatoes.
entries.zh: 烤猪肉在餐桌旁切片，配土豆一起上桌。

entries.meaningZh: 欧亚鸲（Erithacus rubecula，亦称European robin）；红胸的小型鸣禽
entries.en: A robin redbreast followed the gardener along the freshly turned border.
entries.zh: 一只欧亚鸲跟着园丁，沿着刚翻过土的花境移动。

entries.meaningZh: Erigeron pulchellus；北美东部开紫色舌状花的一种多年生飞蓬属植物
entries.en: The robin's plantain formed a loose patch beneath the birch trees.
entries.zh: 那种Erigeron pulchellus在桦树下疏疏落落地长成了一小片。

entries.meaningZh: 岩生小蕨；本例取矮小、落叶、附生于岩石上的蕨类义
entries.en: A rock brake grew from a narrow cleft above the stream.
entries.zh: 溪流上方的一条窄石缝里，长着一株岩生小蕨。

entries.meaningZh: 刺龙虾；没有大型螯足、甲壳多刺的海生龙虾类（本例指活体）
entries.en: The rock lobster backed into a crevice, leaving its long antennae exposed.
entries.zh: 那只刺龙虾倒退着钻进石缝，长长的触角仍露在外面。

entries.meaningZh: 欧洲石鸡（Alectoris graeca）；南欧山区的一种鹑鸡类鸟
entries.en: A rock partridge called from the scree above the walking trail.
entries.zh: 徒步小径上方的碎石坡里，传来了一只欧洲石鸡的叫声。

entries.meaningZh: Talinum calycinum（词典所用学名）；美国西部岩地开粉红花的一种多年生植物
entries.en: The rock pink opened a few pink flowers between the stones.
entries.zh: 那株Talinum calycinum在石头间开出了几朵粉红色小花。

entries.meaningZh: 非洲岩蟒（Python sebae）；rock snake的一个大型蟒蛇义
entries.en: The rock snake lay coiled beneath a fallen tree, almost hidden by the shadows.
entries.zh: 那条非洲岩蟒盘在倒木下，几乎被阴影遮住。

entries.meaningZh: 北美岩地的一种大型地松鼠（词典旧名Citellus variegatus）；本例指美国西南的岩地松鼠
entries.en: The rock squirrel sat upright on a boulder, watching the walkers below.
entries.zh: 那只北美岩地松鼠直起身坐在巨石上，望着下方的行人。

entries.meaningZh: 视杆细胞；对弱光敏感的视网膜感光细胞
entries.en: The diagram showed a rod cell beside a cone cell in the retina.
entries.zh: 示意图在视网膜部分并列画出了一个视杆细胞和一个视锥细胞。

entries.meaningZh: Macrodactylus subspinosus；北美的一种鳃金龟，成虫取食蔷薇等植物的叶和花
entries.en: A rose bug crawled across a damaged rose petal.
entries.zh: 一只Macrodactylus subspinosus正从一片受损的玫瑰花瓣上爬过。

entries.meaningZh: Lychnis coronaria（词典所用学名）；具银白绒毛叶、开鲜红花的庭园草本
entries.en: The rose campion's bright flowers rose above a mound of silvery leaves.
entries.zh: 那株Lychnis coronaria鲜艳的花朵，开在一丛银白色叶片上方。

entries.meaningZh: 大花马齿苋（Portulaca grandiflora）；rose moss的开花植物义
entries.en: The rose moss opened a line of bright flowers along the sunny path.
entries.zh: 向阳的小路边，那些大花马齿苋开出了一排鲜艳的花朵。

entries.meaningZh: 旋翼头；旋翼中心的连接、支承组件（本例取自转旋翼机的旋翼头义）
entries.en: The instructor pointed to the rotor head on the gyroplane model.
entries.zh: 教员指了指自转旋翼机模型上的旋翼头。

entries.meaningZh: 毛脚鵟（Buteo lagopus）；rough-legged hawk的本例鸟种义
entries.en: The rough-legged hawk hovered over the winter pasture before dropping toward the ground.
entries.zh: 那只毛脚鵟在冬日牧场上空悬停，随后朝地面俯冲。

entries.meaningZh: 形状近圆的骨头；本例取描述形状的名词短语义
entries.en: The small round bone had been placed in a separate compartment of the display.
entries.zh: 那块小小的圆形骨头，被放在展柜中单独的格子里。

entries.meaningZh: 搜寻后找到；翻找出
entries.en: I managed to rout up the missing receipt from a box of old papers.
entries.zh: 我翻找了一箱旧文件，总算找出了那张遗失的收据。

entries.meaningZh: 凯撒鹅膏（Amanita caesarea）；鹅膏属的一种蘑菇（本例取该种义）
entries.en: The mycologist's sketch of a royal agaric included the cap, stem and base.
entries.zh: 真菌学家画的凯撒鹅膏素描，包括菌盖、菌柄和基部。

entries.meaningZh: （较少见）温习；使记忆恢复的复习（名词）
entries.en: A short rub-up on the scoring rules helped her enjoy the match.
entries.zh: 简短温习了一遍计分规则后，她看比赛更有兴致了。

entries.meaningZh: 薇拉·鲁宾（Vera Rubin，研究星系运动的天文学家）
entries.en: The students redrew Rubin's galaxy-rotation curves before discussing dark matter.
entries.zh: 学生们重新绘制了鲁宾的星系旋转曲线，然后讨论暗物质。

entries.meaningZh: ruin的旧拼写：毁灭、败落（早期现代英语文献用法）
entries.en: In the historical novel, another war brings the once-rich city to ruine.
entries.zh: 历史小说里，又一场战争使这座昔日富庶的城市走向毁灭。

entries.meaningZh: 出走；未经允许离开本应待着的地方（本例为离家出走）
entries.en: The counsellor listened as the teenager explained his reasons for running away.
entries.zh: 辅导员听那名青少年解释自己离家出走的原因。

entries.meaningZh: （汽车门下的）踏脚板；供上下车踩踏的窄板
entries.en: He wiped the mud off his boots on the old truck's running board.
entries.zh: 他在老卡车的踏脚板上蹭掉了靴子上的泥。

entries.meaningZh: （美式橄榄球）跑球进攻；持球向前推进的进攻打法
entries.en: Their running game improved after the offensive line began creating more space.
entries.zh: 进攻线开始创造更多空间后，他们的跑球进攻也有了起色。

entries.meaningZh: 跑鞋；为跑步设计的轻便鞋
entries.en: She found a pebble inside her left running shoe.
entries.zh: 她在左脚那只跑鞋里发现了一颗小石子。

entries.meaningZh: 电动曲线锯；装有往复运动锯条的便携式电锯（本例取jigsaw义）
entries.en: The carpenter put the saber saw back in its case after finishing the curved panel.
entries.zh: 做完弧形板件后，木匠把电动曲线锯放回工具箱。

entries.meaningZh: 安全门闩；不能从门的外侧拨动的门闩
entries.en: The safety bolt on the garden gate was stiff with rust.
entries.zh: 花园门上的安全门闩生了锈，推起来很涩。

entries.meaningZh: 安全剃须刀；带有护挡的剃须刀（指整件工具）
entries.en: He packed his safety razor in a small case for the journey.
entries.zh: 他把安全剃须刀装进一个小盒子里，准备旅途使用。

entries.meaningZh: 向下凹陷；下垂（本例取不及物用法）
entries.en: The canvas began to sag down as rainwater gathered in the middle.
entries.zh: 雨水积在中间，帆布开始向下凹陷。

entries.meaningZh: 北美蒿类灌木；sagebrush 所指的若干种蒿属灌木
entries.en: Low sagebrush covered the dry slope above the camp.
entries.zh: 营地上方干燥的坡地上长满了低矮的蒿类灌木。

entries.meaningZh: Poterium sanguisorba（词典所用学名）；叶可作沙拉配料的园艺草本
entries.en: The gardener planted salad burnet beside the low stone wall.
entries.zh: 园丁在矮石墙旁种下了那种Poterium sanguisorba草本植物。

entries.meaningZh: 销售金融公司；折价购入零售商分期付款销售合同的融资公司
entries.en: The sales finance company reviewed the retailer's batch of instalment contracts.
entries.zh: 那家销售金融公司审核了零售商提交的一批分期付款销售合同。

entries.meaningZh: 盐豆木（Halimodendron halodendron）；里海盐碱地及西伯利亚的一种具刺灌木
entries.en: A salt tree's silvery young leaves stood out against the dry brown ground.
entries.zh: 那株盐豆木银灰色的嫩叶，在干褐色地面衬托下格外醒目。

entries.meaningZh: Allium scorodoprasum；欧洲的一种葱属植物（词典中的sand leek义）
entries.en: The gardener marked the sand leek with a separate label in the Allium bed.
entries.zh: 园丁在葱属植物花坛里，为那株Allium scorodoprasum插上了一块单独的标牌。

entries.meaningZh: Leiophyllum buxifolium（词典所用学名）；北美东部开白花的低矮常绿灌木
entries.en: The sand myrtle was dotted with small white flowers along the edge of the path.
entries.zh: 小路边，那株Leiophyllum buxifolium点缀着许多小白花。

entries.meaningZh: 望星鱼科（Dactyloscopidae）的小型海鱼；眼位于头顶、常埋伏在沙中的鱼（本例指个体）
entries.en: The sand stargazer disappeared into the sand, leaving only its eyes exposed.
entries.zh: 那条望星鱼钻进沙里，只露出眼睛。

entries.meaningZh: Abronia属植物（花形似马鞭草，常生于沙地）
entries.en: Sand verbena had spread over the dune beside the wooden steps.
entries.zh: 木台阶旁的沙丘上长满了Abronia属的沙地植物。

entries.meaningZh: 三明治拼盘；配有佐食的三明治餐盘
entries.en: The sandwich plate came with pickles and a small portion of potato salad.
entries.zh: 三明治拼盘配有腌黄瓜和一小份土豆沙拉。

entries.meaningZh: 卫生填埋场；采用覆土等措施处置垃圾的填埋场地
entries.en: The council plans to monitor groundwater around the sanitary landfill for another decade.
entries.zh: 市政委员会计划再对卫生填埋场周围的地下水监测十年。

entries.meaningZh: 人心果（果实）
entries.en: She cut the sapodilla plum in half and scooped out its soft brown flesh.
entries.zh: 她把人心果切成两半，挖出柔软的褐色果肉。

entries.meaningZh: 叉子圆柏；沙地柏，Juniperus sabina（本例为植物义）
entries.en: The savin spread low across the rocky slope.
entries.zh: 那株叉子圆柏在多石的坡地上低矮地向四周伸展。

entries.meaningZh: 锯材原木；可锯成板材的原木
entries.en: A red mark on the saw log showed where the damaged wood began.
entries.zh: 锯材原木上的一道红色标记指出了受损木材开始的位置。

entries.meaningZh: 打鼾；呼呼大睡（口语）
entries.en: Dad began to saw logs before the opening credits had finished.
entries.zh: 片头字幕还没放完，爸爸就开始呼呼打鼾了。

entries.meaningZh: 红花槭；红槭（Acer rubrum）
entries.en: The scarlet maple outside the library was the first tree on the street to change colour.
entries.zh: 图书馆外的红花槭是这条街上最先变色的树。

entries.meaningZh: 爵士拟声即兴演唱；用无意义音节模仿乐器的唱法
entries.en: During the scat singing, the pianist answered each of the vocalist's improvised phrases.
entries.zh: 在爵士拟声即兴演唱中，钢琴手对歌手即兴唱出的每个乐句都作出了呼应。

entries.meaningZh: 学校附近供学生通行的人行横道
entries.en: A delivery van had stopped directly in front of the school crossing.
entries.zh: 一辆送货车正停在学校附近供学生通行的人行横道前。

entries.meaningZh: 低手挑篮；以向上舀起的动作完成的投篮
entries.en: He slipped past the defender and finished with a scoop shot under the outstretched arm.
entries.zh: 他突破防守队员，从对方伸出的手臂下完成了一记低手挑篮。

entries.meaningZh: 角鸮；具有耳羽簇的小型猫头鹰
entries.en: A scops owl peered out from the hollow trunk as we passed below.
entries.zh: 我们从树下经过时，一只角鸮正从空心树干里向外张望。

entries.meaningZh: 童军团体；童军的组织单位
entries.en: Our scout group raised enough money to replace the leaking tents.
entries.zh: 我们童军团体筹到了足够的钱，可以更换那些漏雨的帐篷。

entries.meaningZh: 羊颈瘦肉端；羊颈端肉（英式用语）
entries.en: The butcher suggested using scrag end for the slow-cooked lamb stew.
entries.zh: 肉贩建议用羊颈端肉来做慢炖羊肉。

entries.meaningZh: 灌木状矮栎；矮小丛生的栎类
entries.en: Beyond the fence, scrub oak formed a dense barrier along the dry hillside.
entries.zh: 围栏外，灌木状矮栎沿着干燥的山坡形成了一道浓密的屏障。

entries.meaningZh: 弗吉尼亚松（Pinus virginiana）
entries.en: A young scrub pine had taken root in the abandoned field.
entries.zh: 一棵幼小的弗吉尼亚松在荒废的田地里扎了根。

entries.meaningZh: 把……揉皱；把……挤成一团
entries.en: Don't scrunch up the tissue paper; we can use it to wrap the vase.
entries.zh: 别把薄纸揉成一团，我们可以用它包花瓶。

entries.meaningZh: 海滨生菊科草本植物（Leptosyne maritima，旧名Coreopsis maritima）
entries.en: A sea dahlia was flowering beside the coastal path, its yellow heads bright against the grey rocks.
entries.zh: 一株海滨生菊科植物Leptosyne maritima正在海岸小径旁开花，黄色花头映衬着灰色岩石，十分醒目。

entries.meaningZh: 象海豹
entries.en: The male sea elephant raised his head as another male approached the beach.
entries.zh: 另一只雄性靠近海滩时，那只雄象海豹抬起了头。

entries.meaningZh: 补血草属植物（Limonium属）
entries.en: She hung the sea lavender upside down in the shed to dry its flower stems.
entries.zh: 她把补血草属植物倒挂在棚屋里，让花枝干燥。

entries.meaningZh: 八角鱼科的小型鱼；体表有骨板的海鱼
entries.en: The sea poacher in the photograph had rows of bony plates along its narrow body.
entries.zh: 照片里的那条八角鱼科小鱼，狭长身体上排列着一行行骨板。

entries.meaningZh: 某些鲨、鳐的角质卵囊
entries.en: An empty sea purse lay tangled in the seaweed above the waterline.
entries.zh: 一个空的鲨鳐角质卵囊缠在水线以上的海藻中。

entries.meaningZh: 浪涌后的向海暗流；海底回流（旧称）
entries.en: The old coastal survey describes a sea puss beneath the breaking waves.
entries.zh: 那份旧海岸调查记述了碎浪下方的一股向海暗流。

entries.meaningZh: 海蛞蝓；裸鳃类海生腹足软体动物
entries.en: The diver photographed a brightly coloured sea slug crawling across the rock.
entries.zh: 潜水员拍下了一只色彩鲜艳、正在岩石上爬行的海蛞蝓。

entries.meaningZh: 海蜘蛛；皆足类海生节肢动物
entries.en: Under the magnifying lens, the sea spider's thin legs seemed much larger than its body.
entries.zh: 在放大镜下，那只海蜘蛛的细长腿显得比身体大得多。

entries.meaningZh: 留作播种的优质谷物种子
entries.en: The farmer kept the seed grain in a separate bin, away from the grain intended for milling.
entries.zh: 农民把留作播种的谷种存放在单独的仓箱里，与准备磨粉的谷物分开。

entries.meaningZh: 介形类小型甲壳动物；介形虫
entries.en: A seed shrimp moved between the grains of sand in the microscope's field of view.
entries.zh: 显微镜视野中，一只介形虫在沙粒之间移动。

entries.meaningZh: 留作种用的种子或块茎储备
entries.en: The cooperative distributed fresh seed stock after the flood ruined the stored tubers.
entries.zh: 洪水毁掉储存的块茎后，合作社分发了新的种用储备。

entries.meaningZh: 世嘉（SEGA），日本电子游戏公司的名称
entries.en: The developer applied for a programming role at SEGA.
entries.zh: 这名开发者申请了世嘉的一个编程职位。

entries.meaningZh: 自推进车辆；自带动力装置的车辆
entries.en: The cart is a self-propelled vehicle, but a driver still controls its speed and direction.
entries.zh: 这辆车自带动力装置，但速度和方向仍由驾驶员控制。

entries.meaningZh: 运动觉；感知肢体与身体运动的能力
entries.en: With her eyes closed, the dancer relied on her sense of movement to repeat the arm sequence.
entries.zh: 舞者闭着眼睛，依靠运动觉重复那组手臂动作。

entries.meaningZh: 测者地平圈；通过观测者眼睛、垂直于天顶—天底线的平面与天球相交形成的圆
entries.en: The instructor drew the sensible horizon at right angles to the observer's zenith–nadir line.
entries.zh: 教员画出了与观测者天顶—天底线垂直的测者地平圈。

entries.meaningZh: 维修人员上门检修；上门服务
entries.en: The first service call revealed that the washing machine needed a new pump.
entries.zh: 第一次上门检修发现，洗衣机需要更换水泵。

entries.meaningZh: 服务入口；供送货、工作人员等使用的入口
entries.en: The caterers brought the equipment through the service entrance behind the kitchen.
entries.zh: 餐饮服务人员从厨房后面的服务入口运进了设备。

entries.meaningZh: 维修工；检修人员
entries.en: The service man found a loose wire inside the boiler's control box.
entries.zh: 维修工在锅炉控制盒里发现了一根松动的电线。

entries.meaningZh: 家花楸（Sorbus domestica）；结可食果实的欧洲树木
entries.en: The nursery planted a service tree at the sunny edge of the orchard.
entries.zh: 苗圃在果园向阳的边缘种了一棵家花楸。

entries.meaningZh: 石工凿；用于切凿石块或砖块的窄钢凿
entries.en: A set chisel lay beside the mason's partly shaped stone block.
entries.zh: 一把石工凿放在石匠尚未修整完的石块旁。

entries.meaningZh: 绵羊虱蝇（Melophagus ovinus）；寄生于羊体表的无翅蝇
entries.en: The student identified the sheep ked as a wingless fly rather than a tick.
entries.zh: 学生辨认出绵羊虱蝇是一种无翅蝇，而不是蜱。

entries.meaningZh: 庇护工场；为残障人士提供就业的工作场所
entries.en: The sheltered workshop supplied the hotel with handwoven table mats.
entries.zh: 庇护工场向这家酒店供应手工编织的餐垫。

entries.meaningZh: 巴结；讨好（通常含不真诚之意）
entries.en: He tried to shine up to the director by praising every decision she made.
entries.zh: 他试图通过赞美主任的每一个决定来巴结她。

entries.meaningZh: 船上高级船员；担任管理职务的船员
entries.en: A ship's officer checked the cargo list before allowing the truck onto the ferry.
entries.zh: 一名船上高级船员核对了货物清单后，才让卡车驶上渡轮。

entries.meaningZh: 运输性肺炎；牛运输热相关的肺炎
entries.en: The veterinarian suspected shipping pneumonia in the calves that had arrived two days earlier.
entries.zh: 兽医怀疑两天前运来的小牛患了运输性肺炎。

entries.meaningZh: 制鞋用皮革
entries.en: The supplier sent three samples of shoe leather for the designer to compare.
entries.zh: 供应商寄来了三份制鞋皮革样品，供设计师比较。

entries.meaningZh: 玩掷骰子游戏craps
entries.en: On their night off, the crew gathered in the recreation room to shoot craps.
entries.zh: 休息的晚上，船员们聚在娱乐室里玩craps掷骰子游戏。

entries.meaningZh: 供狩猎的管理区；在规定条件下允许狩猎的区域
entries.en: The map shows a shooting preserve beyond the public walking trail.
entries.zh: 地图显示，公共步道以外有一片供狩猎的管理区。

entries.meaningZh: 短铁杆（高尔夫球）
entries.en: She chose a short iron for the high approach shot over the bunker.
entries.zh: 她选了一支短铁杆，以高球越过沙坑攻向果岭。

entries.meaningZh: 短途运输线路；地方短途铁路
entries.en: The short line carries timber from the valley to the main railway junction.
entries.zh: 这条地方短途铁路把木材从山谷运往铁路干线交汇处。

entries.meaningZh: 制铅弹丸用的铅基合金（含砷等硬化成分）
entries.en: The museum label identifies the sample as shot metal rather than pure lead.
entries.zh: 博物馆标签将这份样品标为制弹丸用铅合金，而不是纯铅。

entries.meaningZh: 肩部臂章；缀在制服上臂靠近肩部的识别徽章
entries.en: The tailor sewed a new shoulder flash just below the sleeve's shoulder seam.
entries.zh: 裁缝在袖子的肩缝正下方缝上了一枚新的肩部臂章。

entries.meaningZh: 用肩膀挤进去
entries.en: Two latecomers tried to shoulder in as the crowd moved toward the stage.
entries.zh: 人群朝舞台移动时，两名迟到的人试图用肩膀挤进去。

entries.meaningZh: 低俗或令人不快的笑话；恶趣味玩笑
entries.en: His sick joke about the injured driver brought the conversation to an abrupt end.
entries.zh: 他拿受伤司机开的恶趣味玩笑，让谈话戛然而止。

entries.meaningZh: 军中病员报诊集合；病号集合（英式用语）
entries.en: Three recruits reported for sick parade before the rest of the unit began training.
entries.zh: 全队开始训练前，三名新兵参加了病员报诊集合。

entries.meaningZh: 台球桌长边中部的袋口；中袋
entries.en: She sent the blue ball into the side pocket with a gentle stroke.
entries.zh: 她轻轻一击，把蓝球送进了台球桌的中袋。

entries.meaningZh: 西格妮，女性名字（Signe）
entries.en: Signe set the blue bowl beside the window to examine its glaze.
entries.zh: 西格妮把蓝碗放在窗边，查看碗面的釉色。

entries.meaningZh: 北美西部的一种牧草（Oryzopsis hymenoides）
entries.en: Patches of silk grass remained green on the otherwise dry plain.
entries.zh: 在其余地方已干枯的平原上，几丛Oryzopsis hymenoides牧草仍然青绿。

entries.meaningZh: 文定果树（Muntingia calabura，又称Jamaican cherry）
entries.en: The silk wood beside the gate was covered with small white flowers.
entries.zh: 门边的文定果树开满了小白花。

entries.meaningZh: 一种毛叶柳树（本例指Salix sitchensis）
entries.en: Silky willow grew along the stream, its pale leaves moving in the wind.
entries.zh: 溪流两岸长着Salix sitchensis柳树，颜色浅淡的叶子随风摇动。

entries.meaningZh: 一种银色小型石首鱼（Bairdiella chrysoura）
entries.en: The guide identified the fish as a silver perch from its photograph.
entries.zh: 向导根据照片辨认出，那条鱼是Bairdiella chrysoura，一种银色小型石首鱼。

entries.meaningZh: 单螺旋桨飞机
entries.en: She logged her first solo flight in a borrowed single prop.
entries.zh: 她驾驶一架借来的单螺旋桨飞机，完成了首次单飞。

entries.meaningZh: 单人赛艇；供一人划行的轻型赛艇
entries.en: The coach steadied the single shell while the rower stepped aboard.
entries.zh: 划手登艇时，教练扶稳了那艘单人赛艇。

entries.meaningZh: 不祥的预感；忧虑不安的感觉
entries.en: I had a sinking feeling when the station lights went out and the last train was cancelled.
entries.zh: 车站灯光熄灭、末班车又被取消时，我心里升起一阵不安。

entries.meaningZh: 用虹吸管抽走；以虹吸方式排出
entries.en: They used a narrow tube to siphon off the water above the sediment.
entries.zh: 他们用一根细管把沉淀物上方的水虹吸出来。

entries.meaningZh: 六瓶装或六罐装饮料
entries.en: We put a six-pack of canned ginger beer in the cooler for the picnic.
entries.zh: 我们把一组六罐装姜汁汽水放进冷藏箱，准备野餐时喝。

entries.meaningZh: 车顶滑雪板架
entries.en: The skis were still strapped to the ski rack when the car reached the lodge.
entries.zh: 车开到山间旅舍时，滑雪板还绑在车顶的滑雪板架上。

entries.meaningZh: 共同储蓄会；成员定期集资、常于圣诞节分款的团体（英式旧称）
entries.en: Members of the slate club collected their savings at the pub just before Christmas.
entries.zh: 圣诞节前，共同储蓄会的成员在酒馆领取了各自积存的钱款。

entries.meaningZh: 睡眠住宿设施；供睡觉的房间或住处
entries.en: The ferry fare includes sleeping accommodation in a shared cabin.
entries.zh: 渡轮票价包括共用船舱内的睡眠住宿设施。

entries.meaningZh: 细身懒猴；Loris属的细长体型灵长类动物
entries.en: A slender loris reached from the branch to catch an insect.
entries.zh: 一只细身懒猴从树枝上探身去捉昆虫。

entries.meaningZh: 沉沉地滑落；无力地滑坐下去
entries.en: Too tired to stand any longer, he let himself slide down against the wall.
entries.zh: 他累得再也站不住了，便靠着墙滑坐下来。

entries.meaningZh: 甩液环；将防冰液分布到螺旋桨叶片上的环形装置
entries.en: The maintenance crew inspected the slinger ring around the propeller hub.
entries.zh: 维修人员检查了螺旋桨桨毂周围的甩液环。

entries.meaningZh: 轻快地脱下；迅速脱去
entries.en: You can slip off your muddy boots by the back door.
entries.zh: 你可以在后门旁脱下沾满泥的靴子。

entries.meaningZh: 迅速穿上；轻便地套上
entries.en: I'll slip on a jacket before we go out to look at the stars.
entries.zh: 出去看星星前，我先套上件夹克。

entries.meaningZh: 椎间盘突出；椎间盘脱出（通俗说法）
entries.en: The doctor explained the scan results and confirmed that he had a slipped disc.
entries.zh: 医生解释了扫描结果，确认他患有椎间盘突出。

entries.meaningZh: 单层炮甲板的小型军舰；旧式轻型战舰
entries.en: The display included a model of a sloop of war with its gun ports open.
entries.zh: 展品中有一艘旧式轻型战舰的模型，炮门敞开着。

entries.meaningZh: 止血马唐（Digitaria ischaemum）；一种禾本科杂草
entries.en: Smooth crabgrass had spread through the thin patches of lawn beside the path.
entries.zh: 小径旁草坪稀疏的地方已经蔓生了止血马唐。

entries.meaningZh: 蜻蜓（美国方言俗称）
entries.en: My grandfather called the insect a snake doctor; I knew it simply as a dragonfly.
entries.zh: 祖父把那只昆虫叫作snake doctor，我只知道它就是蜻蜓。

entries.meaningZh: 蜻蜓（美国中部方言俗称）
entries.en: In her childhood diary, she used snake feeder for the dragonflies above the creek.
entries.zh: 她在童年日记里用方言词snake feeder称呼小溪上方的蜻蜓。

entries.meaningZh: 使用呼吸管的浮潜
entries.en: The sheltered bay was our favourite place for snorkel diving.
entries.zh: 那个有遮蔽的海湾是我们最喜欢的浮潜地点。

entries.meaningZh: 大花猪牙花（Erythronium grandiflorum，一种黄花草本植物）
entries.en: A snow lily had opened its yellow flower beside the last patch of melting snow.
entries.zh: 最后一片融雪旁，一株大花猪牙花绽开了黄色花朵。

entries.meaningZh: 银耳；白木耳（Tremella fuciformis）
entries.en: She soaked the dried snow mushroom before adding it to the dessert soup.
entries.zh: 她先把干银耳泡发，再放进甜汤里。

entries.meaningZh: 一种鲜红色陆生有花植物（Sarcodes sanguinea）
entries.en: The snow plant stood out against the dark forest floor like a red candle.
entries.zh: 那株Sarcodes sanguinea有花植物像一支红烛，在暗色的林地上格外醒目。

entries.meaningZh: 一种淡色树蟋蟀（Oecanthus fultoni）
entries.en: We heard a snowy tree cricket in the shrub but could not see it among the pale stems.
entries.zh: 我们听见灌木里一只淡色树蟋蟀的叫声，却没能在浅色枝条间找到它。

entries.meaningZh: 一种北美龙胆（Gentiana saponaria）
entries.en: The botanist photographed soapwort gentian in the damp woodland beside the stream.
entries.zh: 植物学家在溪旁潮湿的林地里拍摄了Gentiana saponaria龙胆。

entries.meaningZh: 社交活动
entries.en: The evening meal became a social activity as guests moved between the long tables.
entries.zh: 宾客们在长桌之间走动，让晚餐变成了一场社交活动。

entries.meaningZh: 套筒扳手
entries.en: He fitted a larger socket to the socket wrench before loosening the bolt.
entries.zh: 拧松螺栓前，他给套筒扳手换上了一个更大的套筒。

entries.meaningZh: 所谓“软性毒品”；对被认为危害或成瘾性较低的毒品的非严格称呼
entries.en: The reporter questioned whether calling cannabis a soft drug made its risks sound trivial.
entries.zh: 记者质疑，把大麻称为“软性毒品”是否会让其风险听起来微不足道。

entries.meaningZh: 软性政治捐款；美国政治筹款中联邦限制范围以外的非联邦资金（本例为历史用法）
entries.en: The historian compared the party's soft money receipts in the 1992 and 1996 campaigns.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了该党在1992年和1996年竞选期间收到的软性政治捐款。

entries.meaningZh: 软皮小面包；用酵母发起、外皮柔软的面包卷
entries.en: She split a soft roll and filled it with roast vegetables.
entries.zh: 她把一个软皮小面包剖开，夹进烤蔬菜。

entries.meaningZh: 旧分类中的绿鹃类鸟名（本例指Vireo solitarius，今英文名blue-headed vireo）
entries.en: Her old field guide labels the blue-headed bird a solitary vireo.
entries.zh: 她的旧野外图鉴把那只蓝头的绿鹃类鸟标作solitary vireo。

entries.meaningZh: 歌鸫（Turdus philomelos）
entries.en: A song thrush repeated its clear phrases from the top of the garden tree.
entries.zh: 一只歌鸫在花园的树梢上反复鸣出清亮的乐句。

entries.meaningZh: 及时；在还来得及的时候
entries.en: We reached the station soon enough to catch the last train.
entries.zh: 我们及时赶到车站，赶上了末班火车。

entries.meaningZh: 排序算法
entries.en: The sorting algorithm puts equal scores next to each other without changing their values.
entries.zh: 这个排序算法把相同分数排在一起，而不改变分数的数值。

entries.meaningZh: 排序程序
entries.en: The sorting program arranged the archived letters by date.
entries.zh: 排序程序按日期排列了归档的信件。

entries.meaningZh: 南美树木Caryocar nuciferum的大型坚果状种子
entries.en: The display included a souari nut with part of its thick shell removed.
entries.zh: 展品中有一颗Caryocar nuciferum的坚果状种子，厚壳被去掉了一部分。

entries.meaningZh: 有声电影摄影机；能同步记录影像和声音的摄影机
entries.en: The catalogue explains how the sound camera keeps speech synchronized with the picture.
entries.zh: 目录介绍了这款有声电影摄影机如何保持说话声与画面同步。

entries.meaningZh: 声学计量单位
entries.en: The table gives each sound unit beside the acoustic quantity it measures.
entries.zh: 表格把每个声学计量单位列在它所测量的声学量旁边。

entries.meaningZh: 翅鲨；油鲨类的Galeorhinus galeus（soupfin shark）
entries.en: The tracking study followed a soupfin shark along the coast.
entries.zh: 这项追踪研究记录了一条Galeorhinus galeus翅鲨沿海岸活动的轨迹。

entries.meaningZh: 酸面团面包；用持续发酵的老面种制成的面包
entries.en: The baker used rye flour for this loaf of sourdough bread.
entries.zh: 面包师用黑麦粉做了这条酸面团面包。

entries.meaningZh: 苦苣菜属植物（Sonchus属）
entries.en: A sow thistle had grown through a crack beside the greenhouse door.
entries.zh: 温室门旁的裂缝里长出了一株苦苣菜属植物。

entries.meaningZh: 金丝瓜；熟后果肉可分成面条状细丝的瓜
entries.en: After roasting the spaghetti squash, he loosened the strands of flesh with a fork.
entries.zh: 把金丝瓜烤熟后，他用叉子拨松了丝状果肉。

entries.meaningZh: 一种含铜约74%的铜锍（旧冶金用语）
entries.en: The smelting report lists sparkle metal as an intermediate product rather than finished copper.
entries.zh: 这份冶炼报告把sparkle metal这种铜锍列为中间产物，而不是成品铜。

entries.meaningZh: 特别法；仅适用于特定个人或地区的立法
entries.en: The legal history describes a special act passed for that district alone.
entries.zh: 这部法律史记述了一项仅为那个地区通过的特别法。

entries.meaningZh: 精子；雄性生殖细胞
entries.en: The diagram shows a sperm cell beside an egg, with the two drawn to the same scale.
entries.zh: 示意图以相同比例画出了一枚精子和一枚卵细胞。

entries.meaningZh: 山胡椒属芳香灌木（本例指Lindera benzoin）
entries.en: A spice bush beside the footpath was covered with small yellow flowers.
entries.zh: 小径旁的一株Lindera benzoin芳香灌木开满了黄色小花。

entries.meaningZh: 香料蛋糕；以肉桂等香料调味的蛋糕
entries.en: The warm spice cake filled the kitchen with the smell of cinnamon.
entries.zh: 温热的香料蛋糕让厨房里充满了肉桂香。

entries.meaningZh: Ophrys属的某些兰花（spider orchid所指的一类）
entries.en: The field guide distinguishes this spider orchid from the Brassia orchids grown in greenhouses.
entries.zh: 这本野外图鉴把这种Ophrys属兰花与温室栽培的Brassia属兰花区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 抽穗；长出穗状花序
entries.en: The young plants should spike out once the warmer weather arrives.
entries.zh: 天气转暖后，这些幼株应该就会抽穗。

entries.meaningZh: 纺纱机；牵伸、加捻并卷绕纱线的机器
entries.en: The spinning frame stopped when a strand of yarn broke.
entries.zh: 一股纱线断裂后，纺纱机停了下来。

entries.meaningZh: 珍妮纺纱机；早期多锭纺纱机
entries.en: The museum demonstration showed one worker operating several spindles on a spinning jenny.
entries.zh: 博物馆的演示展示了一名工人如何操作珍妮纺纱机上的多个纱锭。

entries.meaningZh: 纺车轮钓竿；配合纺车式绕线轮抛饵的钓竿
entries.en: She packed a lightweight spinning rod for the fishing trip.
entries.zh: 她为钓鱼之行装好了一根轻巧的纺车轮钓竿。

entries.meaningZh: 刺龙虾；无大螯、甲壳多刺的海生龙虾类
entries.en: A spiny lobster backed into the rocky crevice, leaving only its long antennae visible.
entries.zh: 一只刺龙虾倒退着钻进岩缝，只露出长长的触角。

entries.meaningZh: 贴在额头或面颊上的小螺旋卷发
entries.en: A single spit curl lay flat against her forehead beneath the hat.
entries.zh: 帽子下，一小绺螺旋卷发平贴在她的额头上。

entries.meaningZh: 斯庞，姓氏（Spong）
entries.en: Spong had to duck under the beam to reach the attic window.
entries.zh: 斯庞得低头从横梁下钻过去，才能走到阁楼窗边。

entries.meaningZh: 用海绵涂上；用海绵拍涂
entries.en: The artist plans to sponge on a second colour after the first coat dries.
entries.zh: 画家打算等第一层颜色干了，再用海绵拍涂第二种颜色。

entries.meaningZh: 尚有希望的成功机会；颇有希望的获胜机会
entries.en: The extra practice gives our team a sporting chance against the league leaders.
entries.zh: 额外的训练让我们球队面对联赛领头羊时，也有了取胜的希望。

entries.meaningZh: 休闲西装上衣；运动式便西装上衣
entries.en: He wore a checked sports coat with plain trousers to the dinner.
entries.zh: 他穿了一件格纹休闲西装上衣，配素色长裤去赴晚宴。

entries.meaningZh: 春季赛前训练；春训
entries.en: Several young players joined the senior squad for spring training.
entries.zh: 几名年轻球员加入成年队，参加春季赛前训练。

entries.meaningZh: 一种常绿瑞香属灌木（Daphne laureola）
entries.en: The spurge laurel under the trees had glossy leaves and clusters of yellow-green flowers.
entries.zh: 树下那株Daphne laureola瑞香属灌木叶片有光泽，开着一簇簇黄绿色的花。

entries.meaningZh: 熊草（Xerophyllum tenax）的旧称（名称含现被视为冒犯性的词）
entries.en: The old herbarium label uses squaw grass for the plant now labelled bear grass.
entries.zh: 旧植物标本标签用squaw grass称呼那种如今标作bear grass的熊草。

entries.meaningZh: 对讲或广播系统的扬声器（口语）
entries.en: A crackling voice from the squawk box announced that the lift was out of order.
entries.zh: 对讲广播扬声器里传来带着杂音的声音，宣布电梯出了故障。

entries.meaningZh: 松鼠跑笼；小动物在其中奔跑时可转动的圆筒形笼子
entries.en: The squirrel cage turned as the small animal ran inside it.
entries.zh: 小动物在里面奔跑时，圆筒形跑笼随之转动。

entries.meaningZh: 一种美国东部落叶灌木（Lyonia mariana）
entries.en: Stagger bush grew along the edge of the clearing, with pale flowers hanging below its leaves.
entries.zh: 空地边缘长着Lyonia mariana落叶灌木，浅色花朵垂在叶片下方。

entries.meaningZh: 鹿角状分枝珊瑚；鹿角珊瑚
entries.en: The diver photographed a branch of staghorn coral growing from the reef.
entries.zh: 潜水员拍下了礁上长出的一枝鹿角珊瑚。

entries.meaningZh: 一种石松类植物（旧学名Lycopodium complanatum）
entries.en: Staghorn moss spread beneath the conifers beside the narrow forest path.
entries.zh: 狭窄的林间小径旁，针叶树下蔓生着旧名Lycopodium complanatum的石松类植物。

entries.meaningZh: 捣矿机；以重杵反复捣碎矿石的设备
entries.en: The stamping mill filled the valley with a steady pounding as it crushed the ore.
entries.zh: 捣矿机粉碎矿石时，持续的捣击声响彻山谷。

entries.meaningZh: 立式压印机；垂直施压的大型印刷压机
entries.en: The printer lowered the plate of the standing press onto the prepared sheet.
entries.zh: 印刷工把立式压印机的压板压向铺好的纸张。

entries.meaningZh: 史前直立巨石；竖石
entries.en: The path ends at a standing stone on the ridge above the village.
entries.zh: 小径的尽头是村庄上方山脊上的一块史前竖石。

entries.meaningZh: 单口喜剧演员；脱口秀喜剧演员
entries.en: The stand-up comedian turned a late audience member's apology into a running joke.
entries.zh: 那名单口喜剧演员把一位迟到观众的道歉变成了贯穿演出的笑料。

entries.meaningZh: 起跑标杆；标示比赛起点的柱子
entries.en: The official tied a red ribbon to the starting post before the race.
entries.zh: 比赛前，工作人员在起跑标杆上系了一条红丝带。

entries.meaningZh: 藏起；储存起来留待以后使用
entries.en: They managed to stash away enough blankets for the winter visitors.
entries.zh: 他们设法储存了足够的毯子，留给冬季到访的客人使用。

entries.meaningZh: 他汀类降脂药，抑制胆固醇合成的一类药物
entries.en: Before dispensing the statin, the pharmacist checked the patient's other medicines.
entries.zh: 药剂师发放那种他汀类药物前，核对了病人正在服用的其他药物。

entries.meaningZh: 警署值班警官；警署值班警长
entries.en: The station keeper entered the visitor's name in the duty book.
entries.zh: 警署值班警官把来访者的姓名记入值班簿。

entries.meaningZh: 远离；避开；不接近
entries.en: The children were told to stay away from the damaged footbridge.
entries.zh: 孩子们被告知不要靠近那座受损的人行桥。

entries.meaningZh: 医用支架，用于支撑血管等体内管道、保持其通畅的小管状装置
entries.en: The surgeon used a diagram to explain where the stent would sit.
entries.zh: 外科医生用示意图解释了支架将被放置的位置。

entries.meaningZh: 立体照片；由两个略异角度的影像组成、观看时产生立体感的照片
entries.en: Viewed through the old viewer, the stereoscopic photograph made the street seem to recede into the distance.
entries.zh: 通过那台旧观片器观看时，立体照片中的街道仿佛向远处延伸。

entries.meaningZh: 潜行狩猎；跟踪或埋伏猎物的狩猎方式
entries.en: Their still hunt ended when a snapped branch sent the deer running.
entries.zh: 一根树枝折断的声音把鹿惊跑了，他们的潜行狩猎也就此结束。

entries.meaningZh: 一种叶片揉碎后有异味的常绿榧树（Torreya taxifolia）
entries.en: The botanical garden planted a stinking cedar beside its other rare conifers.
entries.zh: 植物园在其他珍稀针叶树旁种了一株Torreya taxifolia榧树。

entries.meaningZh: 脚踏固定、用手往复操作的消防水泵；马镫式消防泵
entries.en: The volunteer held the stirrup pump steady with one foot while working the handle.
entries.zh: 志愿者用一只脚稳住马镫式消防泵，同时上下操作把手。

entries.meaningZh: 一种欧地中海伞形科草本植物（Sison amomum）
entries.en: Stone parsley grew beside the lane, its small white flowers held in loose clusters.
entries.zh: 乡间小路旁长着Sison amomum伞形科草本植物，白色小花形成疏松的花簇。

entries.meaningZh: 地中海地区的一种伞冠松树（Pinus pinea）
entries.en: A stone pine shaded the courtyard with its broad, spreading crown.
entries.zh: 一棵Pinus pinea松树用宽阔舒展的树冠为庭院遮阴。

entries.meaningZh: 停止之处；适合结束当前活动的节点
entries.en: The end of this section is a sensible stopping point for today's rehearsal.
entries.zh: 这一节结束的地方适合作为今天排练的收尾节点。

entries.meaningZh: 暴风警报锥；用于悬挂示警的锥形帆布信号
entries.en: The harbour keeper hoisted the storm cone above the signal station.
entries.zh: 港口管理员在信号站上方升起了暴风警报锥。

entries.meaningZh: 直槽凿岩钻；槽沟为直线的凿岩钻具（旧用语）
entries.en: The old inventory lists a straight flute among the mine's rock-drilling tools.
entries.zh: 那份旧清单在矿场的凿岩工具中列有一把直槽凿岩钻。

entries.meaningZh: （酒）经冰搅或摇匀后滤冰饮用的
entries.en: A straight-up martini arrived in a chilled glass.
entries.zh: 一杯经过冰镇并滤去冰块的马提尼，盛在冰过的杯子里端了上来。

entries.meaningZh: 奇异吸引子（非线性动力系统中的复杂吸引子）
entries.en: The Lorenz simulation traced a strange attractor instead of settling into a simple repeating orbit.
entries.zh: 洛伦兹系统的模拟描绘出了奇异吸引子，而没有稳定到简单的重复轨道上。

entries.meaningZh: 分层样本；将总体划分为层后分别抽取得到的样本
entries.en: The stratified sample included residents from every age group, selected at random within each group.
entries.zh: 这个分层样本包含各年龄组的居民，每组内都进行了随机抽取。

entries.meaningZh: 一种灯笼状宿萼包果的酸浆属植物（本例指Physalis pubescens）
entries.en: The strawberry tomato in the school garden had papery husks around its yellow fruit.
entries.zh: 学校花园里的Physalis pubescens酸浆属植物，黄色果实外包着纸质宿萼。

entries.meaningZh: 草莓树；Arbutus unedo常绿小乔木或灌木
entries.en: The strawberry tree carried both flowers and ripe red fruit beside the terrace.
entries.zh: 露台旁的草莓树上既有花朵，又有成熟的红色果实。

entries.meaningZh: 链球菌性咽炎；A组链球菌引起的咽喉感染
entries.en: The throat culture confirmed strep throat after the rapid test was inconclusive.
entries.zh: 快速检测结果不明确，随后咽拭子培养确认了链球菌性咽炎。

entries.meaningZh: 猛击；用力击打
entries.en: The drummer had to strike hard to make the final beat carry across the hall.
entries.zh: 鼓手必须用力击打，才能让最后一记鼓声传遍大厅。

entries.meaningZh: 弦乐四重奏组；由两把小提琴、一把中提琴和一把大提琴组成的四人乐组
entries.en: The string quartette rehearsed in the library before the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 客人到来前，弦乐四重奏组在图书馆里排练。

entries.meaningZh: 条纹鲈（Morone saxatilis）
entries.en: A striped bass broke the surface beside the pier and vanished again.
entries.zh: 一条条纹鲈在码头旁跃出水面，又消失了。

entries.meaningZh: 鲻鱼（Mugil cephalus）
entries.en: A school of striped mullet moved through the shallow water near the estuary.
entries.zh: 一群鲻鱼游过河口附近的浅水。

entries.meaningZh: 东部花栗鼠（Tamias striatus）；北美东部的一种条纹啮齿动物
entries.en: The striped squirrel paused on the log with its cheek pouches full of seeds.
entries.zh: 那只东部花栗鼠停在倒木上，颊囊里装满了种子。

entries.meaningZh: 频闪的；与周期性闪光有关的
entries.en: At one flash setting, the rotating blades appeared motionless in the stroboscopic light.
entries.zh: 在一种闪光设置下，旋转的叶片在频闪光照中看起来静止不动。

entries.meaningZh: 酿番茄；填入馅料的番茄
entries.en: Each stuffed tomato was filled with rice and herbs, then baked until tender.
entries.zh: 每个酿番茄都填入了米饭和香草，再烤至软熟。

entries.meaningZh: 超小型轿车；比紧凑型车更小的乘用车
entries.en: Their subcompact car fitted into the only parking space left on the street.
entries.zh: 他们的超小型轿车停进了街上剩下的唯一一个停车位。

entries.meaningZh: 子状态机；供其他状态机引用的状态机（本例为 UML 建模义）
entries.en: The model reused the same submachine in two different states.
entries.zh: 这个模型在两个不同的状态中复用了同一个子状态机。

entries.meaningZh: 分部；分项；某一部分的下级组成部分
entries.en: Each section of the manual contains several numbered subparts.
entries.zh: 手册的每一节都包含几个带编号的下级小节。

entries.meaningZh: 糖制硬糖；以糖熬制后冷却变硬的糖果
entries.en: The shopkeeper weighed the sugar candy into small paper bags.
entries.zh: 店主把糖制硬糖称好，装进小纸袋。

entries.meaningZh: 糖棕（Arenga pinnata）
entries.en: A sugar palm shaded the path leading to the village house.
entries.zh: 一棵Arenga pinnata糖棕为通往村屋的小径遮阴。

entries.meaningZh: 蓝鲸的旧称（Balaenoptera musculus）
entries.en: The nineteenth-century whaling account refers to the blue whale as a sulfur bottom.
entries.zh: 那份十九世纪的捕鲸记述把蓝鲸称作sulfur bottom。

entries.meaningZh: 黄色或橙色的粉蝶类蝴蝶（sulfur类）
entries.en: A sulfur butterfly closed its yellow wings on the clover flower.
entries.zh: 一只黄色粉蝶在三叶草花上合拢了翅膀。

entries.meaningZh: 黄色或橙色的粉蝶类蝴蝶（英式拼法）
entries.en: We watched a sulphur butterfly move from one flower head to the next.
entries.zh: 我们看着一只黄色粉蝶从一个花头飞到下一个花头。

entries.meaningZh: 以最高学业荣誉；以最优异成绩（拉丁语）
entries.en: She completed the demanding degree summa cum laude while raising two children.
entries.zh: 她一边抚养两个孩子，一边以最高学业荣誉完成了这个要求严格的学位课程。

entries.meaningZh: 即决判决；在不存在实质事实争议等条件下无需完整审判作出的判决
entries.en: The appeal challenged the summary judgement entered before the case reached trial.
entries.zh: 上诉对案件进入正式审判前作出的即决判决提出了异议。

entries.meaningZh: 露天甲板；日光甲板
entries.en: We went up to the sun deck to watch the islands pass.
entries.zh: 我们登上露天甲板，看着船从一座座岛屿旁驶过。

entries.meaningZh: 多年生羽扇豆（Lupinus perennis，特定植物种）
entries.en: Sundial lupine flowered along the sandy bank behind the cottage.
entries.zh: 小屋后方的沙质坡岸上，Lupinus perennis羽扇豆开花了。

entries.meaningZh: 下沉式篱障；由沟壕和挡土墙形成、较少遮挡视线的隔界
entries.en: The sunk fence kept the cattle out without blocking the view across the park.
entries.zh: 下沉式篱障挡住了牛，却没有遮挡横贯园地的视野。

entries.meaningZh: 超重量级拳击选手
entries.en: The super heavyweight entered the ring after the lighter boxers had finished their bouts.
entries.zh: 较轻级别的拳手比完后，那名超重量级选手进入了拳台。

entries.meaningZh: 超临界的；本例指流体处于超过其临界温度和临界压力的状态
entries.en: The study compared the solvent properties of liquid and supercritical carbon dioxide.
entries.zh: 这项研究比较了液态二氧化碳和超临界二氧化碳的溶剂性质。

entries.meaningZh: 超级乐队；由原本已各自成名的音乐人组成的乐队（本例为音乐义）
entries.en: The guitarist formed a supergroup with musicians from three other bands.
entries.zh: 这位吉他手与来自另外三支乐队的音乐人组建了一支超级乐队。

entries.meaningZh: 最高统帅部；最高指挥层（指人员）
entries.en: The supreme headquarters approved the revised evacuation plan.
entries.zh: 最高指挥层批准了修订后的撤离计划。

entries.meaningZh: 北美太平洋岸浅海的海鲫类鱼（surfperch）
entries.en: Several surf fish moved through the shallow water beyond the breaking waves.
entries.zh: 几条海鲫类鱼游过碎浪外侧的浅水。

entries.meaningZh: 地面拖牵式滑雪升降设备；使滑雪者贴地上坡的拖牵装置
entries.en: The surface lift pulled us uphill with our skis still on the snow.
entries.zh: 地面拖牵设备拉着我们上坡，滑雪板始终贴着雪面。

entries.meaningZh: 以露天方式开采；露天采矿
entries.en: The company hoped to surface mine the shallow deposit near the old quarry.
entries.zh: 该公司希望以露天方式开采旧采石场附近的浅层矿床。

entries.meaningZh: “请举心向上”的礼仪应答句；圣餐礼中的拉丁语呼句
entries.en: The choir's setting of the sursum corda begins with a single unaccompanied voice.
entries.zh: 合唱团演唱的“请举心向上”礼仪乐段，以一个无伴奏的人声开始。

entries.meaningZh: 无商业赞助商的广播或电视节目；由播出机构自行承担费用的节目
entries.en: The station filled the empty time slot with a sustaining program of chamber music.
entries.zh: 电台用一档没有商业赞助商的室内乐节目填补了空出的时段。

entries.meaningZh: 通过出汗减轻体重（常指短期失水，不等于减脂）
entries.en: His attempt to sweat off weight became a concern for the team doctor.
entries.zh: 他试图靠出汗减轻体重，让队医担忧起来。

entries.meaningZh: 甜罗勒；常作调味香草的罗勒（Ocimum basilicum）
entries.en: She tore a few leaves of sweet basil over the hot pasta.
entries.zh: 她把几片甜罗勒叶撕碎，撒在热意面上。

entries.meaningZh: 北美芳香树皮桦树（Betula lenta）
entries.en: The guide pointed out a sweet birch among the other trees on the slope.
entries.zh: 向导从坡上的树木中指出了一棵Betula lenta芳香树皮桦树。

entries.meaningZh: 甜茅属（Glyceria）的湿生禾草
entries.en: Sweet grass grew thickly along the muddy edge of the pond.
entries.zh: 池塘泥泞的边缘密生着甜茅属湿生禾草。

entries.meaningZh: 墨角兰（Origanum majorana）；一种芳香调味草本
entries.en: He added sweet marjoram to the beans just before serving them.
entries.zh: 临上桌前，他往豆子里加了些墨角兰。

entries.meaningZh: 桤叶山柳（Clethra alnifolia）；开芳香白花的灌木
entries.en: The sweet pepperbush beside the pond scented the warm evening air.
entries.zh: 池塘旁的桤叶山柳让温暖的晚风带上了花香。

entries.meaningZh: 香矢车菊类植物（本例指Amberboa moschata，旧名Centaurea moschata）
entries.en: The gardener planted sweet sultan near the gate for its fragrant pink flowers.
entries.zh: 园丁在门边种下Amberboa moschata香花植物，欣赏其芳香的粉红色花朵。

entries.meaningZh: 须苞石竹；美国石竹（Dianthus barbatus）
entries.en: A row of sweet William added dense clusters of colour to the border.
entries.zh: 一排须苞石竹为花境添上了密集而鲜艳的花簇。

entries.meaningZh: 大口喝下；大量喝下
entries.en: After the dusty journey, they stopped to swill down glasses of cold water.
entries.zh: 一路尘土飞扬，旅程结束后，他们停下来大口喝下一杯杯凉水。

entries.meaningZh: 向外摆动；向外大幅扫动
entries.en: The crane's boom can swing out over the water to lift cargo from the boat.
entries.zh: 起重机的吊臂可以向水面外摆，从船上吊起货物。

entries.meaningZh: 使转向支持另一方；使改变立场
entries.en: The mayor hoped the new transport proposal would swing over the undecided councillors.
entries.zh: 市长希望新的交通提案能争取到尚未表态的议员支持。

entries.meaningZh: 美国南部湿地的一种矮生竹（Arundinaria tecta）
entries.en: Switch cane formed a low thicket beside the flooded woodland.
entries.zh: Arundinaria tecta矮生竹在积水林地旁形成了一片低矮的竹丛。

entries.meaningZh: 剑杖；内藏剑刃或匕首的手杖
entries.en: The museum displayed the sword stick with its blade partly drawn.
entries.zh: 博物馆展示了那根剑杖，里面的剑刃被抽出了一部分。

entries.meaningZh: 美沙酮的一个别称（本义项；不指海洛因本身）
entries.en: The editor replaced synthetic heroin with methadone in the glossary to make the drug's identity clear.
entries.zh: 编辑把术语表中的synthetic heroin改为美沙酮，以明确所指的药物。

entries.meaningZh: 计算机系统错误；操作系统无法识别或不允许的操作所致错误
entries.en: The installer stopped with a system error before it could copy the final file.
entries.zh: 安装程序还没来得及复制最后一个文件，就因系统错误停了下来。

entries.meaningZh: 指法谱；用指法位置等信息表示演奏方法的记谱法
entries.en: She read the guitar tablature rather than the staff notation.
entries.zh: 她读的是吉他指法谱，而不是五线谱。

entries.meaningZh: 活人画；由真人摆出静止姿态构成的画面
entries.en: The actors held the tableau vivant until the curtain closed.
entries.zh: 演员们一直保持着活人画的静止姿态，直到幕布合拢。

entries.meaningZh: 表格资料；以表格形式排列的内容
entries.en: The editor moved the tabular matter into an appendix to shorten the main report.
entries.zh: 编辑把表格资料移到附录中，以缩短报告正文。

entries.meaningZh: 船闸或运河下游端的闸门；下闸门
entries.en: The lock keeper inspected the hinges of the tail gate before reopening the canal.
entries.zh: 运河重新开放前，船闸管理员检查了下闸门的铰链。

entries.meaningZh: （拳击手）假装被击倒；故意输掉比赛
entries.en: The screenplay centres on a boxer who is pressured to take a dive.
entries.zh: 这部剧本围绕一名被施压要求假装被击倒的拳手展开。

entries.meaningZh: 遭受打击；蒙受损失
entries.en: The shop could take a hit while the bridge is closed for repairs.
entries.zh: 大桥封闭维修期间，这家商店可能会蒙受损失。

entries.meaningZh: 悄悄溜走；不告而别（美式口语）
entries.en: The comic hero decides to take a powder just as the wedding guests arrive.
entries.zh: 婚礼宾客刚到场时，那位喜剧主角便决定悄悄溜走。

entries.meaningZh: 拿起武器作战；开始进行武装斗争（较文学性）
entries.en: In the novel, the villagers take arms against the occupying army.
entries.zh: 小说中，村民们拿起武器反抗占领军。

entries.meaningZh: 赚得；实得（工资或薪酬）
entries.en: With fewer shifts available, she expects to take home less this month.
entries.zh: 可上的班次减少了，她预计这个月实得的工资也会减少。

entries.meaningZh: 登台亮相；成为众人注意的焦点
entries.en: The band will take the stage after the interval.
entries.zh: 乐队将在中场休息后登台亮相。

entries.meaningZh: 全神贯注的；忙于某事的（常接with）
entries.en: She seemed entirely taken up with restoring the old piano.
entries.zh: 她似乎全神贯注于修复那架旧钢琴。

entries.meaningZh: 高生毛茛（Ranunculus acris）
entries.en: Tall buttercup flowered above the shorter grasses in the meadow.
entries.zh: 草甸里，Ranunculus acris高生毛茛的花朵高出较矮的禾草。

entries.meaningZh: 高生毛茛（Ranunculus acris，tall buttercup的别称）
entries.en: The old plant list uses tall crowfoot for the yellow-flowered Ranunculus acris.
entries.zh: 那份旧植物名录用tall crowfoot称呼黄花的Ranunculus acris毛茛。

entries.meaningZh: 高燕麦草（Arrhenatherum elatius）；一种多年生牧草
entries.en: Tall oat grass leaned over the narrow verge after the rain.
entries.zh: 雨后，高燕麦草倒伏在狭窄的路边草地上。

entries.meaningZh: 北美太平洋沿岸的一种常绿树（旧学名Lithocarpus densiflorus）
entries.en: The tanbark oak above the trail had large, leathery leaves.
entries.zh: 山径上方那棵旧名Lithocarpus densiflorus的常绿树，长着大而革质的叶片。

entries.meaningZh: 流苏风信子类球根植物（旧名Muscari comosum）
entries.en: The tassel hyacinth carried a tuft of violet flowers above the rest of the flower spike.
entries.zh: 那株旧名Muscari comosum的球根植物，在花序顶端托着一簇紫色花朵。

entries.meaningZh: 税收收入；政府从征税中取得的收入
entries.en: The town used part of its tax income to repair the public library roof.
entries.zh: 镇政府用部分税收收入修缮了公共图书馆的屋顶。

entries.meaningZh: 税前扣除；可从应税收入中扣减的款项（通俗用语）
entries.en: The accountant asked whether the equipment purchase qualified as a tax write-off.
entries.zh: 会计询问，这笔设备购置支出是否符合税前扣除条件。

entries.meaningZh: 征税官员；负责征收税款的人
entries.en: The taxer faced protests when the new levy was announced.
entries.zh: 新税项宣布后，征税官员遭到了抗议。

entries.meaningZh: 电视休息室；供人观看电视的房间
entries.en: The guests gathered in the television room to watch the match.
entries.zh: 客人们聚到电视休息室里观看比赛。

entries.meaningZh: 端着丝粒染色体；着丝粒位于末端的染色体
entries.en: The diagram places the centromere at the very end of the telocentric chromosome.
entries.zh: 示意图把端着丝粒染色体的着丝粒画在最末端。

entries.meaningZh: 中音鼓；次中音鼓（打击乐器）
entries.en: The tenor drum answered the bass drum with a rolling phrase.
entries.zh: 中音鼓用一段滚奏回应了大鼓。

entries.meaningZh: 特帕里豆（Phaseolus acutifolius）；一种耐热耐旱菜豆作物
entries.en: The growers compared several tepary bean varieties in the dry field.
entries.zh: 种植者在那块干旱的田地里比较了几个特帕里豆品种。

entries.meaningZh: 行政区划单位；为行政管理划定的地区
entries.en: Each territorial division submitted its population figures separately.
entries.zh: 每个行政区划单位分别提交了人口数据。

entries.meaningZh: 毛圈布；表面有未剪断线圈的毛巾织物
entries.en: The bathrobe was made from thick blue terry cloth.
entries.zh: 这件浴袍是用厚实的蓝色毛圈布做的。

entries.meaningZh: 毛圈毛巾；以毛圈织物制成的浴巾或毛巾
entries.en: He wrapped the wet puppy in a warm terry towel.
entries.zh: 他用一条温暖的毛圈毛巾包住了湿漉漉的小狗。

entries.meaningZh: 极难对付的东西；难办的事（口语）
entries.en: The last screw was the devil to remove without damaging the frame.
entries.zh: 想拆下最后一颗螺丝又不弄坏框架，真是难办。

entries.meaningZh: 三牌猜牌游戏；常用作街头骗局的三牌游戏
entries.en: The guide warned us to walk past the three-card monte game without placing a bet.
entries.zh: 导游提醒我们径直走过那场三牌猜牌游戏，不要下注。

entries.meaningZh: 北美东部的一种铁苋菜属杂草（Acalypha virginica）
entries.en: Three-seeded mercury had appeared in the disturbed soil beside the shed.
entries.zh: 棚屋旁翻动过的土壤里长出了Acalypha virginica铁苋菜属杂草。

entries.meaningZh: 北美东部的虫蛇（Carphophis amoenus）
entries.en: A thunder snake slipped beneath the damp leaves as we lifted the fallen branch.
entries.zh: 我们抬起倒下的树枝时，一条Carphophis amoenus虫蛇钻进了潮湿的落叶下。

entries.meaningZh: 票券簿；装订成册、可逐张撕下使用的票券
entries.en: The conductor tore a fresh ticket from the ticket book.
entries.zh: 乘务员从票券簿上撕下一张新票。

entries.meaningZh: 结系工；负责将物料系结的工人（旧职业称谓）
entries.en: The old employment register lists her as a tier-up in a silk mill.
entries.zh: 旧雇员名册把她登记为丝织厂中负责系结的工人。

entries.meaningZh: 虎甲；捕食其他昆虫的甲虫类
entries.en: The tiger beetle ran across the warm sand in short bursts.
entries.zh: 那只虎甲在温热的沙地上时跑时停。

entries.meaningZh: 虎鲨；鼬鲨（Galeocerdo cuvier）
entries.en: The research team photographed a tiger shark beside the reef.
entries.zh: 研究团队在礁石旁拍摄了一条虎鲨。

entries.meaningZh: 紧身的；贴合身体的
entries.en: The tight-fitting gloves made it difficult to pick up the tiny screws.
entries.zh: 紧身手套让拾起那些微小螺丝变得困难。

entries.meaningZh: 跷跷板；支在支点上、两端可轮流升降的长板玩具
entries.en: The children took turns on the tilting board in the playground.
entries.zh: 孩子们轮流玩操场上的跷跷板。

entries.meaningZh: 印度番泻植物；狭叶番泻类灌木（Senna alexandrina）
entries.en: The botanical collection included tinnevelly senna with yellow flowers.
entries.zh: 植物收藏中有一株开黄花的印度番泻灌木。

entries.meaningZh: 补篮；将弹回的球轻拨入筐的投篮
entries.en: Her tip-in dropped through the basket just before the buzzer.
entries.zh: 蜂鸣器响起前，她轻拨补篮，球落入了篮筐。

entries.meaningZh: 翻面桌；桌面可翻起至竖直位置的独柱桌
entries.en: The tip-top table stood against the wall with its top tilted upright.
entries.zh: 那张翻面桌靠墙放着，桌面翻起竖立。

entries.meaningZh: 台式小电烤箱；可烤面包或加热食物的小型电烤箱
entries.en: The toaster oven was just large enough to warm two slices of pizza.
entries.zh: 这台小电烤箱刚好能加热两片比萨。

entries.meaningZh: 烟草天蛾的幼虫（Manduca sexta）
entries.en: A tobacco hornworm was feeding on a leaf near the top of the plant.
entries.zh: 一只Manduca sexta烟草天蛾幼虫正在植株上部的一片叶子上取食。

entries.meaningZh: 烟草螟；一种幼虫危害烟草等干燥植物制品的小蛾（Ephestia elutella）
entries.en: The laboratory identified the small brown insect as a tobacco moth.
entries.zh: 实验室把那只褐色小昆虫鉴定为烟草螟。

entries.meaningZh: 烟草植株；烟草属植物
entries.en: The students measured the height of each tobacco plant in the greenhouse.
entries.zh: 学生们测量了温室里每株烟草的高度。

entries.meaningZh: 托比人物酒壶或酒杯；常塑成戴三角帽的矮胖男子形象的器皿
entries.en: The toby jug on the shelf showed a stout man in a three-cornered hat.
entries.zh: 架上的托比人物酒壶塑成了一个戴三角帽的矮胖男子。

entries.meaningZh: 代币强化制；以可兑换奖励的代币强化目标行为的制度
entries.en: In the classroom's token economy, pupils could exchange earned tokens for extra art time.
entries.zh: 在班级的代币强化制中，学生可以把挣得的代币换成额外的美术活动时间。

entries.meaningZh: 吐鲁香树；吐鲁香膏树（Myroxylon balsamum）
entries.en: The label identified the tolu tree by its botanical name, Myroxylon balsamum.
entries.zh: 标签用植物学名Myroxylon balsamum标明了这株吐鲁香树。

entries.meaningZh: 番茄果实夜蛾幼虫；美洲棉铃虫幼虫（Helicoverpa zea）
entries.en: The tomato fruitworm had chewed a hole into the ripening fruit.
entries.zh: 那只Helicoverpa zea幼虫在逐渐成熟的番茄上咬出了一个洞。

entries.meaningZh: 断层成像的；与获得内部截面图像有关的
entries.en: The team compared tomographic images taken before and after the procedure.
entries.zh: 团队比较了操作前后取得的断层图像。

entries.meaningZh: 牙槽；牙齿嵌入的骨性窝
entries.en: The dentist pointed to the empty tooth socket on the X-ray.
entries.zh: 牙医指出了X光片上那处空的牙槽。

entries.meaningZh: 齿鲸；具有牙齿的鲸类
entries.en: The guide explained why a sperm whale is classed as a toothed whale.
entries.zh: 向导解释了为什么抹香鲸被归为齿鲸。

entries.meaningZh: 高筒靴；常带异色或异质上缘的长靴
entries.en: His top boot had a pale leather cuff above the black shaft.
entries.zh: 他的高筒靴在黑色靴筒上方有一圈浅色皮革靴口。

entries.meaningZh: 上侧；最上面的表面
entries.en: The top side of the slab was polished, but the underside remained rough.
entries.zh: 石板的上表面磨光了，下表面仍很粗糙。

entries.meaningZh: 小腿长的女式紧身裤；斗牛士式七分紧身裤
entries.en: She wore black toreador pants with a loose white shirt.
entries.zh: 她穿着黑色的小腿长紧身裤，配一件宽松白衬衫。

entries.meaningZh: 龙卷风地下避难室；躲避风暴的地下室
entries.en: Before the storm arrived, the caretaker unlocked the tornado cellar.
entries.zh: 风暴来临前，管理员打开了龙卷风地下避难室的门锁。

entries.meaningZh: 斑纹似玳瑁的蛱蝶类（tortoiseshell类蝴蝶）
entries.en: A tortoiseshell butterfly warmed itself on the sunlit garden wall.
entries.zh: 一只玳瑁斑纹的蛱蝶停在阳光照着的花园墙上取暖。

entries.meaningZh: 顺便插入；随口加进谈话中
entries.en: Before the meeting ended, she managed to toss in one useful suggestion.
entries.zh: 会议结束前，她设法顺便提了一条有用的建议。

entries.meaningZh: 焓的旧称；内能加上压强与体积乘积的热力学量
entries.en: The old steam table uses total heat as the heading for its enthalpy values.
entries.zh: 那份旧蒸汽表用total heat作为焓值一栏的标题。

entries.meaningZh: 敞篷旅游车；有折叠车篷的旧式多人敞篷汽车
entries.en: The restored touring car carried four passengers with its folding top lowered.
entries.zh: 那辆修复后的旧式敞篷旅游车放下了折叠车篷，载着四名乘客。

entries.meaningZh: 一种直立生长的欧洲十字花科植物（本例指Arabis turrita）
entries.en: Tower mustard grew beside the old wall, its stiff stems rising above the surrounding herbs.
entries.zh: Arabis turrita十字花科植物长在旧墙旁，挺直的茎高出周围草本。

entries.meaningZh: 毒素—抗毒素混合制剂（旧式免疫制剂）
entries.en: The museum label describes toxin-antitoxin as an early diphtheria immunization mixture.
entries.zh: 博物馆标签把毒素—抗毒素混合剂介绍为一种早期白喉免疫制剂。

entries.meaningZh: 玩具士兵；士兵造型的小玩偶
entries.en: A toy soldier had fallen behind the bookcase during the move.
entries.zh: 搬家时，一个玩具士兵掉到了书柜后面。

entries.meaningZh: 无轨电车；从架空电线取电的公共汽车
entries.en: The trackless trolley crossed the square beneath a web of overhead wires.
entries.zh: 无轨电车从架空电线网下穿过广场。

entries.meaningZh: 收藏交换卡；可收集和交换的图像卡片
entries.en: She kept her rarest trading card in a transparent protective sleeve.
entries.zh: 她把最稀有的收藏卡放在透明保护套里。

entries.meaningZh: 行为事项豁免；就作证涉及的有关行为免受起诉的豁免
entries.en: The witness agreed to testify after being granted transactional immunity for the conduct under investigation.
entries.zh: 证人就受调查的相关行为获授不起诉豁免后，同意作证。

entries.meaningZh: 公共交通线路
entries.en: The new transit line connects the railway station with the university campus.
entries.zh: 新的公共交通线路连接火车站与大学校园。

entries.meaningZh: 捕兽陷阱线；沿一定线路设置的一系列陷阱
entries.en: The ranger marked the abandoned trap line on the survey map.
entries.zh: 护林员在调查地图上标出了那条废弃的捕兽陷阱线。

entries.meaningZh: 诱挡战术；先放防守者冲过开球线再将其挡开的美式足球进攻战术
entries.en: The coach replayed the trap play to show how the blocker opened a path for the runner.
entries.zh: 教练重放了那次诱挡战术，展示阻挡队员如何为持球跑者打开通道。

entries.meaningZh: 沿着某一路线行进
entries.en: The cyclists will travel along the canal before turning toward the hills.
entries.zh: 骑行者将沿着运河前进，然后转向山丘。

entries.meaningZh: 一种树状石松（Lycopodium obscurum）
entries.en: Tree clubmoss covered a small patch of the shaded forest floor.
entries.zh: 一小片阴暗林地上长满了Lycopodium obscurum石松。

entries.meaningZh: 树棉；木本棉属植物（本例指Gossypium arboreum）
entries.en: The gardener planted tree cotton for its pale yellow blossoms.
entries.zh: 园丁种下Gossypium arboreum树棉，欣赏其淡黄色花朵。

entries.meaningZh: 林木培育；树木的栽植和养护经营
entries.en: The family combined tree farming with a small dairy business.
entries.zh: 这家人既经营林木培育，也做小规模奶牛养殖。

entries.meaningZh: 一种高大灌木状锦葵科植物（旧名Lavatera arborea）
entries.en: The tree mallow beside the ruined wall carried large red-purple flowers.
entries.zh: 断墙旁那株旧名Lavatera arborea的锦葵科灌木，开着红紫色的大花。

entries.meaningZh: 三色彩色显像管；通过三原色组合显示彩色图像的电视显像管
entries.en: The diagram shows how the tricolour tube produces a colour television picture.
entries.zh: 示意图展示了三色显像管如何产生彩色电视图像。

entries.meaningZh: 洞口边的支承搁栅；承接横挡梁端部以围出楼梯等洞口的搁栅
entries.en: The carpenter marked the trimmer joist beside the new staircase opening.
entries.zh: 木匠在新楼梯洞口旁的支承搁栅上做了标记。

entries.meaningZh: 硅质抛光材料；可磨成抛光粉的风化硅质岩
entries.en: The restorer mixed tripoli into a paste before polishing the brass fittings.
entries.zh: 修复师把硅质抛光材料调成糊状，然后抛光黄铜配件。

entries.meaningZh: 美洲猪牙花（Erythronium americanum）；一种黄花猪牙花
entries.en: A trout lily in the pressed collection still showed traces of yellow on its petals.
entries.zh: 压制标本中的那株美洲猪牙花，花瓣上仍留有黄色的痕迹。

entries.meaningZh: 北美忍冬属藤本（Lonicera sempervirens，花常为红或橙色）
entries.en: Trumpet honeysuckle climbed the trellis beside the porch.
entries.zh: Lonicera sempervirens忍冬藤沿着门廊旁的花架攀爬。

entries.meaningZh: 簇羽海鹦；眼上具有黄色长羽簇的北太平洋海鸟
entries.en: A tufted puffin stood at the cliff edge with its yellow plumes blowing in the wind.
entries.zh: 一只簇羽海鹦站在崖边，黄色羽簇随风飘动。

entries.meaningZh: 一种攀缘野豌豆（Vicia cracca）
entries.en: Tufted vetch had climbed through the hedge and covered it with clusters of flowers.
entries.zh: Vicia cracca野豌豆攀进树篱，花簇布满了篱面。

entries.meaningZh: 一种黄花墨西哥附生兰（旧名Encyclia citrina或Cattleya citrina）
entries.en: The tulip orchid hung from its mount with the yellow flowers facing downward.
entries.zh: 那株黄花附生兰悬在附生板上，花朵朝下。

entries.meaningZh: 北美鹅掌楸（Liriodendron tulipifera）；郁金香树
entries.en: The tulip tree rose above the neighbouring trees in the park.
entries.zh: 公园里，那棵北美鹅掌楸高出了周围的树木。

entries.meaningZh: 涡轮喷气发动机；以涡轮驱动压气机的喷气发动机（本例为发动机义）
entries.en: The museum displayed a cutaway turbojet beside a diagram of its compressor.
entries.zh: 博物馆在一幅压气机示意图旁陈列了一台剖开的涡轮喷气发动机。

entries.meaningZh: 一种土耳其产低矮铺地菊科草本（Tripleurospermum tchihatchewii）
entries.en: The turfing daisy formed a low mat of small white flowers between the stones.
entries.zh: Tripleurospermum tchihatchewii菊科草本在石块间铺成一片低矮的小白花。

entries.meaningZh: 接客卖淫（非正式用语）
entries.en: The outreach worker asked the woman whether anyone had pressured her to turn a trick.
entries.zh: 外展工作者询问那名女子，是否有人曾施压让她接客卖淫。

entries.meaningZh: 转向指示灯；车辆转弯信号灯
entries.en: The driver switched on the turn indicator before leaving the roundabout.
entries.zh: 驾驶员驶离环岛前打开了转向指示灯。

entries.meaningZh: 在极小空间内转向；转弯半径很小（美式口语）
entries.en: The little boat can turn on a dime inside the narrow harbour.
entries.zh: 这条小船能在狭窄的港内以很小的半径转向。

entries.meaningZh: 产生性兴奋的（非正式）
entries.en: She felt turned on by her partner's voice over the phone.
entries.zh: 电话里伴侣的声音让她产生了性兴奋。

entries.meaningZh: 模糊地带；两种类别或状态之间的过渡区域
entries.en: The proposal lies in a twilight zone between public art and commercial advertising.
entries.zh: 这个提案处于公共艺术与商业广告之间的模糊地带。

entries.meaningZh: 系泊；将到港船只用绳索固定的过程
entries.en: The tying up of the ferry took longer than usual in the strong wind.
entries.zh: 大风中，渡轮系泊所用的时间比平常更长。

entries.meaningZh: 尺静脉；前臂尺侧的静脉
entries.en: The anatomy diagram labels the ulnar vein in the forearm.
entries.zh: 解剖图标出了前臂的尺静脉。

entries.meaningZh: 越权的；超出法定权限的（拉丁语法律用语）
entries.en: The court declared the board's decision ultra vires.
entries.zh: 法院认定董事会的决定超出了法定权限。

entries.meaningZh: 一种北美木兰（Magnolia tripetala，叶片在枝端呈伞状聚集）
entries.en: The umbrella tree spread its large leaves above the garden bench.
entries.zh: 那棵Magnolia tripetala木兰在花园长椅上方舒展着大叶片。

entries.meaningZh: 未清理的；尚未移除障碍物的（本例为路径义）
entries.en: The uncleared path was blocked by fallen branches.
entries.zh: 这条尚未清理的小路被掉落的树枝堵住了。

entries.meaningZh: 缺乏商业吸引力的；不利于商业成功的（本例为商业可行性义）
entries.en: The publisher admired the manuscript but considered its subject uncommercial.
entries.zh: 出版商欣赏这份书稿，却认为它的题材缺乏商业吸引力。

entries.meaningZh: 未分割共有权益；对整项共有财产的权益
entries.en: The deed gave each sister an undivided interest in the whole property.
entries.zh: 契据赋予每位姐妹对整处房产的未分割共有权益。

entries.meaningZh: 非自责分；按记分规则不计入投手自责分的失分（棒球）
entries.en: The scorer recorded an unearned run after an error kept the inning alive.
entries.zh: 一次失误使该局得以延续，随后记分员记下了一分非自责失分。

entries.meaningZh: 联合国儿童基金会的简称（UNICEF）；缩写沿用历史名称United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund
entries.en: The charity event raised money for UNICEF's work with children.
entries.zh: 这场慈善活动为联合国儿童基金会的儿童援助工作筹集了资金。

entries.meaningZh: 统一资源定位符（URL）；用于定位并访问资源的地址标识
entries.en: I copied the uniform resource locator from the browser's address bar into the report.
entries.zh: 我把统一资源定位符从浏览器地址栏复制进了报告。

entries.meaningZh: 大学推广教育；大学面向非在校注册学生提供的教育服务
entries.en: He studied local history through university extension while working full time.
entries.zh: 他全职工作期间，通过大学推广教育学习地方史。

entries.meaningZh: 一种北美白花菊科多年生植物（旧名Aster ptarmicoides）
entries.en: The upland white aster flowered in loose clusters beside the dry path.
entries.zh: 干燥小径旁，那株旧名Aster ptarmicoides的菊科植物开出了疏松的白色花簇。

entries.meaningZh: 城市；人口密集的城市区域（本例指整个城市聚居区）
entries.en: The railway turned the small port into a busy urban center.
entries.zh: 铁路使这座小港口发展成了繁忙的城市聚居区。

entries.meaningZh: 城市游击队员；在城镇活动的游击战人员
entries.en: The novel's narrator becomes an urban guerrilla operating in the capital.
entries.zh: 小说中的叙述者成了一名在首都活动的城市游击队员。

entries.meaningZh: 泌尿器官；泌尿系统的器官
entries.en: The lesson identified the kidney as a urinary organ.
entries.zh: 课堂上把肾脏列为泌尿器官。

entries.meaningZh: 泌尿小管；肾单位和集合管构成的肾内管道系统
entries.en: The lecturer traced the route of fluid through the uriniferous tubule on the diagram.
entries.zh: 讲师在图上描出了液体流经泌尿小管的路线。

entries.meaningZh: 可胜任多个位置的棒球选手；多面手球员
entries.en: The manager valued him as a utility man who could play both the infield and the outfield.
entries.zh: 经理看重他这名多面手球员，因为他既能守内野，也能守外野。

entries.meaningZh: 蒸气相对密度（本例在相同温压下，以空气为1作比较）
entries.en: The safety data sheet lists a vapour density greater than one, using air as the reference.
entries.zh: 安全数据表列出的蒸气相对密度大于一，并以空气为参照。

entries.meaningZh: 血管炎；血管发生炎症的一类病症
entries.en: The specialist explained which blood vessels were affected by the vasculitis.
entries.zh: 专科医生解释了哪些血管受到了血管炎的影响。

entries.meaningZh: 车辆交通；某地来往车辆的总体流动
entries.en: The square is closed to vehicular traffic during the weekend market.
entries.zh: 周末集市期间，广场禁止车辆通行。

entries.meaningZh: 绒毛剪股颖类草（本例指Agrostis canina）
entries.en: Velvet bent grass formed a fine, dense patch beside the path.
entries.zh: 小径旁的Agrostis canina剪股颖类草长成了一片细密的草丛。

entries.meaningZh: 尾穗苋（Amaranthus caudatus）；花序下垂的苋属植物
entries.en: The velvet flower's long tassels hung over the rim of the planter.
entries.zh: 那株尾穗苋的长穗垂过了种植盆的边缘。

entries.meaningZh: 蜗小管静脉；蜗水管静脉（解剖拉丁名）
entries.en: The anatomical chart labels the vena canaliculi cochleae beside the cochlear aqueduct.
entries.zh: 解剖图在蜗水管旁标出了蜗小管静脉。

entries.meaningZh: 腘静脉；膝后区域的静脉（拉丁名）
entries.en: The surgeon identified the vena poplitea behind the knee on the scan.
entries.zh: 外科医生在扫描图像中辨认出了膝后方的腘静脉。

entries.meaningZh: （天主教等宗教语境）小罪；可获宽恕、区别于mortal sin的一类罪
entries.en: The priest explained why the Church treats a venial sin differently from a mortal sin.
entries.zh: 神父解释了教会为何以不同方式看待小罪与大罪。

entries.meaningZh: 春花矮生鸢尾（Iris verna）
entries.en: The vernal iris opened its blue-lilac flowers before the taller plants filled the border.
entries.zh: 花境里较高的植物长满之前，Iris verna矮生鸢尾先开出了蓝紫色的花。

entries.meaningZh: 对顶角；两条直线相交形成的一对相对且相等的角中的一个
entries.en: We found the missing vertical angle by using the 65° angle opposite it.
entries.zh: 我们利用与它相对的65°角，求出了那个未知对顶角的度数。

entries.meaningZh: 近垂直倾侧；飞机横轴接近竖直的倾侧飞行姿态（航空义）
entries.en: During the display, the aircraft rolled into a vertical bank.
entries.zh: 飞行表演中，那架飞机滚转进入了近垂直倾侧的姿态。

entries.meaningZh: 甚高频；30至300MHz的无线电频段（VHF）
entries.en: The radio link uses very high frequency to carry signals between the boats.
entries.zh: 这条无线电链路利用甚高频在船只之间传送信号。

entries.meaningZh: 宗座代牧；代表教宗管理尚未成立正式教区地区的教会负责人
entries.en: A vicar apostolic visited the scattered mission communities by boat.
entries.zh: 一位宗座代牧乘船走访分散的传教团体。

entries.meaningZh: 取景器；相机中供瞄准和构图的装置
entries.en: The photographer kept both eyes open while checking the scene through the viewfinder.
entries.zh: 摄影师透过取景器查看画面时，两只眼睛都睁着。

entries.meaningZh: 漆树属的一种灌木（本例指Rhus glabra）
entries.en: The vinegar tree at the edge of the field had clusters of red fruit.
entries.zh: 田地边缘那株Rhus glabra漆树属灌木结着一簇簇红果。

entries.meaningZh: 乙烯基树脂；由含乙烯基的化合物聚合制成的热塑性树脂
entries.en: The new coating uses a vinyl resin as its binder.
entries.zh: 这种新涂料以乙烯基树脂作黏结剂。

entries.meaningZh: 中音谱号；第三线为中央C的C谱号（常用于中提琴）
entries.en: She checked the viola clef before copying the notes into her part.
entries.zh: 她先核对了中音谱号，再把音符抄进自己的分谱。

entries.meaningZh: 柔音中提琴；一种常带共鸣弦的古弓弦乐器（viola d'amore）
entries.en: The player tuned the sympathetic strings of the viola d'amore before the concert.
entries.zh: 演奏者在音乐会前调好了柔音中提琴的共鸣弦。

entries.meaningZh: 臂持式古提琴；用手臂支撑演奏的历史提琴类乐器（viola da braccio）
entries.en: In the engraving, the musician supports a viola da braccio on his arm.
entries.zh: 版画中，乐师用手臂托着一件臂持式古提琴。

entries.meaningZh: 孤雌生殖；未经雄性受精而产生后代（本例动物生殖学用法）
entries.en: The researchers checked the offspring's DNA after the suspected virgin birth.
entries.zh: 在疑似发生孤雌生殖后，研究人员检查了后代的DNA。

entries.meaningZh: 目视距离；在给定条件下用肉眼看见标准目标的距离
entries.en: Fog reduced our visual range to less than a hundred metres.
entries.zh: 雾使我们的目视距离缩短到了不足一百米。

entries.meaningZh: 伏打；意大利物理学家 Alessandro Volta（本例为具名人物）
entries.en: Volta's early battery is discussed in the museum guide.
entries.zh: 博物馆指南介绍了伏打的早期电池。

entries.meaningZh: 体积或容积的计量单位（本例容量义）
entries.en: Choose a volume unit before entering the tank's capacity.
entries.zh: 输入水箱容量前，请先选择一个容积计量单位。

entries.meaningZh: 元音；声道通畅时发出的语音
entries.en: The teacher asked us to hold the vowel sound without adding a consonant at the end.
entries.zh: 老师让我们持续发出那个元音，不要在结尾加上辅音。

entries.meaningZh: 华夫饼烤模；华夫饼机
entries.en: The waffle iron left a crisp grid pattern on both sides of the batter.
entries.zh: 华夫饼烤模把面糊两面烤出了酥脆的方格纹。

entries.meaningZh: 马车轮箍；包在木轮外缘的金属轮圈
entries.en: The wagon tire had come loose from the wooden wheel.
entries.zh: 木车轮外缘的金属轮箍已经松脱了。

entries.meaningZh: 叶尖能着地生根的蕨（Asplenium rhizophyllum）
entries.en: The walking fern had rooted where a long frond touched the damp soil.
entries.zh: 一片长叶触到湿土的地方，那株Asplenium rhizophyllum蕨已经生根。

entries.meaningZh: 大眼梭鲈；walleye（一种淡水鱼）
entries.en: The lake survey recorded a walleyed pike near the mouth of the river.
entries.zh: 湖泊调查在河口附近记录到了一条大眼梭鲈。

entries.meaningZh: 战时婴儿；战争期间出生的人
entries.en: The family album describes him as a war baby, born just before the fighting ended.
entries.zh: 家庭相册把他称为战时婴儿：他出生时，战斗已接近尾声。

entries.meaningZh: 仓储业者对保管货物的留置权，用于保障仓储等费用（法律术语）
entries.en: The storage contract contained a separate clause about the warehouseman's lien.
entries.zh: 仓储合同设有专门规定仓储业者留置权的条款。

entries.meaningZh: 洗手不管；宣布不再负责（常接of）
entries.en: If they ignore the safety review, I'll wash my hands of the project.
entries.zh: 如果他们无视安全审查，我就和这个项目撇清责任。

entries.meaningZh: 白费力气；徒劳的努力
entries.en: Rearranging the same files for a third time felt like a waste of energy.
entries.zh: 第三次重新整理同一批文件，让人觉得是在白费力气。

entries.meaningZh: 浪费自己的时间；白费工夫
entries.en: Don't waste your time searching the attic; the spare chairs are in the garage.
entries.zh: 别白费时间翻找阁楼了，备用椅子在车库里。

entries.meaningZh: 美洲梣；Fraxinus americana这一北美梣属树种（本例植物义）
entries.en: The white ash spread its branches over the garden wall.
entries.zh: 那棵美洲梣的枝条伸展到了花园围墙上方。

entries.meaningZh: white cohosh；北美一种结白色有毒浆果的草本植物（旧名Actaea alba）
entries.en: The guide pointed out white cohosh growing in the shaded woodland.
entries.zh: 向导指给我们看背阴林地里长着的white cohosh这种草本植物。

entries.meaningZh: 道路上的白色标线，用于划分车道（本例道路义）
entries.en: A white line separated the two lanes on the narrow road.
entries.zh: 狭窄道路上的一条白线把两个车道分开。

entries.meaningZh: 用白色涂改液盖掉文字（本例短语动词义）
entries.en: Please white out the wrong date before making copies of the form.
entries.zh: 复印表格前，请用白色涂改液盖掉错误的日期。

entries.meaningZh: 全音；由两个半音构成的音乐音程
entries.en: Move the melody up a whole step, from C major to D major.
entries.zh: 把旋律从C大调上移一个全音，转到D大调。

entries.meaningZh: 全音；两个半音的音乐音程
entries.en: The opening two notes rise by a whole tone rather than a semitone.
entries.zh: 开头两个音以上行全音相接，而不是半音。

entries.meaningZh: 未经工会领导批准而由工人自行发起的罢工
entries.en: Union leaders urged the workers to end the wildcat strike and return to negotiations.
entries.zh: 工会领导人敦促工人结束未经工会批准的罢工，重新参加谈判。

entries.meaningZh: 野猫井；在尚未证实有油田的地区钻探的勘探油井
entries.en: The first rock samples from the wildcat well gave the geologists little encouragement.
entries.zh: 那口勘探油井的第一批岩石样本没有给地质学家带来多少鼓舞。

entries.meaningZh: 风力发电；利用风力产生电力（本例能源义）
entries.en: The island relies on wind generation for part of its electricity.
entries.zh: 这座岛的一部分电力依靠风力发电提供。

entries.meaningZh: 意外利润；因非获利者所控制的事件而意外获得的收益
entries.en: A sudden rise in land prices gave the owner a windfall profit.
entries.zh: 地价突然上涨，使业主获得了一笔意外利润。

entries.meaningZh: 葡萄酒调味汁；以葡萄酒和其他配料调制的酱汁
entries.en: She spooned the wine sauce over the fish just before serving it.
entries.zh: 临上菜前，她用勺子把葡萄酒调味汁浇在鱼上。

entries.meaningZh: 接触臂；在一系列固定触点上转动接触的导电臂（本例电气义）
entries.en: The wiper arm rotated until its tip met the next fixed contact.
entries.zh: 接触臂转动，直到臂尖接触到下一个固定触点。

entries.meaningZh: 工作台；供特定操作使用的桌台（本例实物义）
entries.en: She cleared the work table before laying out the fabric.
entries.zh: 她先清理工作台，然后铺开布料。

entries.meaningZh: 静电成像打印机；采用静电成像过程的页面打印设备
entries.en: The xerographic printer left a faint streak down the left edge of every page.
entries.zh: 那台静电成像打印机在每页左边缘都留下了一道淡淡的条痕。

entries.meaningZh: yerba buena；美国西北部的一种匍匐常绿草本（旧名Satureja douglasii等）
entries.en: Yerba buena crept along the shaded edge of the garden path.
entries.zh: yerba buena这种草本植物沿着花园小路背阴的一侧匍匐生长。

entries.meaningZh: 洋蕺菜；Anemopsis californica这一蔓生草本（本例全株植物义）
entries.en: Yerba mansa had spread beyond the edge of the small garden bed.
entries.zh: 洋蕺菜已经蔓延到了那块小花圃的边界外。

entries.meaningZh: 基督教青年会的简称（Young Men's Christian Association）
entries.en: The children joined an after-school activity at the local YMCA.
entries.zh: 孩子们参加了当地基督教青年会的一项课后活动。
